一群邻居在联邦法院起诉一家发电厂，指控其污染了流经他们财产的河流。在答辩中，该发电厂提出了诽谤的反诉。该发电厂声称，邻居们恶意散布了其污染河流的虚假信息。

在审判开始前一周，法官与各方当事人举行了最终的审前会议。在会议上，法官下令对发电厂的诽谤反诉进行分案审理，决定首先进行河流污染案的审理，并确定在每次审理中，各方当事人有五天时间出示证据，因为这是该司法管辖区的惯例时间分配。发电厂对这些命令均提出异议。

在河流污染案的审理中，陪审团作出了有利于邻居的裁决，并判给他们300万美元的损害赔偿金。由于此次审理的结果，法官驳回了发电厂的诽谤反诉。

发电厂提起上诉，主张初审法官在审前会议期间下达的命令无效。

联邦上诉法院可能会如何裁决？
options:
A. Affirm all three orders.
维持所有三项命令。

B. Reverse the trial judge's order requiring a separate trial on the counterclaim.
推翻初审法官要求对反诉进行分案审理的命令。

C. Reverse the trial judge's order allowing each side just five days to present evidence.
推翻初审法官仅允许各方当事人五天时间出示证据的命令。

D. Reverse the trial judge's order to hear the river contamination trial before the defamation trial.
推翻初审法官先审理河流污染案，后审理诽谤案的命令。
data.explanation:
Pretrial conferences


(FRCP 16(c)) PurposeMatters for consideration
Expedite litigation
  • Eliminate frivolous claims & defenses
  • Obtain admissions & stipulations
  • Set timeline for summary judgment & dispose of pending motions
  • Schedule discovery, pretrial briefs & future conferences
Improve quality of trial
  • Amend pleadings
  • Refer matters to magistrate or master
  • Require separate trial for different claims
  • Adopt special procedures for complex/unusual legal issues
  • Rule on admissibility of evidence
  • Avoid cumulative evidence & limit expert testimony
  • Establish order & time limit for presentation of evidence
Facilitate settlementFacilitate just, speedy & inexpensive resolution
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 16, a federal district court judge may hold one or more pretrial conferences to help expedite litigation, improve the trial's quality, and facilitate settlement. At these conferences, the judge has broad discretion to address and act on a wide range of issues, including:

  • requiring separate trials of a claim, counterclaim, crossclaim, third-party claim, or other issue (Choice B)
  • determining the order in which the separate trials will be heard (Choice D) and
  • establishing a reasonable time limit to present evidence at trial (Choice C).


On appeal, these discretionary orders are reviewed for abuse of discretion. Under this standard of review, the appellate court gives great deference to the district court judge and will only reverse an unreasonable or arbitrary order.

Here, the district court judge had authority to issue the pretrial conference orders, and there is no indication that those orders were unreasonable or arbitrary. Therefore, the appellate court will likely affirm all three orders.

Educational objective: During pretrial conferences, a trial judge has wide discretion to issue orders - eg, (1) requiring separate trials for different claims, (2) deciding the order of trials, and (3) establishing a reasonable time limit to present evidence. On appeal, such orders are reviewed for abuse of discretion and will only be reversed if unreasonable or arbitrary.

选项正确率统计：A选项 64%（正确选项），B选项 26%，C选项 6%，D选项 1%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

审前会议


(FRCP 16(c)) 目的审议事项
加快诉讼进程
  • 排除无意义的诉讼主张和抗辩
  • 获取承认和约定
  • 为即决判决设定时间表并处理待决动议
  • 安排证据开示、审前状和未来的会议
提高审判质量
  • 修改诉状
  • 将事项移交给裁判官或主事官
  • 要求对不同诉讼主张进行分案审理
  • 对复杂/不寻常的法律问题采纳特殊程序
  • 就证据的可采性作出裁定
  • 避免重复性证据并限制专家证言
  • 确定出示证据的顺序和时限
促进和解促进公正、迅速和经济的解决方案
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (联邦民事诉讼规则)。

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第16条，联邦地区法院法官可以举行一次或多次审前会议，以帮助加快诉讼进程、提高审判质量并促进和解。在这些会议上，法官拥有广泛的自由裁量权来处理和决定一系列广泛的问题，包括：

  • 要求分案审理一项诉讼主张、反诉、交叉诉讼、第三方诉讼或其他问题（选项B）
  • 决定分案审理的顺序（选项D）以及
  • 为在审判中出示证据设定合理的时限（选项C）。


在上诉中，对这些自由裁量命令的审查标准是滥用自由裁量权。在此审查标准下，上诉法院对地区法院法官给予极大的尊重，并且只有在命令不合理或武断的情况下才会予以推翻。

在本案中，地区法院法官有权发布审前会议命令，并且没有迹象表明这些命令是不合理或武断的。因此，上诉法院很可能会维持所有三项命令。

教学目的：在审前会议期间，初审法官拥有广泛的自由裁量权来发布命令——例如，(1) 要求对不同的诉讼主张进行分案审理，(2) 决定审理的顺序，以及 (3) 为出示证据设定合理的时限。在上诉中，此类命令将以滥用自由裁量权为标准进行审查，只有在不合理或武断的情况下才会被推翻。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 16 (pretrial conferences).

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Pretrial Conferences

正确答案：A
(维持所有三项命令)
核心考点：法官的案件管理权

本题的核心在于理解联邦地区法院法官在审前会议 (Pretrial Conferences) 阶段拥有的广泛自由裁量权 (Discretion)。

根据 FRCP 16 和 FRCP 42，为了实现“公正、迅速和经济”的诉讼目标，法官有权对审判程序进行管理。

逐项命令解析
1. 分案审理 (Separate Trials)
根据 FRCP 42(b)，为了方便、避免偏见或提高效率，法官可以命令将反诉 (Counterclaim) 分开审理。本案中，将复杂的环境污染索赔与诽谤索赔分开是合理的管理手段。
2. 审理顺序 (Order of Trials)
法官决定先审理“河流污染案”是非常符合逻辑的。
理由：诽谤 (Defamation) 的核心抗辩是“真实性” (Truth)。如果发电厂确实污染了河流（事实为真），那么邻居们的言论就不构成诽谤。因此，先确定污染事实可以直接决定诽谤案是否还有必要进行，这极大地节省了司法资源。
3. 限制举证时间 (Time Limits)
根据 FRCP 16(c)(2)(O)，法官有权为出示证据设定合理的时限。只要该限制不是武断的（arbitrary）且没有剥夺当事人的正当程序权利，上诉法院通常不会干预。题目中提到“五天是该辖区的惯例”，这进一步证明了该命令的合理性。
上诉审查标准

在上诉阶段，针对初审法官的案件管理命令（如分案、时间限制），上诉法院适用的审查标准是：

滥用自由裁量权
(Abuse of Discretion)

这意味着，除非初审法官的决定极度不合理或明显武断，否则上诉法院将予以维持 (Affirm)。本案中法官的决定逻辑清晰，旨在提高效率，因此会被维持。

💡 MBE 备考技巧

在遇到关于审前程序 (Pretrial Procedures) 或 法官管理权 的题目时，请记住：

  • 联邦规则 (FRCP) 赋予初审法官极大的权力来控制案件进度。
  • 关键词是"Efficiency" (效率) 和 "Judicial Economy" (司法经济)。
  • 如果题目问上诉结果，除非法官的行为极其离谱（例如完全剥夺了一方说话的机会），否则答案通常是"Affirm" (维持原判)。

questions.question:
A woman's house burned down after the wiring in her refrigerator sparked and started a fire. The following week, the woman received adequate notice that a class action had been filed in federal court against the manufacturer of the refrigerator for damages caused by the refrigerator's faulty wiring system. The woman did nothing when she received the notice and was not named as a class representative.
The court certified the class action after determining that common questions of law and fact predominated and that the class action was the best method to fairly and efficiently adjudicate the dispute. During discovery, the named class representatives reached a proposed settlement with the manufacturer. At a hearing, the woman objected to the proposed settlement on the ground that it was inadequate to cover the damage to her house. Despite her objection, the court approved the settlement after concluding that it was fair, reasonable, and adequate.
The woman then sued the manufacturer in another federal court to recover damages for the remaining damage to her house. The manufacturer moved to dismiss this suit.
Is the court likely to grant the manufacturer's motion?

choices.a: No, because the woman objected to the proposed class action settlement.
choices.b: No, because the woman was not a named representative in the class action.
choices.c: Yes, because the court certified the class action.
choices.d: Yes, because the woman failed to opt out of the class action.

一名女性的房屋因其冰箱内的电线产生火花并引发火灾而被烧毁。次周，该女性收到了充分的通知，得知一桩集体诉讼已在联邦法院提起，就因冰箱有缺陷的布线系统所造成的损害向该冰箱制造商索赔。该女性在收到通知后未采取任何行动，也未被指定为集体诉讼代表人。

法院在认定法律和事实的共同问题占主导地位，且集体诉讼是公正、高效地裁决该争议的最佳方法后，批准了该集体诉讼。在证据开示期间，被指定的集体诉讼代表人与制造商达成了和解提议。在一次听证会上，该女性对和解提议提出异议，理由是该和解不足以弥补其房屋的损失。尽管她提出了异议，法院在认定和解方案公正、合理且充分后，依然批准了该和解。

随后，该女性在另一家联邦法院起诉该制造商，要求赔偿其房屋的剩余损失。制造商动议驳回此项诉讼。

法院是否可能批准制造商的动议？
options:
A. No, because the woman objected to the proposed class action settlement.
不会，因为该女性对提议的集体诉讼和解方案提出了异议。

B. No, because the woman was not a named representative in the class action.
不会，因为该女性并非集体诉讼中的指定代表人。

C. Yes, because the court certified the class action.
会，因为法院批准了该集体诉讼。

D. Yes, because the woman failed to opt out of the class action.
会，因为该女性未能选择退出该集体诉讼。
data.explanation:
Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 23 recognizes three types of class actions: prejudicial risk, final equitable relief, and common question. Here, the

court certified (ie, authorized) a "common question" class action against the manufacturer because it determined that (1) common questions of law and fact predominated and (2) the class action was the best method to fairly and efficiently adjudicate the dispute.

In "common question" class actions, adequate notice must be provided to all class members because they have the right to opt out of the class action and sue on their own behalf.† If a class member fails to opt out, he/she cannot pursue an individual suit involving the same claim. Instead, that class member is bound by any resulting final judgment or court-approved settlement, compromise, or voluntary dismissal.

Here, the woman failed to opt out of the class action because she did nothing after receiving adequate notice of the class action. This means that she is bound by the court-approved settlement and barred from asserting an individual suit against the manufacturer. Therefore, the court will likely grant the manufacturer's motion to dismiss her suit.

†In "prejudicial risk" and "final equitable relief" class actions, notice is not required because class members do not have a right to opt out. Instead, a court has the discretion to provide notice and an opportunity to opt out of such class actions.

(Choice A) A class member who objects to a proposed settlement shows that his/her interests diverge from those of the class. As a result, an objection allows the class member to appeal if the court approves the proposal - but not to file an individual suit.

(Choice B) Named class representatives and unnamed class members alike are bound by a court-approved settlement except for those members who opted out of the class action (not seen here).

(Choice C) The fact that the court certified the class action allowed the class action to proceed in federal court. However, it does not provide a basis for dismissing the woman's suit.

Educational objective: A class member must opt out of a "common question" class action to pursue an individual suit involving the same claim. Otherwise, the class member is bound by any final judgment or court-approved settlement, compromise, or voluntary dismissal of the class action.



选项正确率统计：A选项 10%，B选项 6%，C选项 9%，D选项 73%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

《Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 23》（联邦民事诉讼规则第23条）承认三种类型的集体诉讼：防止损害风险型(prejudicial risk)、最终衡平法救济型(final equitable relief)和共同问题型(common question)。在本案中，

法院批准（即授权）了一项针对制造商的“共同问题型”集体诉讼，因为它认定（1）法律和事实的共同问题占主导地位，以及（2）集体诉讼是公正、高效地裁决该争议的最佳方法。

在“共同问题型”集体诉讼中，必须向所有集体成员提供充分的通知，因为他们有权选择退出（opt out）集体诉讼并以个人名义提起诉讼。† 如果集体成员未能选择退出，他/她就不能就同一诉求提起个人诉讼。相反，该集体成员将受到任何最终判决或法院批准的和解、妥协或自愿撤诉的约束。

在本案中，该女性在收到集体诉讼的充分通知后未采取任何行动，因此未能选择退出该集体诉讼。这意味着她受到法院批准的和解的约束，并被禁止向制造商提起个人诉讼。因此，法院很可能会批准制造商驳回其诉讼的动议。

†在“防止损害风险型(prejudicial risk)”和“最终衡平法救济型(final equitable relief)”集体诉讼中，不要求发出通知，因为集体成员没有选择退出的权利。不过，法院有自由裁量权来决定是否提供通知以及在此类集体诉讼中提供选择退出的机会。

(选项A) 对和解提议提出异议的集体成员表明其利益与集体利益存在分歧。因此，如果法院批准了该提议，异议允许该集体成员上诉——但不能提起个人诉讼。

(选项B) 指定的集体诉讼代表人和未被指定的集体成员同样受到法院批准的和解的约束，但已选择退出集体诉讼的成员除外（本案中未出现此情况）。

(选项C) 法院批准集体诉讼这一事实，使得该集体诉讼得以在联邦法院进行。然而，这并不构成驳回该女性诉讼的依据。

教学要点：在“共同问题型”集体诉讼中，集体成员必须选择退出，才能就同一诉求提起个人诉讼。否则，该集体成员将受到该集体诉讼的任何最终判决或法院批准的和解、妥协或自愿撤诉的约束。

References

  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 23(c)(2) (notice requirements for "common question" class action).
  • Matsushita Elec. Indus. Co., Ltd. v. Epstein, 516 U.S. 367, 378 - 79 (1996) (explaining that class members who fail to opt out of a class action are bound by a resulting court-approved settlement agreement).

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Class Actions
✅ 正确答案：D

因为该女性未能选择退出 (Opt Out) 集体诉讼。

核心考点：FRCP 23(b)(3)

本题考查的是“共同问题”集体诉讼 (Common Question Class Action) 的约束力。

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第23条：

  • 在 (b)(3) 类型的集体诉讼中，法院必须向成员提供充分的通知 (Adequate Notice)。
  • 通知必须告知成员他们有权选择退出 (Opt Out)。
  • 如果成员未能选择退出，他们将自动成为集体的一部分，并受最终判决或和解协议的约束 (Bound)。

📝 案情逻辑链

1
定性：题目明确指出法院基于“共同法律和事实问题占主导地位”认证了集体诉讼。这属于 FRCP 23(b)(3) 类型。
2
通知：该女性收到了充分的通知 (Adequate Notice)。
3
行为：该女性“什么也没做” (Did nothing)。这意味着她没有行使选择退出的权利。
4
后果：由于她没有退出，她就是集体诉讼的一员。法院批准的和解协议具有既判力 (Res Judicata)。她不能再就同一诉由提起单独的诉讼。

🚫 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A：她提出了异议 (Objected)

错误点：提出异议 ≠ 选择退出。提出异议只是告诉法院“我认为这个和解不公平”，如果法院驳回异议并批准和解（如本案），该成员依然受和解约束。她可以上诉，但不能另起诉讼。

选项 B：她不是指定代表人 (Named Representative)

错误点：集体诉讼的本质就是判决对所有未退出的成员（无论是否被命名）都有效。否则集体诉讼就失去了解决大规模纠纷的意义。

选项 C：法院认证了集体诉讼

错误点：虽然认证是前提，但直接导致她个人诉讼被驳回的原因是既判力 (Claim Preclusion)，而既判力来源于她“未能退出”这一事实，而非仅仅因为集体诉讼存在。

💡 MBE 提分技巧：
看到集体诉讼题目，首先判断类型：
  • 如果是 (b)(3) Common Question（通常涉及金钱赔偿）：成员有权退出。不退出 = 被绑定。
  • 如果是 (b)(1) 或 (b)(2)（通常涉及禁令或宣告性判决）：成员通常无权退出，直接被绑定。
本题中“损害赔偿”和“共同问题”是识别 (b)(3) 的关键词。

questions.question:
On July 1, 2015, a man was seriously injured when the helicopter he was piloting crashed. The man's attorney diligently investigated and determined that a valve malfunction caused the crash. The attorney contacted the helicopter distributor and requested the name of the company that manufactured the valve in the man's helicopter. The helicopter distributor mistakenly gave the attorney the name of the wrong valve manufacturer.
On June 1, 2017, the man sued the helicopter distributor and the valve manufacturer in federal court to recover $5 million in damages. On January 3, 2018, the name of the valve manufacturer that actually manufactured the valve in the man's helicopter was revealed during discovery. The same day, the man moved to amend his complaint to substitute the correct valve manufacturer as the defendant. The correct valve company did not receive notice of the man's suit until this time.
The applicable statute of limitations provides: "Any personal injury action shall be brought within two years from the date the alleged injuries occurred. A complaint may be amended to properly name a defendant not identified until after the complaint has been filed if the complaint was filed within the designated limitations period."
May the man amend his complaint?

choices.a: No, because the correct valve manufacturer did not receive timely notice of the suit.
choices.b: No, because the statute of limitations has expired.
choices.c: Yes, because the amendment concerns the same transaction asserted in the original pleading.
choices.d: Yes, because the amendment is permitted under the relation-back doctrine.

data.questionStem:
Q88213

On July 1, 2015, a man was seriously injured when the helicopter he was piloting crashed. The man's attorney diligently investigated and determined that a valve malfunction caused the crash. The attorney contacted the helicopter distributor and requested the name of the company that manufactured the valve in the man's helicopter. The helicopter distributor mistakenly gave the attorney the name of the wrong valve manufacturer.

On June 1, 2017, the man sued the helicopter distributor and the valve manufacturer in federal court to recover $5 million in damages. On January 3, 2018, the name of the valve manufacturer that actually manufactured the valve in the man's helicopter was revealed during discovery. The same day, the man moved to amend his complaint to substitute the correct valve manufacturer as the defendant. The correct valve company did not receive notice of the man's suit until this time.

The applicable statute of limitations provides: "Any personal injury action shall be brought within two years from the date the alleged injuries occurred. A complaint may be amended to properly name a defendant not identified until after the complaint has been filed if the complaint was filed within the designated limitations period."

May the man amend his complaint?

2015年7月1日，一名男子在驾驶直升机时因坠机而受重伤。该男子的律师经尽职调查后，确定是阀门故障导致了坠机事故。该律师联系了直升机经销商，并要求提供制造该男子直升机中阀门的公司名称。直升机经销商错误地向律师提供了错误的阀门制造商名称。

2017年6月1日，该男子在联邦法院起诉直升机经销商和该阀门制造商，要求赔偿500万美元的损害。2018年1月3日，在证据开示程序中，实际制造该男子直升机中阀门的制造商名称被披露。同日，该男子提出动议，请求修改其诉状，以正确的阀门制造商替换为被告。在此之前，正确的阀门公司并未收到该男子诉讼的通知。

适用的诉讼时效法规规定：“任何人身伤害诉讼须在所指称的伤害发生之日起两年内提起。如果在指定的时效期限内提交了诉状，则可以在诉状提交后修改诉状，以正确指名在诉状提交前未被识别的被告。”

该男子可以修改其诉状吗？
options:
A. No, because the correct valve manufacturer did not receive timely notice of the suit.
不可以，因为正确的阀门制造商没有及时收到诉讼通知。

B. No, because the statute of limitations has expired.
不可以，因为诉讼时效已过。

C. Yes, because the amendment concerns the same transaction asserted in the original pleading.
可以，因为该修改涉及原始诉状中主张的同一交易。

D. Yes, because the amendment is permitted under the relation-back doctrine.
可以，因为根据关联补正原则（relation-back doctrine），该修改是被允许的。
data.explanation:
A pleading (eg, complaint) cannot be amended after the statute of limitations has expired unless the relation-back doctrine applies. Under this doctrine, an amendment is treated as if it were filed on the same date as the original pleading so that the amendment "relates back" to the date of the original pleading. An amendment that changes a party relates back if the applicable statute of limitations allows.

Here, the statute of limitations on the man's personal-injury claim expired on July 1, 2017 - two years after his alleged injury. He moved to amend his complaint on January 1, 2018 - six months after the statute of limitations had expired. But the applicable law allows relation back when the plaintiff made a mistake as to the proper defendant's identity. Therefore, the amendment "relates back" to the date the man's original complaint was filed on June 1, 2017 - before the statute of limitations expired - and the man may amend his complaint (Choice B).

Had the applicable statute of limitations been silent about relation back, the amendment would still relate back if:
  • the amendment concerned the same transaction or occurrence as the original pleading (Choice C)
  • the new party received notice of the suit within 90 days after the original pleading was filed (Choice A) and
  • the new party knew or should have known that the suit would have been brought against it but for a mistake concerning the proper party's identity (as seen here).

But this analysis is unnecessary since the applicable law does allow relation back under these circumstances.

Educational objective: An amended pleading that changes a party to a lawsuit after the statute of limitations has expired will "relate back" to the date of the original pleading if the statute of limitations allows.



选项正确率统计：A选项 20%，B选项 6%，C选项 13%，D选项 58%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

诉状（例如，起诉状）在诉讼时效（statute of limitations）期满后不得修改，除非关联补正原则（relation-back doctrine）适用。根据此原则，修改后的诉状被视为与原始诉状在同一日期提交，因此该修改可以“溯及”至原始诉状的提交日期。如果适用的诉讼时效法规允许，变更当事人的修改可以溯及既往。

在本案中，该男子人身伤害索赔的诉讼时效于2017年7月1日到期——即其声称受伤两年后。他在2018年1月1日提出修改其诉状的动议——此时诉讼时效已过期六个月。但适用的法律允许在原告因错误而未能确定正确被告身份时进行关联补正。因此，该修改“溯及”至该男子于2017年6月1日提交原始诉状的日期——即在诉讼时效到期之前——故该男子可以修改其诉状（因此选项B是错误的）。

如果适用的诉讼时效法规对关联补正保持沉默，那么在以下情况下，该修改仍可溯及既往：
  • 该修改涉及与原始诉状相同的交易或事件(选项C)
  • 新当事人在原始诉状提交后90天内收到了诉讼通知(选项A) 并且
  • 新当事人知道或理应知道，若非因为对正确当事人身份的错误认定，该诉讼本应向其提起（如此案所示）。

但由于本案适用的法律确实允许在此情况下进行关联补正，因此上述分析并无必要。

教学目的：如果诉讼时效法规允许，在诉讼时效到期后变更诉讼当事人的修改后诉状将“溯及”至原始诉讼的提交日期。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 15(c) (relation back of amended pleadings).

MBE 考点解析：民事诉讼法

Pretrial Procedures
正确答案：选项 D
核心考点

关联补正原则 (Relation-Back Doctrine)

本题考察的是在诉讼时效 (Statute of Limitations) 过期后，修改诉状以添加新被告是否有效的问题。

根据 Fed. R. Civ. P. 15(c)，如果满足特定条件，修改后的诉状可以“溯及” (relate back) 至原始诉状提交的日期，从而避免因时效过期而被驳回。

法律依据

FRCP 15(c)(1) 的两条路径

联邦民事诉讼规则第15(c)(1)条规定，在以下任一情况下，修改均可溯及既往：

路径 A (Rule 15(c)(1)(A))：
提供适用诉讼时效的法律（即州法）允许溯及既往。
路径 B (Rule 15(c)(1)(C))：
（联邦通用标准）满足三个条件：
  1. 涉及同一交易/事件；
  2. 新被告在送达期内（90天）收到通知；
  3. 新被告知道若非原告弄错身份，自己本会被起诉。
案情应用

为什么本题选 D？

本题是一个典型的“陷阱题”。如果只看联邦通用标准（路径 B），原告会输，因为新被告在原始诉状提交后超过90天（6月1日到次年1月3日）才收到通知，不满足 15(c)(1)(C) 的要求。

但是！题目中明确引用了一条具体的法规（Applicable Statute）：

"A complaint may be amended to properly name a defendant... if the complaint was filed within the designated limitations period."

这条法规非常宽容，只要原始诉状在时效内提交，就允许修改被告名。根据 Rule 15(c)(1)(A)，联邦法院必须尊重这条允许溯及既往的法律。

因此，尽管新被告收到通知很晚，但因为适用的时效法规允许，该修改根据关联补正原则（Relation-back doctrine）是允许的。

干扰项排除

为什么其他选项错误？

  • 选项 A (错误)： 认为新被告未及时收到通知。这是基于 Rule 15(c)(1)(C) 的分析。但在本题中，具体的时效法规（Rule 15(c)(1)(A)路径）凌驾于通用的通知要求之上。
  • 选项 B (错误)： 认为时效已过。关联补正原则的核心作用就是让修改后的诉状被视为在时效过期前提交的。
  • 选项 C (不准确)： 虽然“同一交易”是必要条件，但仅凭这一点不足以在变更被告时实现溯及既往（通常还需要通知）。选项 D 更准确地指出了法律机制的名称。
MBE 提分技巧

仔细阅读题目中的法规文本

MBE 题目中有时会给出一个虚构或特定的法规文本（Statute）。

当题目给出具体法规时，不要机械地套用你背诵的联邦规则（如90天通知期）。如果该法规比联邦规则更宽松，根据 Rule 15(c)(1)(A)，应当适用该宽松的法规。

questions.question:
A plaintiff filed a diversity action in federal district court against a defendant. The day after the defendant was served with process, the defendant filed and served an answer.
When must the parties confer to develop a discovery plan?

choices.a: At least 21 days before a scheduling conference is held or a scheduling order is due.
choices.b: At least 30 days before a scheduling conference is held or a scheduling order is due.
choices.c: Within 21 days after the defendant's answer was served.
choices.d: Within 30 days after the defendant's answer was served.

data.questionStem:
Q88222

A plaintiff filed a diversity action in federal district court against a defendant. The day after the defendant was served with process, the defendant filed and served an answer.

When must the parties confer to develop a discovery plan?

一名原告在联邦地区法院对一名被告提起了多元管辖权诉讼。在被告被送达诉讼文件的次日，被告提交并送达了答辩状。

双方当事人必须在何时进行会商以制定证据开示计划？
options:
A. At least 21 days before a scheduling conference is held or a scheduling order is due.
在日程安排会议举行或日程安排令到期前至少21天。

B. At least 30 days before a scheduling conference is held or a scheduling order is due.
在日程安排会议举行或日程安排令到期前至少30天。

C. Within 21 days after the defendant's answer was served.
在被告的答辩状送达后的21天内。

D. Within 30 days after the defendant's answer was served.
在被告的答辩状送达后的30天内。
data.explanation:
Initial conference


(FRCP 26(f))
TimingConfer at least 21 days before scheduling conference is held or scheduling order is due
Conference content
  • Consider basis of claims & defenses
  • Consider settlement possibilities
  • Make or arrange for required disclosures
  • Discuss preservation of discoverable information
  • Develop proposed discovery plan
Discovery plan† content
  • What discovery may be needed
  • Schedule for discovery
  • Modifications to scope of discovery
  • Timing of required disclosures
  • Issues about electronically stored information or privilege
  • Orders court should issue
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure

†Due within 14 days after conference

Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 26(f), the parties must hold an initial conference to plan for discovery. During the conference, the parties should:

  • consider the nature and basis of their claims and defenses
  • consider the possibilities for prompt settlement
  • make or arrange for required disclosures
  • discuss any issues about preserving discoverable information and
  • develop a proposed discovery plan.


The initial conference must be held as soon as practicable, but at least 21 days before a scheduling conference is held or the judge's scheduling order is due (Choice B). If a party fails to confer in good faith, the court may order the party or his/her attorney to pay the opposing party's reasonable expenses, including attorney's fees.

(Choices C & D) A defendant may amend its answer once as a matter of course - ie, without the court's permission or the opposing party's written consent - within 21 days of serving it.

Educational objective: The parties must hold an initial conference to plan for discovery. The conference must be held as soon as practicable and at least 21 days before a scheduling conference with the court is held or the judge's scheduling order is due.

选项正确率统计：A选项 33%（正确选项），B选项 24%，C选项 19%，D选项 21%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

初次会议


(FRCP 26(f))
时间在日程安排会议举行或日程安排令到期前至少21天进行会商
会议内容
  • 考量诉讼请求与抗辩理由的依据
  • 考量和解的可能性
  • 做出或安排必要的披露
  • 讨论可开示信息的保存问题
  • 制定一份拟议的证据开示计划
证据开示计划†内容
  • 可能需要哪些证据开示
  • 证据开示的时间表
  • 对证据开示范围的修改
  • 必要披露的时间安排
  • 关于电子存储信息或特免权的问题
  • 法院应发布的命令
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure

†会议后14天内提交

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第26(f)条 (Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 26(f))，双方当事人必须举行一次初次会议以规划证据开示。在会议期间，双方当事人应：

  • 考量其诉讼请求与抗辩理由的性质和依据
  • 考量迅速和解的可能性
  • 做出或安排必要的披露
  • 讨论关于保存可开示信息的任何问题以及
  • 制定一份拟议的证据开示计划。


初次会议必须在切实可行的情况下尽快举行，但至少要在日程安排会议举行或法官的日程安排令到期前21天举行（选项B）。如果一方当事人未能善意地进行会商，法院可命令该当事人或其律师向对方当事人支付合理的费用，包括律师费。

（选项C和D）被告可以在送达答辩状后的21天内，当然地（即无需法院许可或对方当事人的书面同意）修改其答辩状一次。

教学目标：双方当事人必须举行初次会议以规划证据开示。该会议必须在切实可行的情况下尽快举行，并且至少在与法院举行的日程安排会议或法官的日程安排令到期前21天举行。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 26(f) (initial conference).

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Pretrial Procedures
正确答案 选项 A
在日程安排会议举行或日程安排令到期前至少 21 天。
法律依据 (Legal Basis)

本题考查的是 FRCP 26(f) 会议（即 "Meet and Confer"）的时间要求。

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第 26(f) 条，双方当事人必须在切实可行的情况下尽快进行会商，但至少要在以下两个时间点之一的前 21 天进行：

  1. 日程安排会议 (Scheduling Conference) 举行时；或者
  2. 日程安排令 (Scheduling Order) 根据 FRCP 16(b) 到期应发布时。
时间轴图解 (Timeline)
诉讼开始
原告起诉，被告送达答辩状 (Answer Served)。
截止期限 (Deadline)
FRCP 26(f) 会议
双方必须在此之前会面制定证据开示计划。
⬇ 至少间隔 21 天 ⬇
法院介入
FRCP 16(b) 日程安排会议/命令
(Scheduling Conference / Order)
深度解析 (Analysis)

为什么是 21 天？
法院希望在介入案件管理（发布日程安排令）之前，双方当事人已经充分沟通并达成了一份拟议的证据开示计划 (Discovery Plan)。这 21 天的缓冲期是为了让双方有足够的时间整理会议结果，并在会议后 14 天内向法院提交书面报告。

为什么其他选项是错误的？

  • 选项 C 和 D (答辩状送达后)： 虽然 FRCP 26(f) 要求“尽快”举行，但具体的截止日期是倒推自法院的日程安排会议，而不是顺推自被告的答辩状。答辩状的送达只是触发了诉讼的早期阶段，但不是计算 26(f) 会议截止日的基准点。
  • 选项 B (30 天)： 法律规定的是 21 天，30 天通常用于其他期限（如联邦法院的移除管辖权 Removal，或对证据开示请求的回复期限）。
🎓 MBE 备考锦囊 (Exam Tip) 记忆口诀："21 Days Before the Judge"

在 Civil Procedure 中，关于时间的考点非常多。对于 Discovery Conference (26(f))，请记住它是为了给 Rule 16(b) Scheduling Conference 做准备的。

逻辑链条：
1. 双方见面 (26(f))
2. 提交计划 (见面后14天内)
3. 法官开会 (见面后至少21天)

questions.question:
A manufacturer sued its competitor for patent infringement in a federal district court. On February 1, the manufacturer served the competitor with a summons and complaint. The day after the competitor was served with process, the competitor filed and served an answer. On February 28, the manufacturer delivered to the competitor a request to produce certain documents within the next 15 days. The competitor did not respond to the request for production or produce the requested documents by March 15. As a result, the manufacturer filed a motion to compel a written response to the request for production on April 1, the day after the parties' initial planning conference.
Will the federal court likely grant the manufacturer's motion?

choices.a: No, because a request for production is not permitted less than 30 days after service of process.
choices.b: No, because the competitor's response is not due until 30 days after the initial planning conference.
choices.c: Yes, because the competitor failed to produce the requested documents by the 15-day deadline.
choices.d: Yes, because the competitor's response was due 30 days after the request for production was delivered.

A woman from State A purchased a luxury motorhome online and wired the dealership a deposit for $80,000. The dealership is incorporated and headquartered in State B. When the dealership shipped the motorhome to the woman, she discovered that it failed to meet the contract specifications and refused to accept delivery. The woman then permanently moved to State C.
The woman sued the dealership in a federal court in State C for breach of contract to recover her deposit. The dealership moved to dismiss for lack of personal jurisdiction and improper venue. The court granted the motion on both grounds and dismissed the action.
The woman immediately filed the same breach-of-contract claim in a federal court in State B. The dealership filed a motion to dismiss, arguing that the dismissal of the first action precludes the second action.
Is the court likely to grant the motion?

choices.a: No, because a dismissal does not operate as an adjudication on the merits.
choices.b: No, because the first action was dismissed without prejudice.
choices.c: Yes, because the dealership obtained a court order to dismiss the first action.
choices.d: Yes, because the first action was involuntarily dismissed.

一名来自 A 州的女性在网上购买了一辆豪华房车，并向经销商电汇了 80,000 美元的定金。该经销商在 B 州注册成立，总部也设在 B 州。当经销商将房车运送给该女性时，她发现房车不符合合同规格，因此拒绝接收。之后，该女性永久迁居至 C 州。

该女性以违约为由，在 C 州的联邦法院起诉该经销商，要求返还其定金。经销商以缺乏对人管辖权和审判地不当为由，提出驳回动议。法院基于这两个理由批准了该动议，并驳回了诉讼。

该女性立即在 B 州的联邦法院就同一违约请求提起了诉讼。经销商提出驳回动议，主张第一次诉讼的驳回排除了第二次诉讼。

法院是否可能批准该动议？
options:
A. No, because a dismissal does not operate as an adjudication on the merits.
不会，因为一项驳回并不等同于对案件实体问题的判决。

B. No, because the first action was dismissed without prejudice.
不会，因为第一次诉讼是以无妨碍再诉的方式被驳回的。

C. Yes, because the dealership obtained a court order to dismiss the first action.
会，因为经销商获得了法院命令来驳回第一次诉讼。

D. Yes, because the first action was involuntarily dismissed.
会，因为第一次诉讼属于非自愿驳回。
data.explanation:
Voluntary v. Involuntary dismissal


(FRCP 41)ProcessEffect
Voluntary dismissalπ may dismiss suit without court order when:
  • notice of dismissal filed before ∆ serves answer or summary judgment motion or
  • all parties sign stipulation of dismissal
π may request court order to dismiss suit unless:
  • ∆'s counterclaim cannot be independently adjudicated
Dismissal without prejudice unless:
  • π previously dismissed federal or state action based on same claim or
  • notice or stipulation states otherwise
Involuntary dismissal∆ may move to dismiss suit if π failed to:
  • prosecute own action or
  • comply with rules or court order
∆ may move to dismiss suit via:
  • pre-answer motion
  • judgment on the pleadings or
  • summary judgment
Dismissal with prejudice unless:
  • court order states otherwise or
  • based on lack of jurisdiction, improper venue, or failure to join required party
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure; π = plaintiff; ∆ = defendant.

A suit can be dismissed in two ways:
  • Voluntary dismissal - when the plaintiff moves to dismiss the suit
  • Involuntary dismissal - when the defendant moves to dismiss the suit (as seen here)
An involuntary dismissal generally results in an adjudication on the merits (Choice A). This means that the plaintiff's action is dismissed with prejudice, which precludes the plaintiff from suing the same defendant on the same claim in the future (ie, claim preclusion).

However, an involuntary dismissal based on lack of jurisdiction, improper venue, or failure to join an indispensable party is without prejudice (as seen here). This means that the dismissal is not an adjudication on the merits and does not trigger claim preclusion, so the woman can assert the same claim against the dealership in the State B federal court (Choice D). Therefore, the court will likely deny the dealership's motion to dismiss the second action.

(Choice C) Whether the court entered an order dismissing the action would be relevant in a voluntary dismissal analysis to determine whether the dismissal was with or without prejudice. However, it is irrelevant in an involuntary dismissal analysis because such dismissals always require a court order.

Educational objective: An involuntary dismissal is generally with prejudice, which precludes the plaintiff from suing the same defendant on the same claim in the future. However, an involuntary dismissal based on lack of jurisdiction, improper venue, or failure to join a required party is without prejudice.

选项正确率统计：A选项 39%，B选项 57%（正确选项），C选项 1%，D选项 2%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

自愿撤诉与非自愿驳回


(FRCP 41)程序效力
自愿撤诉原告（π）可在以下情况下未经法院命令撤诉：
  • 在被告（∆）送达答辩状或简易判决动议前提交撤诉通知 或
  • 所有当事方签署撤诉协议
原告可请求法院下令驳回诉讼，除非：
  • 被告的反诉无法独立进行裁决
无妨碍再诉的驳回，除非：
  • 原告先前已就同一请求撤回过联邦或州法院的诉讼 或
  • 通知或协议另有规定
非自愿驳回若原告未能做到以下几点，被告（∆）可动议驳回诉讼：
  • 推进其诉讼 或
  • 遵守规则或法院命令
被告可通过以下方式动议驳回诉讼：
  • 答辩前动议
  • 诉状判决 或
  • 简易判决
有妨碍再诉的驳回，除非：
  • 法院命令另有规定 或
  • 基于缺乏管辖权、审判地不当或未能加入必要当事方
FRCP = 联邦民事诉讼规则 (Federal Rule of Civil Procedure)；π = 原告 (plaintiff)；∆ = 被告 (defendant)。

一项诉讼可以通过两种方式被驳回：
  • 自愿撤诉 - 原告动议撤回诉讼
  • 非自愿驳回 - 被告动议驳回诉讼（如本案所示）
一项非自愿驳回通常构成对案件实体问题的裁决（选项A）。这意味着原告的诉讼是以有妨碍再诉（with prejudice）的方式被驳回，这将排除原告未来就同一请求再次起诉同一被告（即，诉讼主张排除原则）。

然而，基于缺乏管辖权、审判地不当或未能加入不可或缺的当事方而导致的非自愿驳回，是无妨碍再诉的（without prejudice）（如本案所示）。这意味着该驳回并非对案件实体问题的裁决，也不会触发诉讼主张排除原则，因此该女性可以在 B 州的联邦法院对经销商提出相同的诉讼主张（选项D）。因此，法院很可能会驳回经销商对第二次诉讼的驳回动议。

（选项C）法院是否下达驳回诉讼的命令，在分析自愿撤诉时是相关的，因为它能决定该撤诉是“有妨碍再诉”还是“无妨碍再诉”。然而，在分析非自愿驳回时，这一点无关紧要，因为此种驳回总是需要法院的命令。

教学目的：非自愿驳回通常是“有妨碍再诉”的，这会阻止原告未来就同一请求再次起诉同一被告。但是，基于缺乏管辖权、审判地不当或未能加入必要当事方而作出的非自愿驳回，则是“无妨碍再诉”的。

References

  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 41(b) (involuntary dismissal).
  • 9 Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 2373 (4th ed. 2020) (explaining the effect of an involuntary dismissal for lack of jurisdiction, improper venue, or failure to join a required party).

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure | Pretrial Procedures
正确答案：B

法院不会批准驳回动议，因为第一次诉讼是无妨碍再诉 (Without Prejudice) 的驳回。

核心考点：FRCP 41(b)

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第41(b)条，关于非自愿驳回 (Involuntary Dismissal) 的效力：

一般原则：
除非法院命令另有规定，非自愿驳回通常构成对案件实体的裁决 (Adjudication on the Merits)。这意味着它是有妨碍再诉 (With Prejudice) 的，会产生既判力，禁止原告再次起诉。

⚠️ 关键例外 (The Exception)：
以下三种情况的非自愿驳回不构成实体裁决，通常是无妨碍再诉 (Without Prejudice) 的：
  • 缺乏管辖权 (Lack of Jurisdiction)
  • 审判地不当 (Improper Venue)
  • 未能加入必要当事方 (Failure to join a party under Rule 19)
本案逻辑推演
1
第一次驳回的理由：
C州法院驳回案件是基于“缺乏对人管辖权”和“审判地不当”。
2
法律效力判定：
根据 FRCP 41(b) 的例外条款，这种驳回不是对案件实体的裁决 (Not on the merits)。因此，它是无妨碍再诉 (Without Prejudice) 的。
3
既判力 (Res Judicata) 分析：
既判力要求先前的判决必须是“基于实体的终局判决”。由于本案不满足这一要件，第一次驳回不能排除 (Preclude) 第二次诉讼。
为什么不选 A？

选项 A: "No, because a dismissal does not operate as an adjudication on the merits."

这个选项措辞过于绝对且错误。根据 FRCP 41(b)，大多数非自愿驳回（例如因原告未推进诉讼或违反法院命令而被驳回）确实构成实体裁决。

本题之所以不构成实体裁决，是因为它落入了“管辖权/审判地”这个特定例外中，而不是因为“所有的驳回都不构成实体裁决”。因此，选项 B 提供了准确的法律依据。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

看到 Res Judicata (Claim Preclusion) 的题目时，首先检查第一个判决是否是 On the Merits。

记住口诀："Jurisdiction, Venue, Indispensable Parties" —— 这三类驳回只是说“你来错地方了”或“人没找齐”，并没有说“你的案子本身没道理”，所以永远允许换个正确的地方重来。

questions.question:
A woman sued a large company in federal court for violating federal environmental laws. During discovery, the woman's attorney requested that the company produce all electronically stored information (ESI) pertaining to the company's carbon dioxide production but did not specify the form in which this ESI was to be produced. The company provided a written response confirming that it would produce the requested documents.
One month later, the company sent the woman's attorney thousands of documents, emails, spreadsheets, and other files in their ordinarily maintained electronic forms. The attorney did not have the software necessary to access all of the produced ESI, so he sent the company a request for the production of the same ESI that specified the form in which it should be produced. The company refused.
The attorney filed a motion with the federal court to compel the company to produce the ESI again in the specified form.
Is the court likely to grant the motion?

choices.a: No, because the company may choose to produce the ESI in any form.
choices.b: No, because the company produced the ESI in forms in which they are ordinarily maintained.
choices.c: Yes, because the attorney is unable to access the ESI through his software.
choices.d: Yes, because the attorney may specify the form in which the ESI is to be produced.

Q88167

A woman sued a large company in federal court for violating federal environmental laws. During discovery, the woman's attorney requested that the company produce all electronically stored information (ESI) pertaining to the company's carbon dioxide production but did not specify the form in which this ESI was to be produced. The company provided a written response confirming that it would produce the requested documents.

One month later, the company sent the woman's attorney thousands of documents, emails, spreadsheets, and other files in their ordinarily maintained electronic forms. The attorney did not have the software necessary to access all of the produced ESI, so he sent the company a request for the production of the same ESI that specified the form in which it should be produced. The company refused.

The attorney filed a motion with the federal court to compel the company to produce the ESI again in the specified form.

Is the court likely to grant the motion?

一名女性在联邦法院起诉一家大公司，指控其违反联邦环境法。在证据开示（discovery）程序中，该女性的律师要求公司出示所有与公司二氧化碳排放相关的电子存储信息（ESI），但未指明该ESI的出示形式。公司提供了书面答复，确认将出示所要求的文件。

一个月后，公司以其通常维持的电子形式，向该女性的律师发送了数千份文件、电子邮件、电子表格和其他文档。该律师没有必要的软件来访问所有出示的ESI，因此他向公司发出了另一次出示相同ESI的请求，并在其中指明了应有的出示形式。公司拒绝了该请求。

该律师向联邦法院提交了一项动议，请求强制公司以指定形式重新出示该ESI。

法院是否可能批准该动议？
options:
A. No, because the company may choose to produce the ESI in any form.
不会，因为公司可以选择以任何形式出示ESI。

B. No, because the company produced the ESI in forms in which they are ordinarily maintained.
不会，因为公司是以其通常维持的形式出示ESI的。

C. Yes, because the attorney is unable to access the ESI through his software.
会，因为律师无法通过其软件访问ESI。

D. Yes, because the attorney may specify the form in which the ESI is to be produced.
会，因为律师可以指明ESI的出示形式。
data.explanation:
Request for production


(FRCP 34)
Request
  • Must describe each item with reasonable particularity
  • Must specify reasonable time, place & manner of production
  • May specify form in which ESI is to be produced
Response
  • Must state that production or inspection will be permitted as requested OR specify grounds & reasons for objections
  • Due within 30 days of service
Production
  • Must produce documents as kept in usual course of business OR organize & label to correspond to categories in request
  • Must produce ESI in ordinarily maintained or reasonably usable form (if form not specified in request)
  • Need not produce same ESI in more than one form
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure; ESI = electronically stored information

A request for production is a method of discovery used to compel an opposing party to produce and allow inspection of documents, electronically stored information (ESI), tangible things, and real property. Such a request:

  • must describe with reasonable particularity each item to be produced or inspected
  • must specify a reasonable time, place, and manner for the production or inspection and
  • may specify the form in which ESI is to be produced.


If a request for ESI does not specify a form for production, the producing party must produce ESI in its ordinarily maintained or reasonably usable form (Choice A). However, the producing party need not produce the same ESI in more than one form.

Here, the attorney's first request for production did not specify the form in which the ESI was to be produced. As a result, the company properly produced its various ESI in their ordinarily maintained forms. And since the company need not produce the ESI in multiple forms, it does not need to comply with the attorney's second request. Therefore, the court is unlikely to compel production.

(Choice C) The company is not required to reproduce the ESI merely because the attorney cannot access it through his software. That is because the attorney could have specified the form in his original request for production.

(Choice D) The attorney could have specified the form in which the ESI was to be produced in his original request for production - but not after the company produced the ESI in its ordinarily maintained form.

Educational objective: A party requesting production of electronically stored information (ESI) may specify the form in which it is to be produced. If no form is specified, the producing party must produce ESI in its ordinarily maintained or reasonably usable form but need not produce the same ESI in more than one form.

选项正确率统计：A选项 3%，B选项 56%（正确选项），C选项 24%，D选项 16%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

文件出示请求


(FRCP 34)
请求
  • 必须以合理的具体性描述每个项目
  • 必须指明合理的出示时间、地点和方式
  • 可以指明ESI的出示形式
答复
  • 必须声明将按请求允许出示或查阅，或指明反对的根据和理由
  • 送达后30天内到期
出示
  • 必须按照在日常业务过程中保存的方式出示文件，或将其组织并标记以对应请求中的类别
  • 必须以通常维持的或合理可用的形式出示ESI（如果请求中未指明形式）
  • 无需以一种以上形式出示相同的ESI
FRCP = 联邦民事诉讼规则 (Federal Rule of Civil Procedure); ESI = 电子存储信息 (electronically stored information)

文件出示请求是一种证据开示方法，用于强制对方当事人出示并允许查阅文件、电子存储信息（ESI）、有形物和不动产。此类请求：

  • 必须以合理的具体性描述要出示或查阅的每个项目
  • 必须指明合理的出示或查阅时间、地点和方式以及
  • 可以指明ESI的出示形式。


如果对ESI的请求未指明出示形式，则出示方必须以其通常维持的或合理可用的形式出示ESI（选项A）。但是，出示方无需以一种以上形式出示相同的ESI。

在本案中，律师的第一次文件出示请求未指明ESI的出示形式。因此，公司以其通常维持的形式，适当地出示了其各种ESI。并且，由于公司无需以多种形式出示ESI，因此它不需要遵守律师的第二次请求。因此，法院不可能强制其出示。

（选项C） 公司没有义务仅仅因为律师无法通过其软件访问ESI就重新出示。这是因为律师本可以在其最初的文件出示请求中指明形式。

（选项D） 律师本可以在其最初的文件出示请求中指明ESI的出示形式——但在公司以其通常维持的形式出示ESI之后则不能。

教学目标：请求出示电子存储信息（ESI）的一方可以指明其出示形式。如果未指明形式，出示方必须以其通常维持的或合理可用的形式出示ESI，但无需以一种以上形式出示相同的ESI。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 34(b) (requesting & producing electronically stored information).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Discovery & ESI

正确答案：B 法院不会批准动议，因为公司已经按照其“通常维持的形式”出示了电子存储信息（ESI）。
核心考点：FRCP 34(b)

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》(FRCP) 第34条，关于电子存储信息 (ESI) 的出示形式，遵循以下逻辑：

请求方是否指定了 ESI 的格式？
↓ NO (未指定)
出示方必须以以下任一形式出示：
1. 通常维持的形式 (Ordinarily Maintained)
2. 合理可用的形式 (Reasonably Usable)
↓ 关键限制
无需重复出示规则：
出示方不需要以一种以上的形式出示相同的 ESI。
本案分析

1. 律师的失误 (Initial Request)

原告律师在第一次请求中未指定 ESI 的出示形式。这是关键的程序性失误。

2. 公司的合规 (Compliance)

由于未被指定格式，公司选择了以“通常维持的形式” (Ordinarily Maintained Form) 进行出示。这完全符合 FRCP 34 的默认规则。

3. 动议的失败 (Motion to Compel)

律师因为自己软件不兼容而要求重新出示。但法律规定，公司没有义务因为接收方的技术限制而将同一份数据转换格式并再次出示。

为什么其他选项是错的？
  • 选项 A (错)：公司不能随意选择“任何”形式（例如乱码或加密不可读的形式），必须是通常维持或合理可用的。
  • 选项 C (错)：律师无法打开文件是他自己的问题（或应在最初请求中解决），这不能成为强迫被告再次承担出示负担的理由。
  • 选项 D (错)：律师确实可以指定形式，但他必须在最初的请求中指定，而不是在对方已经合规出示后“马后炮”。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

在涉及 Discovery (证据开示) 的题目中，注意区分“权利”的时间点：

请求方有权指定 ESI 格式，但这个权利必须在Request for Production 发出时行使。一旦错过，且对方已按默认规则（Native Format）出示，法院通常不会支持要求重新格式化的 Motion to Compel，除非有特殊理由（如文件不可读/被破坏）。

Reference: Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 34(b)

questions.question:
A man brought a diversity action against a retail store in federal district court for injuries he sustained from a fall in the store. The man alleged that the store allowed its entryway to become slippery from a pipe that leaked water.
Sixty days before trial, the store sent the man its pretrial disclosures, which included a spreadsheet containing the names, addresses, and telephone numbers of the witnesses whom the store expected to testify at trial. Due to a formatting problem, one of the testifying witnesses was omitted from the spreadsheet. The store discovered the omission the following day. Twenty-one days before trial, the store sent the man's attorney an amended spreadsheet containing the testifying witness's information. This was the first time the man's attorney had heard of the testifying witness.
The man's attorney argues that the witness should be excluded from testifying at trial.
Which of the following arguments is most likely to achieve the man's goal of preventing the witness from testifying at trial?

choices.a: The parties did not stipulate that pretrial disclosures could be amended before trial.
choices.b: The store failed to timely correct its pretrial disclosures.
choices.c: The store never obtained the court's leave before correcting its pretrial disclosures.
choices.d: The store's initial pretrial disclosures were untimely filed.

一名男子向联邦地区法院对一家零售店提起跨州诉讼，索赔其在该店内摔倒所受的伤害。该男子声称，该店任由一根漏水的水管导致其入口处变得湿滑。

庭审前六十天，该店向该男子发送了其审前披露材料，其中包括一份电子表格，内含该店预期将在庭审中作证的证人的姓名、地址和电话号码。由于格式问题，其中一位作证证人被从电子表格中遗漏。该店于次日发现了此遗漏。庭审前二十一天，该店向该男子的律师发送了一份修改后的电子表格，其中包含该作证证人的信息。这是该男子的律师首次听说该作证证人。

该男子的律师主张，该证人应被排除在庭审作证之外。

下列哪项主张最有可能实现该男子阻止该证人在庭审中作证的目标？
options:
A. The parties did not stipulate that pretrial disclosures could be amended before trial.
双方当事人并未约定审前披露材料可在庭审前进行修改。

B. The store failed to timely correct its pretrial disclosures.
该店未能及时更正其审前披露材料。

C. The store never obtained the court's leave before correcting its pretrial disclosures.
该店在更正其审前披露材料前，从未获得法院的许可。

D. The store's initial pretrial disclosures were untimely filed.
该店的初始审前披露材料提交不及时。
data.explanation:
Required discovery disclosures (FRCP 26(a))


Initial disclosures
  • Persons with relevant information
  • Items in party's possession that support claim/defense
  • Computation of damages & supporting material
  • Relevant insurance policies
Expert testimony
  • Identity of expert witnesses
  • Expert's written report
  • If no report, subject matter & summary of testimony
Pretrial disclosures
  • Testifying witnesses
  • Deposition testimony to be used at trial
  • Documents/exhibits to be used at trial
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

†Does not apply to evidence used solely for impeachment.

During discovery, certain information must be automatically disclosed through required disclosures. This includes pretrial disclosures, the purpose of which is to avoid surprise at trial regarding substantive evidence. Therefore, pretrial disclosures must, at a minimum, identify the witnesses expected to testify and the evidence expected to be offered at trial.

If a party learns that its disclosures were materially incomplete or incorrect, it must supplement or correct them in a timely manner unless the other parties were made aware of that information during discovery or in writing.† Timeliness is generally evaluated based on how soon the supplemental/corrected information was disclosed after it became available to the disclosing party. Failure to timely supplement generally results in exclusion of the omitted witness or evidence at trial.

Here, the store learned that its pretrial disclosures were materially incomplete because they omitted a testifying witness. The store was required to and did correct those disclosures because the man's attorney had no knowledge of the omission. But waiting nearly 40 days after discovering the mistake before doing so was likely untimely. Therefore, arguing that the correction was untimely will most likely prevent the witness from testifying.

†A party also must supplement or correct any incomplete or incorrect initial disclosures, disclosures of expert testimony, and responses to interrogatories, requests for production, and requests for admission.

(Choices A & C) Neither the court's leave (ie, permission) nor the parties' stipulation is required for a party to supplement or correct its pretrial disclosures.

(Choice D) Pretrial disclosures must be made at least 30 days before trial. Therefore, the store's disclosures were timely submitted 60 days before trial.

Educational objective: A party must timely supplement or correct pretrial disclosures when (1) the party learns that its disclosures were materially incomplete or incorrect and (2) the other parties have not been made aware of the supplemental or corrected information during discovery or in writing.

选项正确率统计：A选项 4%，B选项 74%（正确选项），C选项 14%，D选项 7%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

法定的证据开示披露 (FRCP 26(a))


初始披露
  • 拥有相关信息的人员
  • 当事人持有且支持其主张/抗辩的物品
  • 损害赔偿的计算及支持材料
  • 相关的保险单
专家证言
  • 专家证人的身份
  • 专家的书面报告
  • 若无报告，则提供证言的主题和摘要
审前披露
  • 将要作证的证人
  • 将在庭审中使用的庭外证言
  • 将在庭审中使用的文件/证物
FRCP = 联邦民事诉讼规则。

†不适用于仅用于弹劾证人信誉的证据。

在证据开示程序中，某些信息必须通过法定披露程序自动披露。这包括审前披露，其目的是避免在庭审中就实质性证据出现意外。因此，审前披露必须至少指明预期将作证的证人和预期将在庭审中出示的证据。

如果一方当事人得知其披露存在实质性不完整或不正确，则必须及时地补充或更正，除非其他当事方在证据开示过程中或通过书面形式已得知该信息。† 及时性通常根据披露方在获得补充/更正的信息后多久进行披露来评估。未能及时补充通常会导致被遗漏的证人或证据在庭审中被排除。

在本案中，该店得知其审前披露材料因遗漏一名作证证人而存在实质性不完整。由于该男子的律师对该遗漏毫不知情，该店有义务更正这些披露，并且也确实进行了更正。但是在发现错误后等待了近40天才这样做，很可能是不及时的。因此，主张该更正不及时最有可能阻止该证人作证。

†当事人还必须补充或更正任何不完整或不正确的初始披露、专家证言披露，以及对质询书、文件出示请求和承认请求的答复。

(选项 A & C) 当事人补充或更正其审前披露材料，既不需要法院的许可 (ie, permission)，也不需要各方当事人的约定。

(选项 D) 审前披露必须至少在庭审前30天进行。因此，该店在庭审前60天提交其披露材料是及时的。

教学目标：当事人必须及时补充或更正审前披露材料，如果 (1) 该当事人得知其披露存在实质性不完整或不正确，且 (2) 其他当事方在证据开示过程中或通过书面形式尚未得知该补充或更正的信息。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 26(e) (supplementing disclosures and responses).

8A Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 2049.1 (3d ed. 2020) (explaining a party's duty to supplement or correct initial disclosures, expert testimony, pretrial disclosures, and certain discovery responses).

MBE 考点解析：补充披露的义务

本题考察的核心是联邦民事诉讼规则（FRCP）中关于审前披露（Pretrial Disclosures）以及补充披露义务（Duty to Supplement）的及时性问题。

核心法规：FRCP 26(e)
如果当事人得知其之前的披露或回应在实质上是不完整或不正确的（Incomplete or Incorrect），且该信息尚未被其他当事人知晓，则该当事人必须及时（Timely）补充或更正其披露。

1. 案情时间线分析

要理解为什么被告（商店）会败诉，我们需要画出本案的时间线：

庭审前 60 天
商店提交初始审前披露（符合 FRCP 26(a)(3) 要求的至少提前30天）。
庭审前 59 天 (关键点)
商店发现了遗漏证人的错误。此时商店已知情。
... 拖延了近 40 天 ...
商店持有信息但未通知原告。
庭审前 21 天
商店终于发送了修改后的表格。

2. 为什么选项 B 是正确答案？

选项 B (未能及时更正) 直接击中了问题的要害。

虽然 FRCP 允许当事人补充证据，但前提必须是“及时”（Timely）。商店在发现错误的第二天（庭审前59天）就知道了遗漏，但却无故拖延了近40天，直到庭审前21天才通知原告。

这种拖延剥夺了原告准备庭审、调查该证人的机会（Prejudice）。根据 FRCP 37(c)(1)，如果当事人未能根据 Rule 26(a) 或 (e) 提供信息，除非该失败是合理的（Substantially Justified）或无害的（Harmless），否则该当事人不得在庭审中使用该证人。

3. 为什么其他选项是错误的？

选项 A (未约定修改)：
错误。补充披露是法定义务，不需要双方当事人事先约定（Stipulation）。
选项 C (未获法院许可)：
错误。根据 FRCP 26(e)，当事人有义务自动补充披露，不需要先获得法院的许可（Leave of Court）。
选项 D (初始披露不及时)：
错误。FRCP 26(a)(3) 规定审前披露必须在庭审前至少 30天 进行。商店在庭审前 60 天提交，因此其初始披露是及时的。问题出在后续的“补充”不及时，而不是初始提交不及时。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 在处理 Civil Procedure 的题目时，务必区分“初始行为的合规性”和“后续修正的及时性”。

如果题目中出现“一方发现了错误但等待了 X 天才告诉对方”，这通常是在暗示违反了 Duty to Supplement in a Timely Manner。法院对这种“藏着掖着”（Sandbagging）的行为通常会予以严厉制裁（排除证据）。

questions.question:
A pedestrian was struck and seriously injured by the driver of an automobile while crossing the street. The pedestrian brought a negligence action against the driver in federal court. The driver answered the complaint, contending that the pedestrian's own negligence in darting across the street without looking for oncoming traffic was the cause of the accident. The pedestrian moved for a court order that the driver submit to an examination by an ophthalmologist, alleging that a person with good eyesight would have seen him and avoided the accident. The driver, who did not seek a physical or mental examination of the pedestrian, opposed the motion. The court denied the pedestrian's motion.
Which of the following is the most likely basis for the court's ruling?

choices.a: A request for a mental or physical examination is not a discovery device available to a plaintiff.
choices.b: A physical or mental examination may not be ordered if the party who would be subject to the examination objects.
choices.c: The driver did not seek a physical or mental examination of the pedestrian.
choices.d: The pedestrian's conclusory allegations did not place the driver's eyesight in controversy or constitute a showing of good cause.

questions.question:
A fisherman from State A repeatedly trespassed across a homeowner's property in State B to fish in a publicly owned lake. After one of the fisherman's trips across the homeowner's property, the homeowner discovered that her $80,000 marble statue had been destroyed. The homeowner filed a lawsuit in a federal court in State B to enjoin the fisherman from trespassing and to recover for the damage to her statue.
During discovery, the homeowner interviewed a former friend of the fisherman. The friend said that the fisherman had bragged about trespassing across the homeowner's property and accidently knocking over a marble statue on one occasion. The homeowner expects the fisherman to testify at trial that he did not know he was trespassing and never saw the statue. To impeach the fisherman's anticipated testimony, the homeowner intends to call the friend to testify. The homeowner does not want to disclose the friend's identity to the fisherman.
What is the homeowner's strongest argument to accomplish her goal?

choices.a: The fisherman could have discovered this evidence on his own.
choices.b: The fisherman will have a full and fair opportunity to cross-examine the friend.
choices.c: The friend's testimony will be used solely to impeach the fisherman's testimony.
choices.d: The homeowner's failure to disclose the friend as a witness is harmless.

来自A州的一名渔夫，为了去一个公有湖泊钓鱼，多次侵入B州一名房主的地产。在渔夫某次穿过房主地产后，房主发现她价值8万美元的大理石雕像被毁坏了。

房主在B州的联邦法院提起诉讼，请求禁止渔夫的侵入行为，并就雕像的损害寻求赔偿。在证据开示（discovery）期间，房主询问了渔夫的一位前友人。该友人称，渔夫曾吹嘘自己侵入房主的地产，并在一次偶然中推倒了一座大理石雕像。

房主预计渔夫将在庭审中作证称，他不知道自己侵入了他人地产，也从未见过该雕像。为反驳此证言，房主打算传唤该友人出庭作证。房主不希望向渔夫披露该友人的身份。

为达成其目标，房主最有力的论点是什么？
options:
A. The fisherman could have discovered this evidence on his own.
渔夫本可以自行发现该证据。

B. The fisherman will have a full and fair opportunity to cross-examine the friend.
渔夫将有充分且公正的机会对该友人进行交叉询问。

C. The friend fears that the fisherman may hurt him if he testifies.
该友人担心如果他作证，渔夫可能会伤害他。

D. The friend's testimony will be used solely to impeach the fisherman's testimony.
该友人的证言将仅被用于弹劾渔夫的证言。

FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure

†Does not apply to evidence used solely for impeachment

Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 26(a) requires parties to automatically make initial disclosures, disclosure of expert testimony, and pretrial disclosures. Pretrial disclosures must include:

  • the name, address, and phone number of each witness - separately identifying witnesses expected to testify and those who may be called if the need arises
  • the deposition testimony that will be used at trial and
  • all documents and exhibits - separately identifying items expected to be offered as evidence and those that may be offered if the need arises.


The purpose of pretrial disclosures is to avoid surprises at trial regarding substantive evidence - ie, evidence offered to help prove a material fact or issue. As a result, pretrial disclosures do not apply to impeachment evidence - ie, evidence used solely to discredit a witness and not to prove a material fact or issue. Therefore, the homeowner's strongest argument to avoid disclosing the friend's identity is that his testimony will be used solely to impeach the fisherman's testimony.

(Choices A & B) The fact that the fisherman could have discovered this evidence on his own and will have a full and fair opportunity to cross- examine the friend do not provide grounds for nondisclosure. Instead, the homeowner can withhold the friend's identity only if his testimony will be used solely for impeachment.

(Choice C) If the friend fears that the fisherman may hurt him if he testifies, the friend can obtain a court order that prevents the fisherman from contacting him. If the fisherman violates this order, the court can hold him in contempt of court. But this argument will not allow the homeowner to withhold the friend's identity.

Educational objective: Pretrial disclosures require a party to disclose (1) the name, address, and phone number of each testifying witness, (2) deposition testimony that may be used, and (3) documents and exhibits that will be offered. But these disclosures do not apply to witnesses and evidence that will be used solely for impeachment.

FRCP = 《联邦民事诉讼规则》(Federal Rule of Civil Procedure)

†不适用于仅用于弹劾的证据

《联邦民事诉讼规则》第26条(a)款要求当事人自动进行初步披露、专家证言披露和庭审前披露。庭审前披露必须包括：

  • 每位证人的姓名、地址和电话号码——需分别指明预期将作证的证人和可能根据需要传唤的证人
  • 将在庭审中使用的庭外证言，以及
  • 所有文件和证物——需分别指明预期将作为证据提出的物品和可能根据需要提出的物品。


庭审前披露的目的是为了避免在庭审中出现关于实体证据的意外——即为帮助证明某一重要事实或争议点而提出的证据。因此，庭审前披露不适用于弹劾证据——即仅用于削弱证人可信度，而非用于证明某一重要事实或争议点的证据。因此，房主为避免披露该友人身份的最有力论点是，其证言将仅用于弹劾渔夫的证言。

（选项A和B）渔夫本可以自行发现此证据，以及他将有充分且公正的机会对该友人进行交叉询问，这些事实并不能构成不披露的理由。相反，只有在该友人的证言仅用于弹劾时，房主才能隐匿其身份。

（选项C）如果该友人担心作证后渔夫会伤害他，他可以获取一项禁止渔夫与他接触的法院命令。如果渔夫违反该命令，法院可以裁定他藐视法庭。但这一论点并不能让房主隐匿该友人的身份。

教学目标：庭审前披露要求当事人披露（1）每位作证证人的姓名、地址和电话号码，（2）可能使用的庭外证言，以及（3）将要提出的文件和证物。但这些披露要求不适用于仅用于弹劾的证人和证据。

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure | Pretrial Disclosures
核心规则：FRCP 26(a)(3)

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》(FRCP)，当事人必须在庭审前进行自动披露（Pretrial Disclosures），列出所有预计传唤的证人。

例外情况：如果该证据或证人是仅用于弹劾 (Solely for Impeachment)，则不需要在庭审前披露中列出。

案情逻辑分析

本题中，房主（原告）想隐藏证人（友人）的身份，搞个“突然袭击”。

  • 房主的预期：渔夫会撒谎说他不知道侵入地产，也没见过雕像。
  • 房主的策略：传唤友人出庭，证明渔夫曾吹嘘过此事，从而证明渔夫在撒谎。
  • 法律障碍：通常必须披露证人名单。
  • 突破口：利用“弹劾证据例外”规则。
选项深度解析
选项 D (正确) 该友人的证言将仅被用于弹劾渔夫的证言。
这是房主唯一合法的法律依据。如果房主能成功主张该证人的作用仅仅是为了攻击渔夫证词的可信度（Impeachment），而非为了证明案件的实体事实（Substantive Evidence），那么根据 FRCP 26(a)(3)，她就不需要披露该证人。
选项 A 渔夫本可以自行发现该证据。
这与披露义务无关。披露规则是为了防止庭审突袭，不论对方是否“能够”发现，当事人都必须履行披露义务。
选项 B 渔夫将有充分机会交叉询问。
庭审中的交叉询问机会不能免除庭审前的披露义务。披露是为了让对方准备交叉询问。
选项 C 友人担心被伤害。
如果证人有安全顾虑，正确的程序是申请法院的保护令（Protective Order），而不是单方面决定隐瞒证人身份。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

区分“实体证据”与“弹劾证据”：

  • Substantive Evidence (实体证据)： 用于证明案件要素（如过失、损害）的证据。必须披露。
  • Impeachment Evidence (弹劾证据)： 仅用于证明证人不可信（如撒谎、偏见）的证据。无需在 Pretrial Disclosure 阶段披露。

注意：虽然本题中友人的证言其实也包含了实体内容（承认侵权），但题目问的是“最有力的论点”。在所有选项中，只有 D 引用了一个能豁免披露义务的法律规则。

A woman sued the manufacturer of her hip implant in federal court, claiming that she developed neurological and other health symptoms as a result of her exposure to the implant's material.
During discovery, the woman's attorney hired a doctor as an expert to assess the woman's case. The doctor evaluated the woman, reviewed her medical records, and concluded that the hip implant was not the cause of the woman's symptoms. After sharing this conclusion with the woman's attorney, the doctor was paid for the time spent assessing the woman's case. The woman's attorney did not retain the doctor's services for trial.
The manufacturer's attorney then served a subpoena on the doctor to take her deposition. The woman's attorney moved to quash the subpoena.
How will the court likely rule on the motion?

choices.a: Deny the motion, because the doctor has evidence relevant to the case.
choices.b: Deny the motion, because the woman's attorney hired the doctor as an expert.
choices.c: Grant the motion, because the doctor is not a party in the case.
choices.d: Grant the motion, because the facts known and opinions held by the doctor are privileged.

一名女性在联邦法院起诉其髋关节植入物的制造商，声称因接触植入物的材料而出现了神经系统及其他健康症状。

在证据开示（discovery）程序中，该女性的律师聘请了一名医生作为专家来评估该案。该医生对该女性进行了评估，审阅了她的医疗记录，并得出结论：该髋关节植入物并非导致其症状的原因。在与该女性的律师分享此结论后，医生因评估此案所花费的时间获得了报酬。该女性的律师并未聘请该医生为庭审提供服务。

随后，制造商的律师向该医生送达了传票（subpoena），要求其提供证言录取（deposition）。该女性的律师动议撤销该传票。

法院可能会如何就该动议作出裁决？
options:
A. Deny the motion, because the doctor has evidence relevant to the case.
驳回该动议，因为该医生拥有与本案相关的证据。

B. Deny the motion, because the woman's attorney hired the doctor as an expert.
驳回该动议，因为该女性的律师聘请了该医生作为专家。

C. Grant the motion, because the doctor is not a party in the case.
批准该动议，因为该医生不是本案的当事人。

D. Grant the motion, because the facts known and opinions held by the doctor are privileged.
批准该动议，因为该医生所知悉的事实和持有的意见受特免权保护（privileged）。

Discovery of expert materials


(FRCP 26(b)(4))
Nontestifying expertFacts known or opinions held by expert not discoverable unless:
  • relate to court-ordered physical/mental examination or
  • exceptional circumstances make it impracticable to obtain information by other means
Testifying expertFacts known & opinions held by expert discoverable through deposition. Drafts of expert reports & disclosures not discoverable. Communications between attorney & expert not discoverable unless:
  • relate to expert's compensation or
  • identify facts, data, or assumptions provided by attorney that expert considered in forming opinions
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

Discovery is the pretrial phase of a lawsuit during which the parties can use various methods (eg, depositions) to obtain nonprivileged information that is (1) relevant to any party's claim or defense and (2) proportional to the needs of the case. Information held by an expert witness expected to testify at trial is generally nonprivileged and discoverable. But facts known and opinions held by an expert not expected to testify are privileged and not discoverable unless :
  • that information relates to a court-ordered physical or mental examination or
  • exceptional circumstances make it impracticable to obtain that information by other means - eg, a party dies and cannot be evaluated.

Here, the woman's attorney hired the doctor as an expert to assess the woman's case but not to testify at trial. Since no court-ordered examination took place and no exceptional circumstances exist, the facts known and opinions held by the doctor are privileged and not discoverable. Therefore, the court will likely grant the motion to quash the subpoena (Choice D).

(Choice A) Although the doctor has evidence relevant to the case and favorable to the manufacturer, this evidence is privileged.

(Choice C) The fact that the doctor is not a party does not preclude her from being deposed. That is because a party can depose any party or nonparty to obtain nonprivileged information relevant and proportional to the needs of the case.

Educational objective: The facts known and opinions held by an expert not expected to testify at trial are privileged and not discoverable unless (1) the information relates to a court-ordered physical or mental examination or (2) exceptional circumstances make it impracticable to obtain that information by other means.

选项正确率统计：A选项 32%，B选项 14%，C选项 7%，D选项 45%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

专家材料的证据开示


(FRCP 26(b)(4))
不出庭作证的专家专家所知悉的事实或持有的意见不可被开示，除非：
  • 与法院指令的身体/精神检查相关，或
  • 存在特殊情况，导致通过其他方式获取信息不切实际
出庭作证的专家专家所知悉的事实和持有的意见可通过证言录取程序被开示。专家报告和披露文件的草稿不可被开示。律师与专家之间的交流不可被开示，除非：
  • 与专家的报酬相关，或
  • 识别由律师提供、且专家在形成意见时已考量的事实、数据或假设
FRCP = 《联邦民事诉讼规则》（Federal Rule of Civil Procedure）。

证据开示（Discovery）是诉讼的审前阶段，在此阶段，各方当事人可使用多种方法（如，证言录取）来获取不受特免权保护的信息，这些信息须 (1) 与任何一方当事人的诉请或抗辩相关，且 (2) 与案件的需求成比例。预计将在庭审中作证的专家证人所持有的信息通常不受特免权保护且可被开示。但是，预计不会作证的专家所知悉的事实和持有的意见则受特免权保护且不可被开示，除非：
  • 该信息与法院指令的身体或精神检查相关，或
  • 存在特殊情况，导致通过其他方式获取该信息不切实际——例如，某一方当事人死亡且无法被评估。

在本案中，该女性的律师聘请医生作为专家来评估案件，但并未计划让其在庭审中作证。由于不存在法院指令的检查，也不存在特殊情况，该医生所知悉的事实和持有的意见受特免权保护且不可被开示。因此，法院可能会批准撤销传票的动议（选项 D）。

（选项 A）尽管该医生拥有与本案相关且对制造商有利的证据，但该证据受特免权保护。

（选项 C）该医生不是当事人这一事实，并不妨碍其被要求提供证言录取。这是因为一方当事人可以要求任何当事人或非当事人提供证言录取，以获取与案件需求相关且成比例的不受特免权保护的信息。

教学目标：预计不会在庭审中作证的专家所知悉的事实和持有的意见受特免权保护且不可被开示，除非 (1) 该信息与法院指令的身体或精神检查相关，或 (2) 存在特殊情况，导致通过其他方式获取该信息不切实际。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 26(b)(4) (discovery of expert witnesses).

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure / Discovery
核心规则：FRCP 26(b)(4)

在联邦民事诉讼中，关于专家证人（Expert Witnesses）的证据开示（Discovery）有一个关键区分：

  • 出庭专家 (Testifying Expert)： 对方可以对其进行取证（Deposition）。
  • 不出庭/咨询专家 (Non-testifying / Consulting Expert)： 其意见通常受保护，不可开示。
案情逻辑分析

本题考察的是对不出庭专家的保护规则。

1. 角色定位：
原告律师聘请医生是为了评估案件（assess the case），并且明确决定不让该医生出庭作证（did not retain... for trial）。因此，该医生属于“咨询专家”（Consulting Expert）。

2. 法律后果：
根据 FRCP 26(b)(4)(D)，一方当事人不得通过询问或证言录取（Deposition）的方式，获取咨询专家所知悉的事实或持有的观点。

3. 唯一的例外（Exceptional Circumstances）：
只有在极少数情况下（例如：证据已被销毁，无法通过其他途径获取同类事实），法院才会允许开示。本题中，被告（制造商）完全可以聘请自己的专家去评估该植入物材料，不存在无法获取信息的特殊情况。

专家类型 证据开示规则
出庭作证专家
Testifying Expert		 ✅ 允许
对方有权通过 Deposition 了解其观点，为交叉盘问做准备。
不出庭/咨询专家
Non-testifying Expert		 ❌ 禁止
受特权保护（Privileged/Work Product），除非有特殊情况。
✅ 正确答案：选项 D

法院会批准撤销传票的动议。

因为该医生是专门受聘用于诉讼准备且不打算出庭作证的专家，其持有的事实和观点受规则保护（Privileged in the context of discovery rules），被告无权对其进行取证。

为什么其他选项是错的？
  • 选项 A (相关性)： 错误。虽然证据是“相关的” (Relevant)，但相关性不能凌驾于特权（Privilege）或工作成果保护之上。
  • 选项 B (聘用关系)： 理由不充分。仅仅“聘用”不是理由，关键在于是否“计划出庭作证”。如果是出庭专家，即使是被聘用的，也可以被取证。
  • 选项 C (非当事人)： 错误。非当事人 (Non-party) 通常可以通过传票被要求提供证言，本案被阻止的唯一原因是其“咨询专家”的特殊身份，而非非当事人身份。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧

看到“专家”题目时，第一步先判断：他会出庭吗？(Is he expected to testify?)

如果题目说 "retained for trial" -> 可开示。
如果题目说 "retained to assess/consult" 且 "not for trial" -> 不可开示（除非有特殊例外）。

A man filed a class action in federal court against an insurance company on behalf of thousands of individuals nationwide. The complaint asserted that the insurance company denied these individuals' legitimate claims pursuant to a company policy that violates federal law. The insurance company denied the allegations.
After the parties held an initial planning conference, the man served the insurance company with 25 interrogatories. One of the interrogatories asked the company to list its net profits over the past five years. The interrogatories stated that they were to be answered within 30 days after service.
What is the insurance company's best response to the interrogatory about its net profits?

choices.a: Serve an objection on the ground that interrogatories may only be served on individuals, not companies.
choices.b: Serve an objection on the ground that the interrogatories exceed the number allowed without permission from the court or an agreement between the parties.
choices.c: Serve an answer identifying the specific documents that contain information about the company's net profits and provide the man's attorney an opportunity to inspect and copy those documents.
choices.d: Serve an answer identifying the specific documents that contain information about the company's net profits and provide the man's attorney an opportunity to inspect, but not copy, those documents.

The complaint asserted that the insurance company denied these individuals' legitimate claims pursuant to a company policy that violates federal law. The insurance company denied the allegations.

What is the insurance company's best response to the interrogatory about its net profits?

一名男子代表全国数千名个人，在联邦法院对一家保险公司提起了集体诉讼。起诉状声称，该保险公司依据一项违反联邦法律的公司政策，拒绝了这些个人的合法索赔。保险公司否认了这些指控。

在双方举行了初步规划会议后，该男子向保险公司送达了25份书面质询。其中一份书面质询要求该公司列出其过去五年的净利润。书面质询中声明，应在送达后30天内作出答复。

对于这份关于其净利润的书面质询，保险公司的最佳回应是什么？
options:
A. Serve an objection on the ground that interrogatories may only be served on individuals, not companies.
以书面质询只能送达给个人，而不能送达给公司为由，提出异议。

B. Serve an objection on the ground that the interrogatories exceed the number allowed without permission from the court or an agreement between the parties.
以书面质询的数量超过了未经法院许可或双方协议所允许的数量为由，提出异议。

C. Serve an answer identifying the specific documents that contain information about the company's net profits and provide the man's attorney an opportunity to inspect and copy those documents.
送达一份答复，指明包含公司净利润信息的具体文件，并为该男子的律师提供检查和复制这些文件的机会。

D. Serve an answer identifying the specific documents that contain information about the company's net profits and provide the man's attorney an opportunity to inspect, but not copy, those documents.
送达一份答复，指明包含公司净利润信息的具体文件，并为该男子的律师提供检查但不复制这些文件的机会。

Interrogatories (FRCP 33)


QuestionsWritten questions that inquire about facts, opinions & contentions within scope of discovery. Limit of 25 interrogatories unless stipulated by parties or ordered by court.
ResponsesMust answer each interrogatory fully & separately in writing, under oath & signed by responding party. Objections must be specific & signed by responding party's attorney. Due within 30 days of service.
Production of recordsMay answer by specifying business records from which answer may be derived if: burden of deriving answers is substantially same for interrogating & responding party and responding party allows interrogating party to examine & copy records.
FRCP = Federal Rule of Procedure.

Interrogatories are a method of discovery in which one party serves another party with written questions that inquire about facts, opinions, and contentions within the scope of discovery. The responding party must serve answers within 30 days after being served with the interrogatories.† The responding party may also answer an interrogatory by specifying business records from which the answer may be derived if :
  • the burden of deriving the answer is substantially the same for the interrogating or responding party and
  • the responding party provides the interrogating party with an opportunity to examine and copy such records.


Here, one of the man's interrogatories asked the insurance company to list its net profits over the past five years, which can easily be derived from the company's business records. As a result, the company can respond by (1) serving an answer identifying the specific documents that contain this information and (2) providing the man's attorney an opportunity to inspect and copy those documents.

†The parties may stipulate, or the court may order, a shorter or longer time to respond.

(Choice A) Interrogatories may be served on companies that are parties to the suit. Interrogatories served on a corporation, partnership, association, or government entity must be answered by an officer or agent.

(Choice B) A party may serve up to 25 interrogatories on any other party without the court's permission or an agreement between the parties (as seen here).

(Choice D) The company must provide the man's attorney an opportunity to inspect and copy the documents that contain the information about the company's net profits.

Educational objective: A party may respond to an interrogatory by specifying business records from which the answer may be derived if (1) the burden of deriving the answer is substantially the same for the interrogating or responding party and (2) the responding party provides the interrogating party with an opportunity to examine and copy such records.

选项正确率统计：A选项 4%，B选项 12%，C选项 55%（正确选项），D选项 27%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

书面质询 (FRCP 33)


问题在证据开示范围内，就事实、意见和争点进行询问的书面问题。除非双方约定或法院命令，否则书面质询的数量限制为25份。
答复必须以书面形式，在宣誓后，由答复方签署，对每项书面质询进行全面且独立的回答。异议必须具体，并由答复方的律师签署。应在送达后30天内作出。
记录的出示在以下情况下，可以通过指明可从中获取答案的商业记录来作答：如果获取答案的负担对于质询方和答复方而言基本相同，并且答复方允许质询方检查和复制这些记录。
FRCP = Federal Rule of Procedure (联邦民事诉讼规则)。

书面质询是一种证据开示方法，即一方当事人向另一方当事人送达书面问题，以询问证据开示范围内的相关事实、意见和争点。答复方必须在收到书面质询送达后的30天内送达答复。† 答复方也可以通过指明可从中获取答案的商业记录来回答书面质询，如果：
  • 获取答案的负担对于质询方或答复方而言基本相同，并且
  • 答复方为质询方提供了检查和复制此类记录的机会。


在本案中，该男子的其中一份书面质询要求保险公司列出其过去五年的净利润，这一信息可以轻易地从公司的商业记录中获取。因此，该公司可以通过以下方式回应：(1) 送达一份答复，指明包含该信息的具体文件；以及 (2) 为该男子的律师提供检查和复制这些文件的机会。

†双方可以约定，或法院可以命令，一个更短或更长的答复时间。

(选项A) 书面质询可以送达给作为诉讼当事方的公司。送达给公司、合伙企业、协会或政府实体的书面质询必须由其高级职员或代理人回答。

(选项B) 未经法院许可或双方协议，一方当事人可向任何其他当事人送达最多25份书面质询（如此案所示）。

(选项D) 公司必须为该男子的律师提供检查并复制包含公司净利润信息的文件的机会。

教学目的：一方当事人可以通过指明可从中获取答案的商业记录来回应书面质询，前提是 (1) 获取答案的负担对于质询方或答复方而言基本相同，并且 (2) 答复方为质询方提供了检查和复制此类记录的机会。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 33 (interrogatories).

MBE 考点解析

民事诉讼法 (Civil Procedure)
核心考点：FRCP 33(d)

出示商业记录的选择权 (Option to Produce Business Records)

当书面质询 (Interrogatory) 的答案可以从一方的商业记录中推导出来，且对于双方而言，推导答案的负担基本相同 (Burden is substantially the same) 时，答复方可以选择：

  1. 指明具体的记录 (Specify the records)；并且
  2. 给予质询方检查和复制 (Examine and Copy) 这些记录的合理机会。
题目解析

本题考察的是被告在面对关于财务数据（如净利润）的书面质询时，如何利用 FRCP 33(d) 进行合规且省力的回应。

为何选项 C 是最佳答案？

计算过去五年的净利润通常需要查阅大量的财务报表。根据 FRCP 33(d)：

  • 负担转移：如果让原告律师自己去查账算出利润的难度，与被告公司自己去算的难度差不多，被告可以直接把账本交出来。
  • 关键条件：被告必须指明具体文件，并且必须允许原告“检查和复制” (Inspect and Copy)。选项 C 完美符合这一规则。
干扰项排除
选项 A 错误：
书面质询可以送达给任何当事人 (Party)，包括公司 (Corporation)。公司需指定代理人或官员作答。
选项 B 错误：
FRCP 33(a)(1) 规定的书面质询上限正是 25 个。题目中原告正好送达了 25 个，并未超标，因此不能以此为由提出异议。
选项 D 错误：
这是一个典型的细节陷阱。选项 D 仅允许“检查”但不允许“复制”。FRCP 33(d)(2) 明确要求必须提供复制 (Copy) 的机会。不让复印会让原告的取证负担变得不合理地重。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 证据开示 (Discovery) 的题目中，注意以下数字和关键词：

  • 25：未经许可的书面质询上限。
  • 30天：通常的答复期限。
  • Business Records Option：如果题目涉及从大量文件中提取数据，寻找包含“指明文件 (Specify records)” + “允许复制 (Allow copying)” 的选项。只让看不让复印通常是错误的。

一个交响乐团原定在10天后的一场音乐会上演奏一位著名作曲家的音乐。在与交响乐团的指挥发生争执后，该作曲家告知指挥，他不能再使用她的歌曲。指挥表示他将按计划继续举办音乐会。

该作曲家向联邦地区法院对指挥和交响乐团提起了经核实的诉状，指控其侵犯版权。该作曲家还申请了临时限制令（TRO），以阻止音乐会的进行。该作曲家未向被告方发出通知，但主张法院应立即签发单方临时限制令。

联邦地区法院将可能如何裁定该作曲家的申请？
options:
A. Deny the motion, because notice must be given to an opposing party before a court may issue a TRO.
驳回申请，因为在法院签发临时限制令之前，必须向对方当事人发出通知。

B. Deny the motion, because the songwriter's attorney failed to certify in writing why the defendants need not be notified.
驳回申请，因为作曲家的律师未能以书面形式证明为何无需通知被告方。

C. Grant the motion, because an ex parte TRO is justified under the circumstances.
批准申请，因为在此情况下，签订单方临时限制令是合理的。

D. Grant the motion, because federal courts have exclusive jurisdiction over claims based on copyright infringement.
批准申请，因为联邦法院对基于版权侵权的诉求拥有专属管辖权。

Preliminary relief (FRCP 65)


TypeRequired contentsEffect
Preliminary injunction
  • Notice of hearing
  • State reasons issued
  • Reasonably describe acts restrained or required
  • Specify terms
Persons bound upon receiving actual notice of order:
  • parties to the case
  • parties' officers, agents, employees & attorneys
  • anyone in active concert/participation with above persons
Temporary restraining order Ex parte (no notice)Above requirements plus:
  • date & hour issued
  • why injury is irreparable
  • why issued without notice
  • promptly filed with clerk & entered into record
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

A temporary restraining order (TRO) is a court order that commands a party to do or stop doing a specified action for 14 days or until a preliminary-injunction hearing can take place - whichever occurs first. This preserves the parties' status quo until the court can fully consider the issue at a hearing. Unlike a preliminary injunction, a TRO may be issued without notice to the nonmovant (ie, ex parte). But to prevent abuse and protect the rights of all involved, a federal court can issue an ex parte TRO only if:
  • the movant files an affidavit or verified complaint containing specific facts showing that he/she will suffer immediate and irreparable harm before the nonmovant can be heard and
  • the movant's attorney certifies in writing any efforts made to give notice and the reasons why notice should not be required (Choice A).†
Here, even if the songwriter's verified complaint specifically shows that she will suffer immediate and irreparable harm, the songwriter's attorney failed to certify in writing why the defendants need not be notified. As a result, an ex parte TRO is not justified under the circumstances, and the court will likely deny the songwriter's motion (Choice C).

†Additionally, a federal court will issue a preliminary injunction or TRO only if the movant provides security (eg, a bond) sufficient to pay the costs and damages if the nonmovant is improperly restrained.

(Choice D) Although federal courts have exclusive jurisdiction over copyright infringement claims, this does not provide a basis to grant a TRO.

Educational objective: A temporary restraining order can be issued without notice only if (1) the movant files an affidavit or verified complaint that specifically shows he/she will suffer immediate and irreparable harm and (2) the movant's attorney certifies in writing any efforts made to give notice and why notice is not required.

选项正确率统计：A选项 10%，B选项 54%（正确选项），C选项 33%，D选项 1%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

初步济助 (FRCP 65)


类型必要内容效力
初步禁令
  • 听证通知
  • 陈述签发理由
  • 合理描述被限制或要求的行为
  • 明确条款
在收到命令的实际通知后受其约束的人员：
  • 案件的当事人
  • 当事人的高级职员、代理人、雇员和律师
  • 与上述人员共同积极行动/参与的任何人
临时限制令 单方（无通知）除上述要求外，还需：
  • 签发的日期和小时
  • 损害为何是不可弥补的
  • 为何在未通知的情况下签发
  • 立即提交给书记官并计入卷宗
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (《联邦民事诉讼规则》)。

临时限制令 (TRO) 是一种法院命令，指令一方当事人在14天内或在初步禁令听证会召开前（以二者中较早者为准）作为或停止作为特定行为。这可以在法院通过听证会充分审议该问题之前维持当事人的现状。与初步禁令不同，临时限制令可以在未通知非申请方的情况下签发（即单方面签发）。但为防止滥用并保护所有相关方的权利，联邦法院只有在以下情况下才能签订单方临时限制令：
  • 申请人提交一份宣誓书或经核实的诉状，其中包含具体事实，表明其在非申请方有机会陈述意见前，将遭受即时且不可弥补的损害，并且
  • 申请人的律师以书面形式证明其为发出通知所做的任何努力，以及为何不应要求发出通知的理由（选项A）。†
在本案中，即使作曲家经核实的诉状明确显示她将遭受即时且不可弥补的损害，但作曲家的律师未能以书面形式证明为何无需通知被告方。因此，在这种情况下，签订单方临时限制令是不合理的，法院可能会驳回作曲家的申请（选项C）。

†此外，只有在申请人提供保证金（例如，保证书），足以在非申请方受到不当限制时支付其费用和损害赔偿的情况下，联邦法院才会签发初步禁令或临时限制令。

（选项D）尽管联邦法院对版权侵权诉求拥有专属管辖权，但这并不构成批准临时限制令的依据。

教学目标： 只有在以下情况下，才能在未通知的情况下签发临时限制令：（1）申请人提交一份宣誓书或经核实的诉状，其中明确显示其将遭受即时且不可弥补的损害，并且（2）申请人的律师以书面形式证明为发出通知所做的任何努力以及为何不需要发出通知的理由。

References

  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 65(b) (requirements for an ex parte TRO).
  • 11A Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 2952 (3d ed. 2020) (explaining the process for issuing an ex parte TRO).

MBE 考点解析

民事诉讼法 (Civil Procedure)
正确答案
选项 B：驳回申请，因为作曲家的律师未能以书面形式证明为何无需通知被告方。
核心考点：单方临时限制令 (Ex Parte TRO)
本题考查的是《联邦民事诉讼规则》第65条 (FRCP 65) 关于在未通知对方当事人的情况下签发临时限制令 (Temporary Restraining Order, TRO) 的严格程序要求。
FRCP 65(b)(1) 规定：
法院仅在满足以下两个条件时，方可在未书面或口头通知对方当事人的情况下签发 TRO：
  1. 实质要件：通过宣誓书 (Affidavit) 或经核实的诉状 (Verified Complaint) 证明，若不立即签发命令，申请人将在对方被听审前遭受即时且不可弥补的损害 (Immediate and irreparable injury)；
    以及 (AND)
  2. 程序要件：申请人的律师必须书面证明 (Certifies in writing) 其为通知对方所做的努力（如有），以及为何不应要求通知 (Why notice should not be required) 的理由。
案情分析
在本案中，作曲家虽然提交了“经核实的诉状”并可能证明了版权侵权会带来不可弥补的损害（满足了第一个条件），但题目明确指出：

“该作曲家未向被告方发出通知，但主张法院应立即签发单方临时限制令。”

关键的缺失在于：作曲家的律师没有提交书面证明来解释为什么不需要通知被告。

由于 Ex parte（单方）程序剥夺了被告的听审权，法院对此类申请极其谨慎。如果没有律师的书面证明解释为何通知是不可能的或会适得其反（例如，通知会导致被告销毁证据），法院必须驳回申请。
干扰项解析
选项 A 错误 虽然通常需要通知，但这并非绝对。法律允许在特定紧急情况下签发无通知的 TRO，前提是满足上述严格条件。因此说“必须发出通知”过于绝对。
选项 C 错误 即使情况紧急，如果程序要件（律师的书面证明）缺失，法院也不能批准单方 TRO。程序正义在联邦法院中至关重要。
选项 D 错误 专属管辖权 (Exclusive Jurisdiction) 仅意味着案件必须在联邦法院审理，但这并不自动赋予原告获得特定禁令救济 (Injunctive Relief) 的权利。原告仍需满足 TRO 的具体签发标准。
💡 MBE 备考技巧
遇到涉及 TRO (临时限制令) 的题目时，请立即检查是否涉及“通知”(Notice)：
  • 如果是初步禁令 (Preliminary Injunction)：必须通知对方并举行听证会。
  • 如果是TRO：通常需要通知，但可以豁免。若题目说“未通知”(No notice)，必须寻找两个要素：(1) 宣誓过的即时损害证据 + (2) 律师关于为何不通知的书面解释。缺一不可。

A customer brought a federal diversity action against a corporation. During discovery, the customer requested information that was stored on hard drives at the corporation's headquarters. The corporation informed the customer that the hard drives had been wiped clean when the corporation switched over to a new information technology firm a few months before the customer filed suit. The customer moved for sanctions.
After a hearing, the court found that the corporation negligently failed to preserve the information contained in the hard drives, but that the corporation did not act intentionally to prevent the customer from accessing the information. The court also found that the information cannot be obtained by any other means and that the loss of this information prejudices the customer's claim.
Based on those findings, what action should the court take?

choices.a: Enter a default judgment in favor of the customer.
choices.b: Instruct the jury at trial that it must presume that the lost information was unfavorable to the corporation.
choices.c: Permit the parties to present evidence at trial regarding the loss of information.
choices.d: Prohibit the corporation from seeking discovery in the lawsuit to put the parties at a similar disadvantage.

一位客户对一家公司提起了联邦多元管辖权诉讼。在证据开示期间，客户要求获取存储在公司总部硬盘上的信息。公司告知客户，在客户提起诉讼前几个月，公司更换了新的信息技术公司，届时硬盘已被清空。客户动议要求制裁。

经过听证，法院认定公司因过失未能保存硬盘中包含的信息，但公司并非为了阻止客户获取信息而故意为之。法院还认定，该信息无法通过任何其他方式获得，且该信息的丢失对客户的诉讼主张造成了损害。

基于这些认定，法院应采取何种措施？
options:
A. Enter a default judgment in favor of the customer.
做出对客户有利的缺席判决。

B. Instruct the jury at trial that it must presume that the lost information was unfavorable to the corporation.
在审判中指示陪审团，必须推定丢失的信息对公司不利。

C. Permit the parties to present evidence at trial regarding the loss of information.
允许双方在审判中就信息丢失一事提交证据。

D. Prohibit the corporation from seeking discovery in the lawsuit to put the parties at a similar disadvantage.
禁止公司在诉讼中进行证据开示，以使双方处于类似的不利地位。
data.explanation:
Sanctions may be appropriate if a party failed to preserve electronically stored information (ESI) that:
  • should have been preserved in the anticipation or conduct of litigation
  • is lost because the party failed to take reasonable steps to preserve it and
  • cannot be replaced or restored through additional discovery.


If the court finds that the party intentionally deprived the requesting party of the ESI, the court may:
  • presume that the lost ESI was unfavorable to the party that failed to preserve it
  • instruct the jury that it may or must presume the lost ESI was unfavorable to that party (Choice B) or
  • dismiss the action or enter a default judgment against that party (Choice A).


These sanctions are not available here because the corporation acted negligently - not intentionally. As a result, the court should only order measures that are no greater than necessary to cure the prejudice caused to the customer - eg, allow the parties to present evidence at trial regarding the loss of the ESI.

(Choice D) It is unlikely that a court would prohibit a party from seeking discovery as a form of sanction as that would frustrate the purpose of discovery - ie, to uncover facts, narrow the issues in dispute, and otherwise prepare both parties for trial.

Educational objective: A court may order measures no greater than necessary to cure prejudice caused by a party's failure to preserve electronically stored information that (1) should have been preserved in the anticipation or conduct of litigation, (2) is lost because the party failed to take reasonable steps to preserve it, and (3) cannot be replaced or restored.



选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 41%，C选项 52%（正确选项），D选项 5%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

如果一方当事人未能保存电子存储信息（ESI），且该信息符合以下情况，则制裁可能是适当的：
  • 在预期或进行诉讼时本应被保存
  • 因该方当事人未能采取合理措施进行保存而丢失并且
  • 无法通过额外的证据开示来替代或恢复。


如果法院认定一方当事人故意剥夺了请求方获取ESI的权利，法院可以：
  • 推定丢失的ESI对未保存方不利
  • 指示陪审团，其可以或必须推定丢失的ESI对该方不利（选项B）或
  • 驳回诉讼或对该方当事人做出缺席判决（选项A）。


在此案中，这些制裁措施不适用，因为公司行为是过失而非故意。因此，法院只应下令采取不超过纠正对客户造成的损害所必需的措施——例如，允许双方在审判中就ESI的丢失提交证据。

（选项D）法院不大可能将禁止一方当事人进行证据开示作为一种制裁形式，因为这会妨碍证据开示的目的——即，发现事实、缩小争议焦点，并为双方审判做准备。

教学目的：如果一方当事人未能保存电子存储信息，且该信息(1)本应在预期或进行诉讼时被保存，(2)因该方当事人未能采取合理措施保存而丢失，以及(3)无法被替代或恢复，法院可以下令采取不超过纠正由此造成的损害所必需的措施。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 37(e) (failure to preserve electronically stored information).
