MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Joinder of Parties

正确答案：B 法院不会批准驳回动议，因为医生并非本案的必要当事人 (Required Party)。
⚖️ 核心法律规则 (FRCP 19)

本题考察的是《联邦民事诉讼规则》第19条关于必要当事人 (Required Joinder of Parties) 的认定。判断一个缺席方是否“必要”，主要看三点：

  • 如果没有该方，法院能否给予现有当事人完全救济 (Complete Relief)？
  • 该方的缺席是否会损害其自身的利益？
  • 该方的缺席是否会让现有当事人面临双重或不一致的责任 (Double or Inconsistent Obligations)？
🔍 深度解析：连带责任与共同侵权

本题的关键在于被告（公司）声称医生是共同侵权人 (Joint Tortfeasor) 并承担连带责任 (Joint and Several Liability)。

1
最高法院判例规则：
根据 Temple v. Synthes Corp. 案，共同侵权人（Joint Tortfeasors）从来都不是 Rule 19 下的必要当事人。
2
原告的权利：
在连带责任下，原告有权选择起诉任何一个或所有有责任的被告。原告可以只起诉公司并获得全额赔偿（25万美元）。因此，即使没有医生，原告也能获得“完全救济”。
3
被告的救济途径：
如果公司认为医生也有责任，公司不应申请驳回起诉，而应该使用第三方诉讼 (Impleader / Rule 14) 将医生作为第三方被告引入，要求其分摊赔偿 (Contribution)。但公司不能强迫原告直接起诉医生。
❌ 为什么其他选项错误

选项 A & C (错误)：
Rule 19 的分析是分步骤的。只有当缺席方首先被认定为“必要当事人”时，法院才会考虑“可行性 (Feasibility)”或“公平性 (Equity)”。既然医生根本不是必要当事人，后续步骤无需考虑。

选项 D (错误)：
虽然“未加入必要当事人”确实可以在答辩前动议 (Pre-answer motion) 中提出，但这只是程序上的允许，并不改变实体法律结论——即医生本身并非必要当事人。

💡 MBE 考试技巧
看到 "Joint and Several Liability" (连带责任) 和 "Motion to Dismiss for Failure to Join" (因未加入当事人申请驳回) 同时出现时，答案通常是驳回动议会被拒绝 (Motion Denied)。

记住：共同侵权人 (Joint Tortfeasors) 仅仅是允许合并 (Permissive) 的当事人，而非必要 (Required) 的当事人。

A mail clerk domiciled in State A slipped and fell on ice that had formed near the loading dock of the building in State B where the clerk's State B employer leased space for its headquarters. The building was owned and operated by a State C corporation. As a result of the fall, the clerk was injured and the employer's expensive computer he was carrying was badly damaged.
The clerk sued the building owner for negligence in a federal district court in State B, seeking $100,000 in personal-injury damages. The employer has filed a timely motion to intervene, asserting an $80,000 negligence claim against the building owner for the damage to its computer.
Is the court likely to grant the employer's motion to intervene?

choices.a: No, because although the employer has an interest in the clerk's action, that interest is not likely to be impaired in the employer's absence.
choices.b: No, because the clerk chose not to join the employer as a co-plaintiff in his action.
choices.c: Yes, because the employer is an indispensable party.
choices.d: Yes, because the employer's claim shares common questions of law and fact with the clerk's action.

data.explanation:
Intervention
(FRCP 24)


Intervention of right
  • On timely motion, court must permit intervention when either:
    • nonparty's interest in case not adequately represented by existing parties & deciding case may impair nonparty's ability to protect that interest
    • federal statute gives unconditional right to intervene
Permissive intervention
  • On timely motion, court may permit intervention when either:
    • nonparty's claim or defense shares common question of law or fact with main action
    • federal statute gives conditional right to intervene
  • Court must consider whether intervention will unduly delay or prejudice adjudication of original parties' rights

FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

A nonparty can join a case to protect his/her interest by timely filing a motion to intervene under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (FRCP) 24. There are two types of intervention:

  • Intervention of right – the court must permit an intervention when (1) the nonparty's interest is inadequately represented by the existing parties and (2) deciding the case may impair the nonparty's ability to protect that interest.
  • Permissive intervention – the court may permit an intervention when the nonparty's claim or defense shares a common question of law or fact with the main action. But a court may deny permissive intervention if it would unduly delay or prejudice the adjudication of the original parties' rights.

Here, the employer timely moved to intervene in the clerk's action against the building owner. Although the employer's interest (property-damage claim) is inadequately represented by the existing parties, deciding the clerk's personal-injury action is not likely to impair the employer's ability to protect its interest (no intervention of right). But since both actions are based on the owner's alleged negligence (common questions of law and fact), the court will likely allow the employer to permissively intervene (Choice D).

To determine if a motion to intervene is timely filed, the court considers (1) the length of time the movant knew or should have known about its threatened interest, (2) the prejudice to the parties if intervention is permitted, and (3) the prejudice to the movant if intervention is denied.

(Choice B) The clerk's decision to exclude the employer as a co-plaintiff does not affect the employer's ability to intervene.

(Choice C) Under FRCP 19, an indispensable party must be joined in a lawsuit. But the employer is not an indispensable party because the employer's absence would not affect the court's ability to provide relief to the clerk or the employer's ability to protect its related property interest.

Educational objective:
Intervention must be permitted when the nonparty's interest is inadequately represented and deciding the case may impair his/her ability to protect that interest (ie, intervention of right). And intervention may be permitted when the nonparty's claim or defense shares a common question with the main action (ie, permissive intervention).



参加诉讼
（联邦民事诉讼规则第24条）


依权利参加诉讼
  • 在及时提出动议的情况下，法院必须在以下任一情况下准许参加诉讼：
    • 案外人的利益未被现有当事人充分代表，且案件的判决可能损害案外人保护该利益的能力
    • 联邦法规赋予无条件的参加诉讼权
依许可参加诉讼
  • 在及时提出动议的情况下，法院可以在以下任一情况下准许参加诉讼：
    • 案外人的诉求或抗辩与主诉讼有共同的法律或事实问题
    • 联邦法规赋予有条件的参加诉讼权
  • 法院必须考虑参加诉讼是否会不当地延迟或妨碍对原当事人权利的裁决

FRCP = 联邦民事诉讼规则 (Federal Rule of Civil Procedure)。

案外人可以通过根据联邦民事诉讼规则（FRCP）第24条及时提交参加诉讼动议来加入案件以保护其利益。参加诉讼有两种类型：

  • 依权利参加诉讼 – 当 (1) 案外人的利益未被现有当事人充分代表，且 (2) 案件的判决可能损害案外人保护该利益的能力时，法院必须准许参加诉讼。
  • 依许可参加诉讼 – 当案外人的诉求或抗辩与主诉讼有共同的法律或事实问题时，法院可以准许参加诉讼。但是，如果依许可参加诉讼会不当地延迟或妨碍对原当事人权利的裁决，法院可以拒绝。

在本案中，雇主及时提出动议，要求参加邮件员对建筑物所有者的诉讼。尽管雇主的利益（财产损害索赔）未被现有当事人充分代表，但对邮件员人身伤害诉讼的判决不大可能损害雇主保护其利益的能力（因此不构成依权利参加诉讼）。但由于两起诉讼都基于所有者被指控的过失（共同的法律和事实问题），法院很可能会允许雇主依许可参加诉讼（选项D）。

为了确定参加诉讼的动议是否及时提交，法院会考虑 (1) 动议人知道或应当知道其利益受到威胁的时间长短，(2) 如果准许参加诉讼对各方当事人造成的损害，以及 (3) 如果拒绝参加诉讼对动议人造成的损害。

（选项B）邮件员决定不将雇主列为共同原告，这并不影响雇主参加诉讼的能力。

（选项C）根据联邦民事诉讼规则第19条，不可或缺的当事人必须被追加到诉讼中。但雇主并非不可或缺的当事人，因为雇主的缺席不会影响法院向邮件员提供救济的能力，也不会影响雇主保护其相关财产利益的能力。

教学目标：
当案外人的利益未被充分代表，且案件的判决可能损害其保护该利益的能力时，必须准许参加诉讼（即依权利参加诉讼）。而当案外人的诉求或抗辩与主诉讼有共同问题时，可以准许参加诉讼（即依许可参加诉讼）。



References
• Fed. R. Civ. P. 24 (intervention).

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Intervention (FRCP 24)

FRCP 24 参加诉讼
核心考点：参加诉讼的两种类型

本题考察的是联邦民事诉讼规则第24条（FRCP 24）下的参加诉讼 (Intervention)。考生必须区分两种情况：

1. 依权利参加诉讼 (Intervention of Right)
FRCP 24(a)
  • 法院必须 (Must) 批准。
  • 条件：案外人的利益可能因案件判决而受损 (Impaired)，且现有当事人无法充分代表该利益。
2. 依许可参加诉讼 (Permissive Intervention)
FRCP 24(b)
  • 法院可以 (May) 批准（有裁量权）。
  • 条件：案外人的诉求与主诉讼有共同的法律或事实问题 (Common question of law or fact)。
题目解析与逻辑推理

正确答案：D

事实分析：邮件员（Clerk）起诉大楼所有者（Owner）过失导致滑倒。雇主（Employer）想加入诉讼，起诉同一所有者，理由是同一事故摔坏了电脑。

法律适用：

  • 共同问题：两者的索赔都源于同一个“结冰滑倒”事件。核心事实问题（是否有冰、是否危险）和法律问题（所有者是否过失）是完全相同的。
  • 结论：这完全符合依许可参加诉讼 (Permissive Intervention) 的标准。因此，法院很可能会批准动议，以提高司法效率，避免重复审理同一事实。
为什么其他选项是错误的？
  • 选项 A (错误)： 虽然雇主的利益可能不会因为缺席而受到法律上的“损害”（因为雇主可以单独起诉，不受既判力 Res Judicata 影响），但这只是说明它不符合“依权利参加”的严格标准。它仍然符合“依许可参加”的标准，而题目问的是法院“是否可能批准”，依许可参加也是一种批准路径。
  • 选项 B (错误)： 原告（邮件员）没有选择联合起诉并不妨碍案外人（雇主）主动申请参加诉讼。这是两个独立的程序机制。
  • 选项 C (错误)： 雇主不是不可或缺的当事人 (Indispensable Party, FRCP 19)。法院完全可以在雇主不在场的情况下解决邮件员的人身伤害案，不会导致不公正。
MBE 考试技巧

在处理 Intervention 问题时，请遵循以下思维导图：

  1. 先看是否符合 Intervention of Right（利益受损 + 代表不足）。
  2. 如果不符合，再看是否符合 Permissive Intervention（共同的法律或事实问题）。
  3. 注意题目问法：如果是问“法院必须批准吗？”，则必须满足前者；如果是问“法院可能批准吗？”，满足后者即可。

questions.question:
Hundreds of same-sex couples domiciled across the country initiated a class action in a federal district court against a health insurance company. The suit alleged that the insurance company violated a federal statute by charging the couples higher insurance premiums solely because they were in a same-sex relationship. The suit sought an injunction to stop the insurance company's discriminatory premiums as well as individualized monetary damages of $5,000 to $20,000 for each couple.
The district court entered an order certifying the suit as a "final equitable relief" class action after it determined that injunctive relief was appropriate because the insurance company's actions applied generally to the whole class. The insurance company immediately appealed the certification order.
Is the federal appellate court likely to overturn the certification order?

choices.a: No, because subject-matter jurisdiction exists over the class action.
choices.b: No, because the district court has not entered a final judgment.
choices.c: Yes, because the amount-in-controversy requirement was not satisfied.
choices.d: Yes, because the class action seeks individualized monetary damages.

data.questionStem:
Q88196

Hundreds of same-sex couples domiciled across the country initiated a class action in a federal district court against a health insurance company. The suit alleged that the insurance company violated a federal statute by charging the couples higher insurance premiums solely because they were in a same-sex relationship. The suit sought an injunction to stop the insurance company's discriminatory premiums as well as individualized monetary damages of $5,000 to $20,000 for each couple.

The district court entered an order certifying the suit as a "final equitable relief" class action after it determined that injunctive relief was appropriate because the insurance company's actions applied generally to the whole class. The insurance company immediately appealed the certification order.

Is the federal appellate court likely to overturn the certification order?

数百对居住在全国各地的同性伴侣在一家联邦地区法院对一家健康保险公司提起了集体诉讼。诉讼声称，该保险公司仅仅因为这些伴侣是同性关系就向他们收取更高的保险费，从而违反了一项联邦法规。该诉讼旨在寻求一项禁令以制止该保险公司的歧视性保费，并为每对伴侣寻求5,000至20,000美元的个体化金钱损害赔偿。

地区法院认定禁令救济是适当的，因为该保险公司的行为普遍适用于整个集体，因此下达了一项命令，将该诉讼认证为一项“最终衡平法救济”集体诉讼。该保险公司立即对该认证令提起了上诉。

联邦上诉法院是否可能推翻该认证令？
options:
A. No, because subject-matter jurisdiction exists over the class action.
不会，因为对该集体诉讼存在标的物管辖权。

B. No, because the district court has not entered a final judgment.
不会，因为地区法院尚未作出最终判决。

C. Yes, because the amount-in-controversy requirement was not satisfied.
会，因为未满足争议金额的要求。

D. Yes, because the class action seeks individualized monetary damages.
会，因为该集体诉讼寻求个体化金钱损害赔偿。
data.explanation:
A federal appellate court applies the abuse of discretion standard when reviewing a district court's discretionary certification order authorizing a class action to proceed. Class action certification is proper if the case satisfies four prerequisites (shown above) and is one of the following types of class actions:

  • Prejudicial risk - when separate actions would create a risk of (1) inconsistent decisions regarding the parties or (2) impairing absent class members' interests
  • Common question - when common questions of law or fact predominate over individual questions and a class action is the best method to resolve the dispute
  • Final equitable relief - when injunctive or declaratory relief is appropriate because the opposing party's actions generally apply to the whole class

A certified "final equitable relief" class action is valid if the suit also seeks incidental monetary damages. Such damages flow from liability to the class and do not require individualized determinations (eg, statutorily mandated damages). In contrast, a certified "final equitable relief" class action is invalid if the suit also seeks individualized monetary relief (as seen here).† Therefore, the district court abused its discretion in certifying the couples' suit as a "final equitable relief" class action, and the certification order will likely be overturned.

†A certified "final equitable relief" class action that seeks individualized monetary relief may violate due process because, unlike in "common question" class actions, class members are not entitled to notice or an opportunity to opt out and pursue individual suits.

(Choices A & C) Subject-matter jurisdiction exists through federal-question jurisdiction, which has no amount-in-controversy requirement, because this class action arises under a federal statute. However, this action was improperly certified since it contains individualized monetary claims.

(Choice B) The final-judgment rule bars a federal appellate court from hearing an appeal until the district court has entered a final judgment - absent limited exceptions. One such exception is an appeal of a district court's order granting or denying class action certification (as seen here).

Educational objective: A suit may be certified as a "final equitable relief" class action when injunctive or declaratory relief is appropriate because the opposing party's actions generally apply to the whole class. Certification of such a class action is appropriate even if it also seeks incidental monetary damages - but not individualized monetary relief.



选项正确率统计：A选项 30%，B选项 23%，C选项 9%，D选项 36%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

联邦上诉法院在审查地区法院授权集体诉讼进行的自由裁量认证令时，适用自由裁量权滥用标准。如果案件满足四个先决条件（如上所示），并且属于以下集体诉讼类型之一，则集体诉讼认证是适当的：

  • 偏见风险 - 当单独的诉讼会产生 (1) 关于各方当事人的裁决不一致或 (2) 损害缺席集体成员利益的风险时
  • 共同问题 - 当法律或事实的共同问题优于个体问题，且集体诉讼是解决争议的最佳方法时
  • 最终衡平法救济 - 当禁令或宣告性救济是适当的，因为对方的行为普遍适用于整个集体时

一项被认证为“最终衡平法救济”的集体诉讼是有效的，如果该诉讼同时寻求附带的金钱损害赔偿。此类损害赔偿源于对集体的责任，并且不需要个体化的裁定（例如，法定的损害赔偿）。相比之下，一项被认证为“最终衡平法救济”的集体诉讼是无效的，如果该诉讼同时寻求个体化的金钱救济（如此处所示）。† 因此，地区法院在将这对伴侣的诉讼认证为“最终衡平法救济”集体诉讼时滥用了其自由裁量权，该认证令很可能会被推翻。

†寻求个体化金钱救济的“最终衡平法救济”集体诉讼认证可能违反程序正义，因为与“共同问题”集体诉讼不同，集体成员无权获得通知或选择退出并提起个人诉讼的机会。

（选项A和C）标的物管辖权通过联邦问题管辖权而存在，该管辖权没有争议金额要求，因为本次集体诉讼是根据一项联邦法规提起的。然而，由于该诉讼包含个体化的金钱索赔，其认证是不当的。

（选项B）最终判决规则禁止联邦上诉法院在地区法院作出最终判决前审理上诉——除非有有限的例外。其中一个例外就是对地区法院批准或否决集体诉讼认证的命令（如此处所示）的上诉。

教学目标：当禁令或宣告性救济因对方的行为普遍适用于整个集体而成为适当时，一项诉讼可以被认证为“最终衡平法救济”集体诉讼。即使该集体诉讼同时寻求附带的金钱损害赔偿，认证也是适当的——但如果寻求个体化的金钱救济则不当。

References

  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 23(a) - (b) (class action certification requirements).
  • Wal-Mart Stores, Inc. v. Dukes, 564 U.S. 338, 360 - 62 (2011) (explaining that certification of a "final equitable relief" class action is invalid when the class members seek individualized monetary relief).

Civil Procedure

集体诉讼的认证规则

Class Action Certification under FRCP 23
正确答案：D

是的，上诉法院很可能会推翻该认证令，因为该集体诉讼寻求的是个体化的金钱损害赔偿 (Individualized Monetary Damages)。

核心考点解析

本题考察的是《联邦民事诉讼规则》第23条 (FRCP 23) 中关于不同类型集体诉讼的认证标准，特别是 Rule 23(b)(2) 与金钱赔偿的关系。

Rule 23(b)(2) "禁令类" 集体诉讼 此类诉讼适用于被告的行为普遍适用于整个集体，因此禁令救济 (Injunctive Relief) 或 宣告性救济 (Declaratory Relief) 对整个集体是适当的。

关键规则：

  • 适用范围： Rule 23(b)(2) 主要用于解决民权案件或要求停止某种行为的案件，其核心在于救济的“不可分割性”。
  • 金钱赔偿的限制： 如果原告寻求金钱赔偿，只有当这些赔偿是附带的 (Incidental) 且不需要复杂的个体计算时，才可能被允许。
  • 禁止个体化赔偿： 如果金钱赔偿需要对每个成员进行单独的证据听证或计算（即“个体化”），则不能根据 Rule 23(b)(2) 进行认证。

重要判例：Wal-Mart Stores, Inc. v. Dukes (2011)

最高法院明确指出，当集体成员寻求个体化的金钱救济 (Individualized Monetary Relief) 时，不能根据 Rule 23(b)(2) 认证集体诉讼。此类索赔通常属于 Rule 23(b)(3)，后者提供了更严格的程序保护（如通知和退出权）。

案情应用

在本案中，原告不仅寻求禁令，还要求每对伴侣获得 $5,000 到 $20,000 不等的赔偿。这意味着：

  1. 法院必须单独审查每对伴侣的具体情况来确定赔偿额。
  2. 这属于个体化金钱损害赔偿，而非仅仅是禁令的附带产物。
  3. 因此，地区法院将其认证为 "Final Equitable Relief" (Rule 23(b)(2)) 集体诉讼是滥用自由裁量权。

干扰项分析

选项 A & C (管辖权)
错误。本案基于联邦法规提起，存在联邦问题管辖权 (Federal Question Jurisdiction)，不需要满足争议金额 (Amount-in-Controversy) 要求。虽然管辖权存在，但这不能解决认证类型错误的问题。
选项 B (最终判决规则)
错误。通常上诉需要等到最终判决 (Final Judgment Rule)。但是，Rule 23(f) 提供了一个例外，允许上诉法院在地区法院下达批准或拒绝集体诉讼认证的命令后，立即受理中间上诉 (Interlocutory Appeal)。

MBE 考试技巧

看到 Rule 23(b)(2)（禁令类集体诉讼）时，立即检查原告是否要求金钱赔偿。

  • 如果是统一的、附带的赔偿（如法定固定罚款），可能允许。
  • 如果是因人而异的赔偿（如本题的 $5k-$20k），则必须走 Rule 23(b)(3) 通道（需要 Predominance 和 Superiority），不能走 (b)(2)。

The attorney for a plaintiff in an action filed in federal district court served the defendant with the summons, the complaint, and 25 interrogatories asking questions about the defendant's contentions in the case. The interrogatories stated that they were to be answered within 30 days after service.
The defendant is likely to succeed in obtaining a protective order on which of the following grounds?

choices.a: Interrogatories are only proper to discover facts, not contentions.
choices.b: Interrogatories may not be served until an answer to the complaint is filed.
choices.c: Interrogatories may not be served until the parties have conferred to arrange for initial disclosures and prepare a discovery plan.
choices.d: The interrogatories exceed the number permitted without permission from the court or an agreement between the parties.

data.questionStem:
Q88805 The attorney for a plaintiff in an action filed in federal district court served the defendant with the summons, the complaint, and 25 interrogatories asking questions about the defendant's contentions in the case. The interrogatories stated that they were to be answered within 30 days after service.

The defendant is likely to succeed in obtaining a protective order on which of the following grounds? 在一起向联邦地区法院提起的诉讼中，原告的律师向被告送达了传票、起诉状以及25份质询书，这些质询书询问了被告在本案中的主张。质询书上注明，应在送达后30天内作出答复。

被告很可能基于以下哪一项理由成功获得保护令？
options:
A. Interrogatories are only proper to discover facts, not contentions.
质询书仅适用于发现事实，而非主张。

B. Interrogatories may not be served until an answer to the complaint is filed.
在对起诉状提交答辩状之前，不得送达质询书。

C. Interrogatories may not be served until the parties have conferred to arrange for initial disclosures and prepare a discovery plan.
在双方当事人进行协商以安排初步披露并准备证据开示计划之前，不得送达质询书。

D. The interrogatories exceed the number permitted without permission from the court or an agreement between the parties.
未经法院许可或双方当事人协议，质询书的数量超过了允许的上限。
data.explanation:
Methods of discovery


Depositions
  • Written or oral examination of party or witness under oath
  • 10 per party
Interrogatories
  • Written questions served on party
  • Serve up to 25
  • Written responses due within 30 days of service
Request for production
  • Request served on party (or subpoena served on nonparty) to produce & allow inspection of documents, electronic information, tangible items, or land
  • No limit
  • Written response due within 30 days of service
Requests for admission
  • Requests served on other party to admit truth of facts within scope of discovery
  • No limit
  • Written response due within 30 days of service
Physical/mental exams
  • Order by court or parties' agreement for physical or mental examination of party if those conditions are in controversy
Except in limited circumstances,† a party may not seek discovery (including interrogatories) until the parties have held an initial planning conference—ie, a meeting where the parties arrange for initial disclosures and prepare a plan for discovery. If a discovery request is submitted before this conference is held (as seen here), the court would likely grant a protective order. This shields the served party from the undue burden of responding to that request, especially since the disclosure of the requested information will likely be arranged at the initial planning conference.

†Discovery may be sought before an initial planning conference (1) in a proceeding exempt from initial disclosures or (2) if permitted by a court order, the parties' stipulation, or a procedural rule.

(Choice A) Interrogatories are written questions (served by one party on another party) that may inquire about any matter within the scope of discovery—including facts, opinions, and contentions that pertain to the case.

(Choice B) Interrogatories may be served after an initial planning conference has been held—not when an answer to the complaint has been filed.

(Choice D) A party may serve up to 25 interrogatories on any other party without the court's permission or an agreement between the parties (as seen here).

证据开示的方法


庭外证言
  • 对当事人或证人进行的经宣誓的书面或口头询问
  • 每方10次
质询书
  • 向当事人送达的书面问题
  • 最多可送达25份
  • 书面答复应在送达后30天内提交
文件出示请求
  • 向当事人送达请求（或向非当事人送达传票），要求其出示并允许检查文件、电子信息、有形物品或土地
  • 无数量限制
  • 书面答复应在送达后30天内提交
承认请求
  • 向另一方当事人送达请求，要求其承认属于证据开示范围内的案件事实的真实性
  • 无数量限制
  • 书面答复应在送达后30天内提交
身体/精神检查
  • 如果当事人的身体或精神状况存在争议，可由法院命令或经当事人协议对其进行身体或精神检查
除非在有限的情况下†，否则一方当事人不得寻求证据开示（包括质询书），直到双方举行了初步规划会议——即双方当事人安排初步披露并准备证据开示计划的会议。如果证据开示请求在此次会议举行前提交（如本案所示），法院很可能批准一项保护令。这可以保护被送达方免于承受回应此请求的不当负担，特别是因为所请求信息的披露很可能会在初步规划会议上进行安排。

†在初步规划会议之前可以寻求证据开示的情形包括：(1) 在免于初步披露的程序中，或 (2) 经法院命令、当事人约定或程序规则允许。

(选项A) 质询书是一方当事人向另一方当事人送达的书面问题，可以询问证据开示范围内的任何事项——包括与案件有关的事实、意见和主张。

(选项B) 质询书可以在初步规划会议举行后送达——而不是在对起诉状提交答辩状后。

(选项D) 未经法院许可或双方当事人协议，一方当事人可以向任何其他当事人送达最多25份质询书（如本案所示）。

Educational objective:
Discovery requests generally cannot be served until the parties have held an initial planning conference to arrange for initial disclosures and prepare a discovery plan.

References
• Fed. R. Civ. P. 26(d) (timing of discovery).
• Fed. R. Civ. P. 33 (interrogatories).

MBE 民事诉讼法解析

Civil Procedure: Discovery Timing
正确答案 选项 C

在双方举行 Rule 26(f) 会议之前，不得送达质询书。

⚖️ 核心法律规则 (The Rule)

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》(FRCP)，除非法院命令或双方协议另有规定，一方当事人不得在双方举行 Rule 26(f) 会议之前向任何来源寻求证据开示（Discovery）。

Reference: Fed. R. Civ. P. 26(d)(1)
🔍 案件分析 (Analysis)
  • 时间点错误 (Premature Service)：
    本案中，原告律师在送达起诉状（Complaint）和传票（Summons）的同时送达了质询书（Interrogatories）。
  • 程序要求：
    联邦规则要求双方必须先进行“会面与协商”（Meet and Confer），即 Rule 26(f) Conference，以制定证据开示计划。在此会议之前，证据开示的大门尚未开启。
  • 后果：
    由于原告违反了时间规定，被告有正当理由申请保护令 (Protective Order)，以免除在30天内回复这些过早送达的质询书的负担。
❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 A 错误：
质询书可以询问事实，也可以询问将法律适用于事实的主张 (Contentions)。FRCP 33(a)(2) 明确允许 "Contention Interrogatories"。
选项 B 错误：
证据开示的触发点是 Rule 26(f) 会议，而不是被告提交答辩状（Answer）的时间。虽然通常会议发生在答辩之后，但法律规则的锚点是会议本身。
选项 D 错误：
FRCP 33(a)(1) 规定的质询书上限正是 25个（包括所有子问题）。题目中原告送达了正好25个，因此并未超过法定数量限制，无需法院许可。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理 Discovery (证据开示) 的题目时，务必关注时间线 (Timeline)。

记住黄金法则：
Complaint Served ➔ Rule 26(f) Conference ➔ Discovery Starts

如果看到原告一上来就扔出一堆 Discovery Request，通常都是违反了 Rule 26(d) 的时间规定。

questions.question:
A plaintiff filed an action in federal district court and served the defendant with the summons and complaint. The defendant moved to dismiss the complaint for failure to state a claim.
Instead of opposing the motion to dismiss, the plaintiff voluntarily dismissed the action and filed a new action alleging the same claims and addressing the pleading defects outlined in the defendant's motion to dismiss. The defendant moved to dismiss the second action, and the plaintiff voluntarily dismissed the second action instead of filing opposition papers.
The plaintiff has filed a third action asserting the same claims and new allegations that are responsive to the defendant's second motion. The defendant has moved to dismiss the third action; the plaintiff opposes the motion.
Is the court likely to grant the defendant's motion?

choices.a: No, because the plaintiff has promptly and diligently attempted to address the pleading defects.
choices.b: No, because the plaintiff voluntarily dismissed each previous action before the defendant filed an answer or moved for summary judgment.
choices.c: Yes, because the plaintiff failed to seek a court order dismissing the second action.
choices.d: Yes, because the plaintiff's previously dismissed actions asserting the same claims operate as an adjudication on the merits.

data.questionStem:
Q88808 A plaintiff filed an action in federal district court and served the defendant with the summons and complaint. The defendant moved to dismiss the complaint for failure to state a claim.

Instead of opposing the motion to dismiss, the plaintiff voluntarily dismissed the action and filed a new action alleging the same claims and addressing the pleading defects outlined in the defendant's motion to dismiss. The defendant moved to dismiss the second action, and the plaintiff voluntarily dismissed the second action instead of filing opposition papers.

The plaintiff has filed a third action asserting the same claims and new allegations that are responsive to the defendant's second motion. The defendant has moved to dismiss the third action; the plaintiff opposes the motion.

Is the court likely to grant the defendant's motion? 原告在联邦地区法院提起诉讼，并向被告送达了传票和诉状。

被告以诉状未能陈述有效诉由为由，动议驳回该诉状。

原告没有对驳回动议提出反对，而是自愿撤回了诉讼，并提起了新的诉讼，主张相同的诉由，并纠正了被告在驳回动议中指出的诉状缺陷。被告动议驳回第二次诉讼，而原告没有提交反对文件，而是再次自愿撤回了第二次诉讼。

原告提起了第三次诉讼，主张了相同的诉由，并针对被告的第二次动议提出了新的指控。被告已动议驳回第三次诉讼；原告对该动议提出反对。

法院是否可能批准被告的动议？
options:
A. No, because the plaintiff has promptly and diligently attempted to address the pleading defects.
不会，因为原告已迅速并尽力地尝试纠正诉状中的缺陷。

B. No, because the plaintiff voluntarily dismissed each previous action before the defendant filed an answer or moved for summary judgment.
不会，因为原告在被告提交答辩状或动议即决判决之前，自愿撤回了之前的每一次诉讼。

C. Yes, because the plaintiff failed to seek a court order dismissing the second action.
会，因为原告未能寻求法院命令来撤回第二次诉讼。

D. Yes, because the plaintiff's previously dismissed actions asserting the same claims operate as an adjudication on the merits.
会，因为原告先前就相同诉由撤回的诉讼，已构成对案件实体的是非判决。
data.explanation:
Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 41(a), a plaintiff may voluntarily dismiss a suit without a court order by filing (1) a stipulation of dismissal signed by all the parties or (2) a notice of dismissal before the defendant serves an answer or a summary judgment motion. Here, no court order was required since the plaintiff voluntarily dismissed the first and second actions before an answer or summary judgment motion was filed (Choice C).

A voluntary dismissal is generally entered without prejudice. This means that the plaintiff can sue the defendant on the same claim in the future. However, a voluntary dismissal is with prejudice and operates as an adjudication on the merits when stated in an order, notice, or stipulation of dismissal OR the two-dismissal rule applies. This rule applies when the plaintiff:

• voluntarily dismissed the first action in federal or state court without a court order and

• voluntarily dismissed the second action based on the same claim in federal court by filing a notice of dismissal.

Here, the plaintiff likely dismissed both actions by a notice of dismissal since there is no indication that the court issued an order or the parties signed a stipulation. Since these actions asserted the same claims, the second dismissal operated as an adjudication on the merits. Therefore, the court will likely grant the defendant's motion to dismiss the third action.

(Choice A) The fact that the plaintiff has promptly and diligently attempted to address the pleading defects raised by the defendant does not affect the application of the two-dismissal rule.

(Choice B) Although the plaintiff voluntarily dismissed each previous action before the defendant filed an answer or moved for summary judgment, the two-dismissal rule still bars the third action.

Educational objective: Under the two-dismissal rule, a voluntary dismissal of a second action operates as an adjudication on the merits when the plaintiff voluntarily dismissed (1) the first action in federal or state court without a court order and (2) the second action based on the same claim in federal court by filing a notice of dismissal.



根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第41(a)条，原告可以通过提交 (1) 经所有当事人签署的撤诉协议，或 (2) 在被告送达答辩状或即决判决动议之前的撤诉通知，来自愿撤诉，而无需法院命令。在本案中，由于原告在被告提交答辩状或即决判决动议之前自愿撤回了第一次和第二次诉讼，因此不需要法院命令（选项C）。

自愿撤诉通常是无偏见的（without prejudice）。这意味着原告将来可以就同一诉由再次起诉被告。但是，当撤诉的命令、通知或协议中另有规定，或者两次撤诉规则（two-dismissal rule）适用时，自愿撤诉将是有偏见的（with prejudice），并构成对案件实体的是非判决（adjudication on the merits）。该规则适用于以下情况：原告：

• 在联邦或州法院未经法院命令自愿撤回了第一次诉讼并且

• 通过提交撤诉通知，在联邦法院就同一诉由自愿撤回了第二次诉讼。

在本案中，原告很可能是通过提交撤诉通知来撤回这两次诉讼的，因为没有迹象表明法院下达了命令或当事人签署了协议。由于这些诉讼主张了相同的诉由，第二次撤诉构成了对案件实体的是非判决。因此，法院很可能会批准被告驳回第三次诉讼的动议。

（选项A）原告迅速并尽力地尝试纠正被告提出的诉状缺陷，这一事实不影响两次撤诉规则的适用。

（选项B）尽管原告在被告提交答辩状或动议即决判决之前自愿撤回了每一次诉讼，但两次撤诉规则仍然禁止第三次诉讼。

教学目的： 根据两次撤诉规则，当原告 (1) 在联邦或州法院未经法院命令自愿撤回第一次诉讼，并且 (2) 通过提交撤诉通知在联邦法院就同一诉由自愿撤回第二次诉讼时，第二次的自愿撤诉即构成对案件实体的是非判决。

References

• Fed. R. Civ. P. 41(a) (voluntary dismissals).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure | Voluntary Dismissal
正确答案：D
核心考点：两次撤诉规则

Two-Dismissal Rule
根据联邦民事诉讼规则 (FRCP) 41(a)(1)(B)，如果原告此前已经自愿撤回过基于同一诉由 (same claim) 的诉讼（无论是在联邦法院还是州法院），那么其第二次提交撤诉通知 (Notice of Dismissal) 将被视为“对案件实体的是非判决” (Adjudication on the Merits)。

📝 案件逻辑推演

  • 1
    第一次诉讼：原告提起诉讼，被告动议驳回。原告在被告答辩前自愿撤诉。
    ➡ 结果：无偏见撤诉 (Without Prejudice)。原告可以重来。
  • 2
    第二次诉讼：原告基于同一诉由再次起诉。被告再次动议驳回。原告再次自愿撤诉。
    ➡ 结果：触发“两次撤诉规则”。本次撤诉变为“有偏见” (With Prejudice)。
  • 3
    第三次诉讼：原告再次起诉。由于第二次撤诉已构成“实体判决”，根据既判力原则 (Res Judicata)，原告不得再诉。
    ➡ 结论：法院将批准被告的驳回动议。
⚠️ 关键陷阱 (Exam Tip) 考生常误以为只要是在“被告提交答辩状 (Answer) 或即决判决动议 (Summary Judgment)”之前撤诉就是安全的。

虽然 Rule 41(a)(1) 允许在此时段内无需法院命令即可撤诉，但它并不豁免两次撤诉规则的后果。一旦使用了两次“撤诉通知 (Notice of Dismissal)”，案子就彻底结束了。

🔍 选项深度解析

✅ 选项 D 正确：
第二次自愿撤诉构成了 Adjudication on the Merits（即实质性判决）。这意味着法院视同原告已经输掉了官司，因此禁止其就同一事项提起第三次诉讼。

❌ 选项 A 错误：
原告是否“勤勉 (diligently)”或试图修正诉状缺陷与该规则的适用无关。这是一个严格的程序性规则。

❌ 选项 B 错误：
虽然原告确实是在被告 Answer 之前撤诉的（程序上是合法的），但这不能阻止“两次撤诉规则”产生的法律后果（即禁止再诉）。

❌ 选项 C 错误：
原告不需要法院命令即可撤诉（因为被告仅提交了 Rule 12(b)(6) 动议，这既不是 Answer 也不是 Summary Judgment）。问题不在于是否需要命令，而在于撤诉的次数。

备考建议：
遇到 "Voluntary Dismissal" 的题目，立即数一下这是第几次撤诉。如果是第二次且基于同一诉由，直接找 "Adjudication on the Merits" 或 "With Prejudice" 的选项。

questions.question:
The owner of a food processing plant sued a food preservative company in federal court for federal antitrust violations. During discovery, the owner's lawyer served the company with notice of a written deposition of the company. The notice stated the company's name and address and provided the name and address of the officer before whom the deposition would be taken.
The company refused to attend the written deposition. The owner moved for sanctions.
The company is likely to succeed in defeating the owner's motion on which of the following grounds?

choices.a: The owner failed to designate an individual from the company to answer the questions.
choices.b: The owner failed to include a subpoena with the notice.
choices.c: The owner failed to obtain the court's leave before serving the company with the notice.
choices.d: The owner failed to reasonably describe the matters to be examined.

data.questionStem:
Q88218

The owner of a food processing plant sued a food preservative company in federal court for federal antitrust violations. During discovery, the owner's lawyer served the company with notice of a written deposition of the company. The notice stated the company's name and address and provided the name and address of the officer before whom the deposition would be taken.

The company refused to attend the written deposition. The owner moved for sanctions.

The company is likely to succeed in defeating the owner's motion on which of the following grounds?

一家食品加工厂的所有者在联邦法院起诉一家食品防腐剂公司，指控其违反联邦反垄断法。在证据开示（discovery）期间，所有者的律师向该公司送达了一份对该公司进行书面证言质询（written deposition）的通知。该通知说明了公司的名称和地址，并提供了主持取证的官员的姓名和地址。

该公司拒绝出席书面证言质询。所有者请求法院施加制裁（sanctions）。

该公司很可能基于以下哪一项理由成功驳回所有者的动议（motion）？
options:
A. The owner failed to designate an individual from the company to answer the questions.
所有者未能从公司中指定一名个人来回答问题。

B. The owner failed to include a subpoena with the notice.
所有者未能在通知中附上传票（subpoena）。

C. The owner failed to obtain the court's leave before serving the company with the notice.
所有者在向公司送达通知前，未能获得法院的许可（leave）。

D. The owner failed to reasonably describe the matters to be examined.
所有者未能合理地描述将要被质询的事项。
data.explanation:
Contents for written notice of deposition


TypeSimilar contentsUnique contents
WrittenTime & place of deposition Method of recordingOfficer's name / descriptive title & address Copy of deposition questions
OralDeponent's name & address (if known) OR general description to identify deponent or group to which deponent belongs (if name unknown)If deponent is organization, matters for examination described with reasonable particularity
†Must be served on party deponent to compel his/her attendance.

A deposition is a method of discovery in which a deponent (party or nonparty) is examined under oath and outside court. There are two types of depositions:
  • Oral depositions (most common) - in which the parties' attorneys question and cross-examine the deponent as they would at trial and an officer records that testimony
  • Written depositions - in which an officer asks the deponent questions submitted by the parties and then records the deponent's responses

To compel a party deponent's attendance at either deposition, the deposing party must serve the party deponent with written notice.† If the party deponent is an organization, the notice must describe the matters for examination with reasonable particularity and satisfy all other notice requirements. Based on the matters identified for examination, the organization must then designate one or more individuals to testify on its behalf. If the deponent fails to attend the deposition, the court may impose sanctions.

Here, the owner served the company with notice of a written deposition, but the company did not attend. However, the notice was deficient because it failed to reasonably describe the matters for examination. As a result, the company is likely to defeat the owner's motion for sanctions on this ground.

†The deposing party must also serve a copy of the written notice on the other parties and, for written depositions, on the officer before whom the deposition will be taken.

(Choice A) The company, not the owner, must designate an individual(s) to answer the deposition questions.

(Choice B) A subpoena is required to compel a nonparty deponent's attendance, but a party deponent (eg, the company) can be compelled to attend through written notice.

(Choice C) A party may conduct a deposition without the court's leave or the parties' stipulation unless (1) the deposition exceeds the 10- deposition maximum, (2) the deposition is sought before the initial planning conference, or (3) the deponent was already deposed in the case. None of these exceptions apply here.

Educational objective: To compel a party deponent's attendance at a deposition, the deposing party must serve the deponent with written notice. When the deponent is an organization, the notice must describe the matters for examination with reasonable particularity. The organization must then designate one or more individuals to testify on its behalf.

选项正确率统计：A选项 26%，B选项 18%，C选项 7%，D选项 47%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

书面证言质询通知的内容


类型相似内容特有内容
书面证言质询的时间和地点
记录方法		官员的姓名/描述性头衔和地址
证言质询问题的副本
口头证人姓名和地址（如已知）或用以识别证人或其所属团体的一般性描述（如姓名未知）如证人是组织，则需以合理的具体性描述质询事项
†必须向当事方证人送达，以强制其出席。

证言质询（deposition）是一种证据开示（discovery）的方法，在此过程中，证人（deponent）（当事方或非当事方）在法庭外宣誓接受质询。证言质询有两种类型：
  • 口头证言质询（最常见）- 各方律师像在庭审中一样对证人进行询问和交叉询问，并由一名官员记录证词
  • 书面证言质询 - 由一名官员向证人提出各方提交的问题，然后记录证人的回答

为强制当事方证人出席任一类型的证言质询，取证方必须向该当事方证人送达书面通知。† 如果当事方证人是一个组织，通知必须以合理的具体性描述质询的事项，并满足所有其他通知要求。根据所确定的质询事项，该组织必须指定一名或多名个人代表其作证。如果证人未能出席证言质询，法院可施加制裁。

在本案中，所有者向公司送达了书面证言质询的通知，但公司并未出席。然而，该通知存在缺陷，因为它未能合理地描述质询事项。因此，公司很可能基于此理由成功驳回所有者请求制裁的动议。

†取证方还必须向其他当事方送达书面通知的副本，并且对于书面证言质询，还需向主持取证的官员送达副本。

(选项A) 必须由公司而非所有者指定个人来回答证言质询的问题。

(选项B) 强制非当事方证人出席需要传票（subpoena），但当事方证人（例如，本案中的公司）可以通过书面通知被强制出席。

(选项C) 一方当事人可以在未经法院许可（leave）或各方约定的情况下进行证言质询，除非 (1) 证言质询的次数超过10次的上限，(2) 在初次计划会议之前寻求进行证言质询，或 (3) 证人已在本案中被质询过。这些例外情况均不适用于本案。

教学目标：为强制当事方证人出席证言质询，取证方必须向证人送达书面通知。当证人是一个组织时，通知必须以合理的具体性描述质询事项。该组织随后必须指定一名或多名个人代表其作证。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 31 (depositions by written questions).

Fed. R. Civ. P. 30(b)(6) (notice requirements for deposing an organization).

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Pretrial Procedures
💡 核心考点：对组织进行取证 (Deposing an Organization) 当取证对象是公司或组织时，通知书必须明确描述质询的事项，以便组织指定合适的人员作证。
法律依据：FRCP 30(b)(6) & 31

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》(Federal Rules of Civil Procedure)，无论是口头证言质询 (Oral Deposition) 还是书面证言质询 (Written Deposition)，如果受通知人是一个组织（如本案中的公司）：

  1. 通知要求：取证方必须在通知中以"合理的具体性" (reasonable particularity) 描述将要质询的事项。
  2. 指定义务：只有在知道要问什么之后，被取证的组织才有义务指定 (designate) 一名或多名官员、董事或其他人员代表其作证。

⚖️ 案情逻辑推演

在本案中，原告（所有者）向被告（公司）发送了书面取证通知。虽然通知包含了公司的名称和地址，但缺少了关键的一环：

❌ 未描述质询事项 (Failed to describe matters)

由于公司不知道原告要问什么问题，公司就无法履行其法律义务去挑选一个“知道答案”的人来回答。因此，该通知在程序上是有缺陷的。

✅ 正确答案分析 (选项 D)

D. 所有者未能合理地描述将要被质询的事项。

这是公司拒绝出席并能成功抗辩制裁动议的根本原因。没有具体的质询事项描述，公司无法根据 FRCP 30(b)(6) 指定合适的代理人。这是程序上的致命缺陷。

❌ 错误选项排除

A. 所有者未能指定个人...
错误。 法律规定由被取证的组织（公司）来指定回答问题的人，而不是由取证方（所有者）指定。取证方只需列出问题范围。
B. 未能附上传票 (Subpoena)...
错误。 传票通常用于强制非当事方 (non-party) 出席。对于本案中的被告（当事方），仅需送达符合规定的通知 (Notice) 即可强制其出席。
C. 未能获得法院许可 (Leave of court)...
错误。 一般情况下，进行证言质询不需要法院许可，除非触犯了特定限制（如超过10次取证、重复取证等），本案未提及这些例外情况。
🎓 MBE 提分技巧 看到 "Deposition of a Corporation/Organization" 时，立即检查两个关键点：
  • 通知中是否描述了具体事项 (Subject Matter)？
  • 是否由公司自己 (The Organization) 指定证人？
如果通知只写了公司名字没写事项，或者原告试图强行指定公司的某个人（如CEO）回答所有问题，通常都是程序错误的。

questions.question:
A construction company bought lumber from an out-of-state supplier. The lumber was supposed to be pressure-treated, which renders the lumber resistant to rot and termites. The construction company used the lumber to build its headquarters, and after one year, the lumber began to show signs of rot and termites.
The construction company sued the supplier for breach of contract in a federal district court.
Which method of discovery should the construction company use to most efficiently identify the supplier's employees who might have information about how the lumber was treated?

choices.a: Interrogatories.
choices.b: Oral deposition.
choices.c: Request for production of documents.
choices.d: Subpoena.

data.questionStem:
Q88224

A construction company bought lumber from an out-of-state supplier. The lumber was supposed to be pressure-treated, which renders the lumber resistant to rot and termites. The construction company used the lumber to build its headquarters, and after one year, the lumber began to show signs of rot and termites.

The construction company sued the supplier for breach of contract in a federal district court.

Which method of discovery should the construction company use to most efficiently identify the supplier's employees who might have information about how the lumber was treated?

一家建筑公司从一个州外供应商处购买了木材。该木材本应经过压力处理，这种处理能使木材防腐和防白蚁。该建筑公司使用这批木材建造其总部，一年后，木材开始出现腐烂和白蚁侵蚀的迹象。

该建筑公司在联邦地区法院以违约为由起诉了该供应商。

该建筑公司应使用何种证据发现方法，才能最有效地确定可能了解木材处理方式相关信息的供应商员工？
options:
A. Interrogatories.
书面质询。

B. Oral deposition.
口头取证。

C. Request for production of documents.
文件出示请求。

D. Subpoena.
传票。
data.explanation:
Methods of discovery


DepositionsWritten or oral examination of party or witness under oath 10 per party
InterrogatoriesWritten questions served on party Serve up to 25 Written responses due within 30 days of service
Request for productionRequest served on party (or subpoena served on nonparty) to produce & allow inspection of documents, electronic information, tangible items, or land No limit Written response due within 30 days of service
Requests for admissionRequests served on other party to admit truth of facts within scope of discovery No limit Written response due within 30 days of service
Physical/mental examsOrder by court or parties' agreement for physical or mental examination of party if those conditions are in controversy
Interrogatories are written questions served by one party on another party that may inquire about any facts, opinions, and contentions within the scope of discovery. One of the primary purposes of interrogatories is to ascertain facts and information that might lead to other evidence, and the main benefit of interrogatories is that they are simple and inexpensive. Therefore, interrogatories are the most efficient way for the construction company to identify the supplier's employees who might have information about the lumber's treatment.

(Choice B) A deposition is a written or oral examination of a party or nonparty under oath and outside of court. Oral depositions are useful to question potential witnesses because their answers can be used at trial if they are inconsistent with the witnesses' trial testimony or the witnesses are unavailable to testify. But an oral deposition is time-consuming and expensive, so it is not the most efficient method to identify potential witnesses.

(Choice C) A request for production is used to make another party produce and allow inspection of documents, electronically stored information, tangible things, or land in their control. Here, the supplier may have documents that show which employees treated the lumber. But the more efficient method to obtain this information is through interrogatories since they place the burden on the responding party (eg, the supplier) to find the answer.

(Choice D) A subpoena is a written court order that can be used in conjunction with other discovery methods to compel a person to appear in court, take part in a deposition, or produce documents in the person's possession. But it would not be useful here since the company is trying to identify potential witnesses.

Educational objective: Interrogatories are written questions served by one party on another party that may inquire about any matter within the scope of discovery. This simple and inexpensive method of discovery is primarily used to identify facts and information that might lead to other evidence - eg, the identity of potential witnesses.

选项正确率统计：A选项 59%（正确选项），B选项 12%，C选项 19%，D选项 9%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

证据发现方法


Depositions (取证)在宣誓下对当事人或证人进行的书面或口头询问
每方当事人不得超过10次
Interrogatories (书面质询)向一方当事人送达的书面问题
最多可送达25个问题
书面答复应在送达后30天内完成
Request for production (文件出示请求)向当事人送达请求（或向非当事人送达传票），要求其出示并允许检查文件、电子信息、有形物品或土地
无数量限制
书面答复应在送达后30天内完成
Requests for admission (自认请求)向另一方当事人送达的，要求其对证据发现范围内的案件事实的真实性予以承认的请求
无数量限制
书面答复应在送达后30天内完成
Physical/mental exams (身体/精神检查)若当事人的身体或精神状况存在争议，可由法院命令或经当事人协议对其进行身体或精神检查
书面质询是书面问题，由一方当事人向另一方当事人送达，可以询问证据发现范围内的任何事实、意见和争点。书面质询的主要目的之一是查明可能引出其他证据的事实和信息，其主要优点是简单且成本低廉。因此，书面质询是建筑公司确定可能了解木材处理方式相关信息的供应商员工的最有效方法。

(选项 B) 口头取证是在法庭外，在宣誓下对当事人或非当事人进行的书面或口头询问。口头取证对于询问潜在证人很有用，因为如果他们的回答与庭审证词不一致，或者证人无法出庭作证，这些回答可以在审判中使用。但口头取证耗时且昂贵，因此它不是确定潜在证人的最有效方法。

(选项 C) 文件出示请求用于要求另一方当事人出示并允许检查其控制下的文件、电子存储信息、有形物品或土地。在本案中，供应商可能拥有显示哪些员工处理了木材的文件。但是，获取此信息的更有效方法是通过书面质询，因为这会将寻找答案的责任施加给应答方（例如，供应商）。

(选项 D) 传票是一种书面法院命令，可与其他证据发现方法结合使用，以强制某人出庭、参加取证或出示其持有的文件。但在本案中它没有用，因为该公司正试图确定潜在证人。

教学目标：书面质询是由一方当事人向另一方当事人送达的书面问题，可以询问证据发现范围内的任何事项。这种简单且成本低廉的证据发现方法主要用于确定可能引出其他证据的事实和信息——例如，确定潜在证人的身份。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 33 (interrogatories).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Discovery
✅
正确答案：选项 A
书面质询 (Interrogatories)

本题考查的核心是：在联邦民事诉讼中，针对特定目的（确定知情人员身份），哪种证据发现手段最符合效率原则。

⚖️ 法律依据与推理
FRCP Rule 33: Interrogatories 书面质询是一方当事人向另一方当事人发出的书面问题，接收方必须在宣誓后以书面形式作答。

在本案中，建筑公司的目标是确定 (Identify) 供应商的哪些员工了解木材处理情况。选择书面质询的理由如下：

  1. 成本低廉且高效： 律师只需起草一个简单的问题（例如：“请列出所有参与木材压力处理的员工姓名及职位”）。
  2. 举证责任转移： 书面质询将“寻找信息”的负担转移给了应答方（供应商）。供应商必须去查阅记录、询问经理，然后提供一份名单。
  3. 作为后续手段的基础： 一旦通过书面质询拿到了名单，原告就可以针对特定人员进行更昂贵的取证（如口头取证）。
🔍 为什么其他选项不是最佳？
手段 为何本案中不适用？
口头取证
(Depositions)		 太贵且过早。 口头取证需要律师在场、法庭记录员记录，费用高昂。如果你还不知道该问谁，就无法安排取证。
文件出示
(Request for Production)		 效率较低。 虽然可以要求“出示所有处理记录”，但原告必须自己从海量文件中筛选员工名字。不如直接问“是谁”来得直接。
传票
(Subpoena)		 对象错误。 传票通常用于强制非当事人 (Non-party) 提供证词或文件。本案被告是当事人，应直接使用发现程序，而非传票。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

当题目问及“最有效 (Most Efficient)”或“最经济 (Most Economical)”的方法，且目的是为了获取基础事实信息（如证人姓名、保险金额、基本主张）时，Interrogatories 通常是正确答案。

记住逻辑顺序：先用 Interrogatories 找人（Identify），再用 Depositions 问话（Testimony）。

questions.question:
A man from State A and a woman from State B started a fashion business together in State A. After a year of working together, the man and the woman began to have different opinions on how the business should operate. The woman was also concerned that the man used dress designs from his previous employer, thereby risking a lawsuit from the former employer. They tried to figure out a solution to wind down the business without involving lawyers but failed.
The woman sued the man in federal district court, seeking $2 million for breach of contract. During discovery, the woman served a subpoena on the man's former employer seeking copies of the employer's dress designs. The employer is worried that disclosing these designs will reveal his trade secrets.
What is the most efficient action the employer can take to prevent disclosure of his trade secrets?

choices.a: Claim privilege over the dress designs.
choices.b: File a motion to quash the subpoena.
choices.c: Intervene in the case.
choices.d: Request a temporary restraining order.

Q88215

After a year of working together, the man and the woman began to have different opinions on how the business should operate. They tried to figure out a solution to wind down the business without involving lawyers but failed.

The woman sued the man in federal district court, seeking $2 million for breach of contract. During discovery, the woman served a subpoena on the man's former employer seeking copies of the employer's dress designs. The employer is worried that disclosing these designs will reveal his trade secrets.

What is the most efficient action the employer can take to prevent disclosure of his trade secrets?

一名来自 A 州（State A）的男子和一名来自 B 州（State B）的女子在 A 州共同创办了一家时装企业。合作一年后，该男子和女子开始在企业运营方式上产生分歧。该女子还担心该男子使用了其前雇主的服装设计，从而有被前雇主起诉的风险。他们试图在不聘请律师的情况下找出解决办法来结束业务，但未能成功。

该女子在联邦地区法院起诉该男子，以违约为由索赔 200 万美元。在证据开示（discovery）期间，该女子向该男子的前雇主送达了一张传票（subpoena），要求其提供服装设计的副本。该前雇主担心披露这些设计会泄露其商业秘密。

该前雇主可以采取何种最有效的行动来防止其商业秘密被披露？
options:
A. Claim privilege over the dress designs.
主张服装设计享有特免权（privilege）。

B. File a motion to quash the subpoena.
提交一份动议（motion）以撤销该传票。

C. Intervene in the case.
申请介入（intervene）此案。

D. Request a temporary restraining order.
申请临时限制令（temporary restraining order）。
data.explanation:
Quashing or modifying subpoenas


(FRCP 45(d)(3))
Required
Court must quash or modify subpoena that:
  • fails to allow reasonable time to comply
  • requires person to comply beyond geographical limits
  • requires disclosure of privileged or protected matter or
  • subjects person to undue burden
Permitted
Court may quash or modify subpoena that requires disclosing:
  • unretained expert's opinion or information that (1) does not describe occurrences in dispute & (2) results from expert's study not requested by party
  • trade secret or confidential research, development, or commercial information
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

A subpoena is a written court order that compels a person (party or nonparty) to appear in court or at a deposition OR to produce documents or items in his/her possession.† Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 45(d), a person subjected to a subpoena may file a motion to modify or quash that subpoena. A court may grant the motion if the subpoena requires disclosure of:

  • an unretained expert witness's opinion or information that (1) does not describe specific occurrences in dispute and (2) results from the expert's independent study instead of a party's request or
  • trade secrets or other confidential research, development, or commercial information.


Here, the woman served a subpoena on the man's former employer (nonparty) to produce copies of his dress designs. Since the employer is concerned that disclosure will reveal his trade secrets and a motion is relatively cost-effective, the most efficient action to prevent disclosure is to file a motion to quash the subpoena.

†A person commanded to produce documents or items need not appear in person at the place of production or inspection unless also commanded to appear for a deposition, hearing, or trial.

(Choice A) In general, trade secrets are not privileged. If they were, the court would be required to modify or quash a subpoena compelling the disclosure of that privileged information.

(Choice C) A nonparty may intervene (ie, join) and fully participate in a pending suit to protect his/her interests. But here, the employer does not have an interest in the pending suit other than the subpoena, and he can efficiently protect this interest by filing a motion to quash.

(Choice D) A temporary restraining order (TRO) is a court order that preserves the status quo of the parties until there is an opportunity to hold a full hearing on an application for a preliminary injunction. But since the employer is not a party to the suit and a TRO provides only a temporary solution, it is not the most efficient action.

Educational objective: A court may modify or quash a subpoena that requires disclosing (1) an unretained expert's opinion or information that does not describe specific occurrences in dispute and results from the expert's independent study instead of a party's request or (2) trade secrets or other confidential research, development, or commercial information.

选项正确率统计：A选项 22%，B选项 56%（正确选项），C选项 6%，D选项 14%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

撤销或修改传票


(FRCP 45(d)(3))
强制性规定
法院必须撤销或修改具有以下情形的传票：
  • 未能给予合理的遵从时间
  • 要求个人在超出地理范围限制之外遵从
  • 要求披露享有特免权或受保护的事项或
  • 使个人承受不当负担
裁量性规定
法院可以撤销或修改要求披露以下内容的传票：
  • 非当事人聘请的专家的意见或信息，而该意见或信息 (1) 未描述争议中的事件，且 (2) 源于该专家并非应任何一方请求而进行的研究
  • 商业秘密或机密的研究、开发或商业信息
FRCP = 《联邦民事诉讼规则》（Federal Rule of Civil Procedure）。

传票（subpoena）是一份书面法院命令，强制个人（当事人或非当事人）到庭或参加庭外取证（deposition），或出示其占有的文件或物品。† 根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第45(d)条，收到传票的个人可提交动议以修改或撤销该传票。如果传票要求披露以下内容，法院可以批准该动议：

  • 非当事人聘请的专家证人的意见或信息，而该意见或信息 (1) 未描述争议中的特定事件，且 (2) 源于该专家的独立研究而非任何一方的请求或
  • 商业秘密或其他机密的研究、开发或商业信息。


在本案中，该女子向前雇主（非当事人）送达传票，要求其出示服装设计的副本。鉴于该前雇主担心披露会泄露其商业秘密，且提交动议相对而言成本效益较高，因此防止披露最有效的行动是提交动议以撤销传票。

†被命令出示文件或物品的个人无需亲自出现在出示或检查地点，除非其同时被命令出席庭外取证、听证会或审判。

(选项 A) 一般而言，商业秘密不享有特免权。如果享有，法院将被要求修改或撤销强制披露该特免信息的传票。

(选项 C) 非当事人可以为了保护自身利益而介入（即加入）并全面参与正在进行的诉讼。但在本案中，除了该传票外，前雇主在正在进行的诉讼中并无其他利益，他可以通过提交撤销传票的动议来有效地保护此项利益。

(选项 D) 临时限制令（TRO）是一种法院命令，旨在维持各方现状，直到有机会就初步禁令（preliminary injunction）的申请举行全面听证会为止。但由于该前雇主并非案件当事人，且临时限制令仅提供临时解决方案，因此它不是最有效的行动。

教学目的：法院可以修改或撤销要求披露以下内容的传票：(1) 非当事人聘请的专家的意见或信息，而该意见或信息未描述争议中的特定事件，且源于该专家的独立研究而非任何一方的请求；或 (2) 商业秘密或其他机密的研究、开发或商业信息。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 45(d)(3) (modifying or quashing a subpoena).

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Discovery & Subpoenas
核心法律规则 (FRCP 45)

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第 45(d)(3) 条，法院对传票 (Subpoena) 的处理分为两种情况：

  1. 必须撤销 (Must Quash)：如果传票要求披露享有特免权 (Privileged) 的信息，或造成不当负担。
  2. 可以撤销 (May Quash)：如果传票要求披露商业秘密 (Trade Secrets) 或其他机密商业信息。

程序路径：收到传票的非当事人 (Non-party) 应向法院提交撤销或修改传票的动议 (Motion to Quash or Modify)。

正确答案分析
正确选项：B

提交动议以撤销传票 (File a motion to quash the subpoena)

在本案中，前雇主是非当事人，且担心披露的是商业秘密。虽然商业秘密不像律师-客户特权那样享有绝对保护，但 FRCP 45 明确允许法院在涉及商业秘密时行使裁量权撤销传票。

效率分析：这是最直接、最符合程序规定且成本最低的方法。雇主只需针对传票本身提出异议，无需卷入整个诉讼。

为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A：主张特免权 (Claim Privilege)

陷阱点：虽然商业秘密受保护，但在联邦证据规则下，它通常不被视为一种“特免权” (Privilege)（如 Attorney-Client Privilege）。

即使它被视为特免权，单纯“主张”是不够的，程序上仍然需要通过反对传票或提交动议来由法院裁定。

选项 C：介入案件 (Intervene)

效率低：介入 (Intervention, FRCP 24) 意味着非当事人正式加入诉讼成为当事人。对于仅仅想保护文件不被披露的前雇主来说，这不仅程序复杂，而且成本高昂，属于“杀鸡用牛刀”。

选项 D：临时限制令 (TRO)

适用错误：TRO 通常用于紧急情况下维持现状，防止不可挽回的损害，通常针对当事人的行为。对于证据开示中的传票争议，专门的程序工具是 Motion to Quash，而不是申请 TRO。

MBE 答题技巧

1. 识别身份：注意题目中涉及的是“非当事人” (Non-party)。非当事人对抗法院命令（传票）的标准动作通常是 Motion to Quash。

2. 区分概念：分清 Privilege (绝对保护，如律师客户) 与 Confidential/Trade Secret (有条件的保护，法院可权衡利弊)。

3. 关注“效率”：题目问 "most efficient action"。在民诉题中，选择最直接针对争议点的程序工具，避免过度诉讼（如介入案件）。

questions.question:
A woman bought a piece of farmland in the state where she resides. Three years after this purchase, a man informed her that he held a mortgage against the farmland and that she must pay him.
The woman then filed a quiet title action in an appropriate federal court in the state where the farmland is located. The man was properly served with the complaint and summons.
The day after receiving the complaint and summons, the man called the woman and informed her that he co-owns the mortgage on the farmland with his brother. Both the man and his brother live in another state.
What is the easiest action the woman can take to join the man's brother in the suit?

choices.a: File a motion for compulsory joinder.
choices.b: Immediately file and serve an amended complaint listing both siblings as defendants.
choices.c: Move the court for permission to join the other sibling.
choices.d: Voluntarily dismiss the case and refile a complaint naming both siblings as defendants.

Q88192

A woman bought a piece of farmland in the state where she resides. Three years after this purchase, a man informed her that he held a mortgage against the farmland and that she must pay him.

The woman then filed a quiet title action in an appropriate federal court in the state where the farmland is located. The man was properly served with the complaint and summons.

The day after receiving the complaint and summons, the man called the woman and informed her that he co-owns the mortgage on the farmland with his brother. Both the man and his brother live in another state.

What is the easiest action the woman can take to join the man's brother in the suit?

一名女子在她居住的州购买了一块农田。购买三年后，一名男子通知她，他对该农田持有抵押权，她必须向他付款。

该女子随后向农田所在州的相应联邦法院提起了确认产权诉讼。该男子被依法送达了起诉状和传票。

在收到起诉状和传票的第二天，该男子致电该女子，告知她他与他的兄弟共同拥有该农田的抵押权。该男子和他的兄弟都居住在另一个州。

该女子可以采取何种最简便的措施将其兄弟追加为本案当事人？
options:
A. File a motion for compulsory joinder.
提出强制追加当事人的动议。

B. Immediately file and serve an amended complaint listing both siblings as defendants.
立即提交并送达一份将兄弟二人均列为被告的修改后起诉状。

C. Move the court for permission to join the other sibling.
请求法院许可追加另一名兄弟为当事人。

D. Voluntarily dismiss the case and refile a complaint naming both siblings as defendants.
自愿撤诉，并重新提交一份将兄弟二人均列为被告的起诉状。
data.explanation:
Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (FRCP) 19, a person must be joined as a party to a lawsuit in certain situations. Here, for example, the brother is likely a required party in the woman's quiet title action since his absence could prejudice his mortgage interest. And though the woman failed to name him in her complaint, FRCP 15 allows a party to amend a pleading once as a matter of course - ie, without the court's permission or the opposing party's written consent. But this must be done within 21 days after :
  • serving that pleading if a responsive pleading is not required or
  • being served with a responsive pleading or FRCP 12 motion (whichever occurs first) if a responsive pleading is required.
A defendant is required to file and serve an answer in response to the plaintiff's complaint. And since the man has not yet filed an answer (or FRCP 12 motion), the woman can amend her complaint without the court's permission or the man's written consent (Choice C). Therefore, the easiest way the woman can join the brother in the suit is to immediately file and serve an amended complaint listing both siblings as defendants.

(Choice A) Compulsory (ie, required) joinder makes it mandatory to include all necessary parties in a lawsuit - eg, co-owners of property in a quiet title action. Therefore, a defendant would file a motion for compulsory joinder to add any necessary parties, while a plaintiff would simply amend the complaint (as seen here).

(Choice D) A plaintiff may voluntarily dismiss a suit if the plaintiff wants to file it in a different court or has reached a settlement with the defendant. But the plaintiff need not dismiss a complaint to add another party.

Educational objective: A party can amend a pleading once as a matter of course within 21 days (1) after serving that pleading or (2) if a responsive pleading is required, after being served with a responsive pleading or motion under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 12.



选项正确率统计：A选项 29%，B选项 61%（正确选项），C选项 6%，D选项 2%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》(Federal Rule of Civil Procedure, FRCP) 第19条，在特定情况下，某人必须被追加为诉讼当事人。例如，在本案中，该兄弟很可能是女子提起的确认产权诉讼中的必要当事人，因为他的缺席可能会损害其抵押权利益。尽管该女子未在起诉状中指名他，但FRCP第15条允许一方当事人在当然权利下修改一次诉讼文书——即无需法院许可或对方当事人的书面同意。但这必须在以下时间点的21天内完成：
  • 如果不需要回应性诉讼文书，则在送达该诉讼文书之后或
  • 如果需要回应性诉讼文书，则在收到一份回应性诉讼文书或FRCP第12条动议之后（以先到者为准）。
被告需要提交并送达一份答辩状以回应原告的起诉状。由于该男子尚未提交答辩状（或FRCP第12条动议），该女子可以在未经法院许可或该男子书面同意的情况下修改其起诉状（选项C）。因此，该女子追加其兄弟参与诉讼的最简便方法是立即提交并送达一份将兄弟二人均列为被告的修改后起诉状。

（选项A）强制（即必要）追加当事人制度要求必须将所有必要当事人纳入诉讼——例如，确认产权诉讼中的财产共同所有人。因此，被告会提出强制追加当事人的动议以增加任何必要当事人，而原告则只需修改起诉状（如本案所示）。

（选项D）如果原告希望向另一法院提起诉讼或已与被告达成和解，原告可以自愿撤诉。但原告无需为了追加另一当事人而撤销起诉状。

教学目标：一方当事人可以在(1) 送达诉讼文书后的21天内，或(2) 如果需要回应性诉讼文书，在收到回应性诉讼文书或根据Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 12提出的动议后的21天内，当然地修改一次诉讼文书。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 15(a) (amending complaint before trial).

Fed. R. Civ. P. 19 (required joinder of parties).

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Pretrial Procedures
正确答案：B 立即提交并送达一份将兄弟二人均列为被告的修改后起诉状。
(Immediately file and serve an amended complaint listing both siblings as defendants.)
核心考点：当然权利修改诉状

本题考察的是 FRCP 15(a) 关于修改诉状（Amended Pleadings）的规则。这是MBE民事诉讼法中非常高频的考点。

根据规则，当事人有一次机会可以作为“当然权利” (as a matter of course) 修改其诉状，即不需要法院的许可，也不需要对方当事人的同意。

时间限制是关键：

  • 如果在送达后 21天内；或者
  • 如果该诉状需要回应（如起诉状需要答辩状），则在收到回应性诉讼文书（Responsive Pleading）或 FRCP 12 动议后的 21天内。
本案时间线分析
Day 0: 女子提起诉讼并送达起诉状给男子。
Day 1: 男子告知还有一个共同拥有人（兄弟）。
(此时处于21天窗口期内，且被告尚未提交答辩状)
Action: 原告可以直接修改起诉状加入兄弟。

题目问的是“最简便” (Easiest) 的措施。因为还在窗口期内，原告可以直接行使修改权，无需任何繁琐的动议程序。

为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A (Motion for compulsory joinder): 错误。虽然根据 FRCP 19，兄弟是必要当事人，但“动议”通常是被告用来强迫原告加人的手段，或者在原告错过了自动修改期后才使用。既然原告可以直接改，何必多此一举去写动议？
选项 C (Move for permission): 错误。只有在 21 天窗口期过期后，或者已经修改过一次后，才需要请求法院许可 (Leave of Court)。现在请求许可是多余的。
选项 D (Voluntarily dismiss and refile): 错误。这是最笨拙的方法。虽然可以这样做，但需要重新缴纳诉讼费并重新启动程序，绝不是“最简便”的。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 当题目询问“最佳” (Best) 或 “最简便” (Easiest) 的程序性措施时，通常是在考察是否存在一种无需法院介入 (Without Court Intervention) 的自动权利。

看到“修改诉状” (Amending Complaint) 的题目，第一反应检查是否在 21天 的自动修改窗口期内。如果是，直接修改永远是标准答案。

A plaintiff brought a diversity action against a defendant in federal court. During discovery, the plaintiff orally deposed the defendant. Upon completion of that deposition, the plaintiff sought to depose the defendant again, which would be the tenth deposition taken by the plaintiff in the case.
The plaintiff served the defendant with written notice stating the time and place of the deposition. Upon receipt of the notice, the defendant's attorney called the plaintiff's attorney to tell him that the defendant would not appear at the deposition. The plaintiff's attorney demanded that the defendant appear as noticed. Neither the defendant nor the defendant's attorney appeared at the deposition. The plaintiff's attorney has moved for sanctions.
Is the court likely to impose sanctions?

choices.a: No, because the defendant had already been deposed in the action.
choices.b: No, because the plaintiff failed to serve a subpoena to compel the defendant's attendance.
choices.c: Yes, because the defendant received written notice of the deposition.
choices.d: Yes, because the plaintiff is entitled to take up to 10 depositions.

一名原告在联邦法院对一名被告提起了多元管辖权诉讼。在证据开示程序中，原告对被告进行了口头庭外取证。该次取证完成后，原告试图再次对被告进行取证，这将是原告在本案中进行的第十次庭外取证。

原告向被告送达了书面通知，说明了庭外取证的时间和地点。收到通知后，被告的律师致电原告律师，告知被告不会出席该次庭外取证。原告律师要求被告按通知出席。被告及其律师均未出席该次庭外取证。原告律师已动议要求制裁。

法院是否可能施加制裁？
options:
A. No, because the defendant had already been deposed in the action.
不会，因为被告在该诉讼中已经被取证过。

B. No, because the plaintiff failed to serve a subpoena to compel the defendant's attendance.
不会，因为原告未能送达传票以强制被告出席。

C. Yes, because the defendant received written notice of the deposition.
会，因为被告收到了庭外取证的书面通知。

D. Yes, because the plaintiff is entitled to take up to 10 depositions.
会，因为原告有权进行最多10次庭外取证。
data.explanation:
Leave of court for oral or written deposition


Court's leave or parties' stipulation required to conduct deposition when:
  • deposition exceeds 10-deposition limit
  • deposition sought before parties' initial planning conference or
  • deponent already deposed in action
Leave of court is always required when deponent is in prison.

An oral deposition is a method of discovery in which the deposing party conducts an oral examination of another party or nonparty (deponent) under oath and outside of court. To compel the attendance and testimony of a party deponent, the deposing party must provide the party deponent with written notice. If the party deponent fails to attend, the federal court may impose sanctions.

Notice may be provided and the deposition conducted without the court's leave (ie, permission) or the parties' stipulation unless :
  • the deposition exceeds the 10-deposition limit (which includes both oral and written depositions)
  • the deposition is sought before the parties' initial planning conference† or
  • the deponent was already deposed in the action.


Here, the plaintiff sought to conduct an oral deposition of the defendant after the defendant had already been deposed in the action. Since the plaintiff failed to obtain the court's leave and the parties did not stipulate to the second deposition, the plaintiff's written notice to the defendant was improper (Choice C). As a result, the defendant was not required to attend the deposition, and the court is unlikely to impose sanctions.

†Leave of court or the parties' stipulation is not required for an oral deposition conducted before the initial planning conference if the deposing party certifies (and provides supporting facts) in the notice that the deponent is expected to leave the U.S and be unavailable for examination.

(Choice B) A subpoena is required to compel a nonparty deponent's attendance at an oral deposition. But a party deponent can be compelled to attend through written notice.

(Choice D) Although the plaintiff was entitled to take up to 10 depositions, leave of court or a stipulation between the parties was required before the plaintiff could depose the defendant a second time.

Educational objective: A party may provide notice of and conduct an oral deposition without the court's leave or the parties' stipulation unless (1) the deposition exceeds the 10-deposition limit, (2) the deposition is sought before the initial planning conference, or (3) the deponent was already deposed in the case.

选项正确率统计：A选项 53%（正确选项），B选项 17%，C选项 11%，D选项 17%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

进行口头或书面庭外取证的法院许可


在以下情况下进行庭外取证需获得法院许可或双方当事人约定：
  • 庭外取证超过10次的限制
  • 在双方当事人初次计划会议前寻求进行庭外取证 或
  • 取证对象已在该诉讼中被取证过
当取证对象在监狱中时，始终需要获得法院的许可。

口头庭外取证是一种证据开示方法，取证方在法庭外对另一方当事人或非当事人（取证对象）在宣誓下进行口头询问。为强制一方当事人作为取证对象出席并作证，取证方必须向该当事人提供书面通知。如果该当事人未能出席，联邦法院可施加制裁。

提供通知和进行庭外取证可以无需法院的许可（即permission）或双方当事人的约定，除非：
  • 该庭外取证超过10次的限制（包括口头和书面庭外取证）
  • 该庭外取证是在双方当事人的初次计划会议†前寻求进行的 或
  • 该取证对象已在该诉讼中被取证过。


在本案中，原告在被告已于该诉讼中被取证过后，再次寻求对被告进行口头庭外取证。由于原告未能获得法院的许可，且双方当事人也未约定进行第二次庭外取证，因此原告向被告发出的书面通知是不当的(选项C)。因此，被告没有义务出席该次庭外取证，法院也不太可能施加制裁。

†如果在初次计划会议前进行的口头庭外取证，取证方在通知中证明（并提供支持性事实）取证对象预计将离开美国且无法接受询问，则无需法院许可或双方当事人约定。

(选项B) 强制非当事人取证对象出席口头庭外取证需要传票。但当事人取证对象可通过书面通知被强制出席。

(选项D) 尽管原告有权进行最多10次庭外取证，但在第二次对被告进行取证之前，需要获得法院的许可或双方当事人的约定。

教学目标：一方当事人可以无需法院许可或双方当事人约定而发出通知并进行口头庭外取证，除非（1）庭外取证超过10次的限制，（2）在初次计划会议前寻求进行庭外取证，或（3）取证对象已在该案中被取证过。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 30(a) (when court's leave or parties' stipulation required for oral deposition).

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure / Pretrial Procedures
正确答案：A 法院不太可能施加制裁，因为被告在该诉讼中已经被取证过，而原告未获得法院许可或双方约定。
核心考点：庭外取证的限制 (FRCP 30)

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》(FRCP) 第30条，通常情况下，一方当事人进行口头庭外取证 (Oral Deposition) 不需要法院许可。

但是，在以下三种情况下，必须获得法院许可 (Leave of Court) 或 双方当事人约定 (Stipulation)：

1.
重复取证：取证对象已经在该诉讼中被取证过 (Deponent already deposed)。
(本题考点)
2.
超额取证：该次取证将导致该方进行的取证总数超过 10 次。
3.
过早取证：在双方初次计划会议 (Rule 26(f) conference) 之前寻求取证。
本案分析

原告已经对被告进行了一次取证。现在原告想要进行第二次取证。

尽管这是原告的第10次取证（未超过总数限制），但因为是对同一人的重复取证，原告必须先获得法院许可或被告同意。

原告仅发出了通知 (Notice) 而未获得许可，该通知无效。因此，被告拒绝出席是合法的，法院不会施加制裁。

为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 B 错误 (Subpoena)：
这是一个常见的 MBE 陷阱。对于当事人 (Party)，只需送达取证通知 (Notice) 即可强制其出席，不需要传票 (Subpoena)。传票仅用于强制非当事人 (Non-party) 出席。
选项 C 错误 (Written Notice)：
虽然被告确实收到了通知，但该通知本身在程序上是有缺陷的（因为缺少法院许可）。程序违规的通知不能产生强制出席的义务。
选项 D 错误 (10 Depositions)：
原告确实有权进行最多 10 次取证，但这指的是总数，而不是针对同一个人的次数。针对同一人的第二次取证始终需要特殊许可，无论总数是否达标。
💡 MBE 备考锦囊：

看到 "Deposition"（庭外取证）题目时，迅速检查两个数字：
  • 10次：一方当事人总共只能进行10次取证。
  • 1次：每个人（无论是当事人还是证人）通常只能被取证1次。

如果题目中出现 "Depose again" 或 "Second deposition"，立即寻找是否有 "Leave of court"（法院许可）。如果没有，该取证请求通常是不当的。

questions.question:
A landowner sued a company in a federal district court in State A for violating a federal environmental statute. The landowner alleged that the company dumped chemicals into a stream, which polluted the groundwater near his home. The company denied the landowner's allegation and sought to prove that its waste system prevents chemicals from being dumped into the stream. The company's attorney signed and issued a subpoena that required the engineer who designed the waste system to testify at trial. The engineer was personally served with the subpoena, which contained the contents required by the federal rules. The courthouse where the engineer will testify is 81 miles away from where she resides.
The engineer has asked her attorney's advice as to whether she must comply with the subpoena and testify at trial.
What advice should the engineer's attorney give?

choices.a: The engineer must comply with the subpoena if the company's attorney is authorized to practice in State A's federal court.
choices.b: The engineer must comply with the subpoena if the landowner signed it.
choices.c: The engineer need not comply with the subpoena because she is not a party to the suit.
choices.d: The engineer need not comply with the subpoena because the courthouse is located more than 75 miles from where she resides.

questions.question:
An entrepreneur from State A sued a company incorporated and headquartered in State B in federal court in State B to recover $100,000 in damages. The entrepreneur alleged that the company breached their contract by disclosing confidential information supplied by the entrepreneur's consultant, a U.S. citizen who resides in a foreign country. The company denies receiving this information from the consultant.
The entrepreneur asked the consultant to voluntarily attend a deposition or submit an affidavit, but he refused. The entrepreneur then moved for, and the court issued a subpoena requiring, the consultant's appearance at a deposition in State B. The consultant was served with the subpoena by mail in accordance with an international agreement signed by the foreign country. The subpoena contained the contents required by federal rules and stated that the consultant must pay his own expenses to attend the deposition.
What is the consultant's best argument that he does not need to comply with the subpoena?

choices.a: The consultant's testimony is unnecessary in the interest of justice.
choices.b: The court lacks authority to issue a subpoena for a person in a foreign country.
choices.c: The entrepreneur failed to pay the consultant's travel and attendance expenses.
choices.d: The entrepreneur used an improper method to serve the subpoena.

一名来自A州的创业者在B州的联邦法院起诉了一家在B州注册成立且总部设在B州的公司，要求赔偿10万美元的损失。该创业者声称，该公司违反了合同，披露了由该创业者的顾问提供的机密信息。该顾问是一名居住在外国的美国公民。该公司否认从该顾问处收到了这些信息。

该创业者请求该顾问自愿参加庭外质证或提交书面证词，但顾问拒绝了。该创业者随后提出动议，法院据此签发了一张传票，要求该顾问出席在B州举行的庭外质证。根据该外国签署的一项国际协议，该顾问通过邮寄方式收到了传票的送达。该传票包含了联邦规则所要求的内容，并声明该顾问必须自行支付出席庭外质证的费用。

该顾问可以提出的、无需遵守该传票的最佳抗辩理由是什么？
options:
A. The consultant's testimony is unnecessary in the interest of justice.
从司法公正的角度来看，该顾问的证言并非必要。

B. The court lacks authority to issue a subpoena for a person in a foreign country.
法院无权向身在外国的人员签发传票。

C. The entrepreneur failed to pay the consultant's travel and attendance expenses.
该创业者未能支付顾问的差旅费和出席费。

D. The entrepreneur used an improper method to serve the subpoena.
该创业者使用了不当的方法送达传票。
data.explanation:
A subpoena is a written court order that generally commands a person to testify at a trial, hearing, or deposition. Federal courts have the authority to subpoena U.S. citizens in a foreign country † (eg, the consultant) pursuant to special rules governing the issuance and service of such subpoenas (Choice B). Such a subpoena is validly issued when it:
  • contains the required contents (as seen here)

  • is issued from the court where the action is pending (as seen here) and

  • seeks testimony that is (1) necessary in the interest of justice and (2) impractical to obtain in an admissible form without the witness's personal appearance.

Here, the consultant's testimony about the disclosure of confidential information is necessary in the interest of justice because it is the basis for the entrepreneur's breach-of-contract claim (Choice A). And it is impractical to obtain this testimony without the consultant's appearance because he refused to voluntarily attend a deposition or submit an affidavit. As a result, the subpoena was validly issued.

The entrepreneur then had to validly serve the subpoena on the consultant by:
  • using a method of service that the federal rules allow for service of process in a foreign country (eg, pursuant to an international agreement) and

  • paying the consultant's travel and attendance expenses.

Here, the consultant was served with the subpoena by mail. This is a proper method of service since an international agreement signed by the foreign country permits such service (Choice D). However, the subpoena was invalidly served because the entrepreneur failed to pay the consultant's travel and attendance expenses. As a result, this is the consultant's best argument that he does not need to comply with the subpoena.

†A federal court may not issue subpoenas to foreign citizens in foreign countries since they owe no allegiance to the U.S.

Educational objective: Federal courts can subpoena U.S. citizens in a foreign country when their testimony is necessary in the interest of justice and impractical to obtain by other means. Such subpoenas are validly served when the serving party (1) uses a method of service allowed by the federal rules and (2) pays the citizen's attendance and travel expenses.



选项正确率统计：A选项 11%，B选项 24%，C选项 58%（正确选项），D选项 5%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

传票 (subpoena) 是一份书面法院命令，通常指令某人在审判、听证会或庭外质证中作证。根据管辖此类传票签发和送达的特殊规则，联邦法院有权向在外国的美国公民†（例如，本案中的顾问）发出传票（选项B）。此类传票在以下情况下被视为有效签发：
  • 包含所要求的内容（如本案所示）

  • 由审理该案件的法院签发（如本案所示）并且

  • 其寻求的证言 (1) 为司法公正所必需，且 (2) 在没有证人亲自出庭的情况下，无法以可采纳的形式实际获取。

在本案中，该顾问关于机密信息泄露的证言是司法公正所必需的，因为它是该创业者违约索赔的基础（选项A）。并且，在没有该顾问出席的情况下，无法实际获取此证言，因为他拒绝了自愿参加庭外质证或提交书面证词的请求。因此，该传票的签发是有效的。

然后，该创业者必须通过以下方式向顾问有效送达传票：
  • 使用联邦规则所允许的在外国送达法律文书的方法（例如，根据国际协议）并且

  • 支付该顾问的差旅费和出席费。

在本案中，顾问是通过邮寄方式收到传票送达的。这是一种正当的送达方式，因为该外国签署的一项国际协议允许此类送达（选项D）。然而，由于创业者未能支付顾问的差旅费和出席费，该传票的送达是无效的。因此，这是该顾问可以提出的、无需遵守该传票的最佳抗辩理由。

†联邦法院不得向在外国的外国公民签发传票，因为他们对美国没有效忠义务。

教学要点：当在外国的美国公民的证言为司法公正所必需，且无法通过其他方式实际获取时，联邦法院可以向其发出传票。当送达方 (1) 使用联邦规则所允许的送达方法，并且 (2) 支付该公民的出席费和差旅费时，此类传票即为有效送达。

References

  • 28 U.S.C. § 1783 (subpoena of person in foreign country).


  • 9A Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 2462 (3d ed. 2020) (explaining the requirements to issue and serve subpoenas to U.S. citizens in foreign countries).

MBE 考点解析

Federal Civil Procedure
✅ 正确答案：C 该顾问无需遵守传票，因为原告（创业者）未能预付差旅费和出席费。
⚖️ 核心法律依据：Walsh Act

本题考查的是联邦法院向身在国外的美国公民签发传票的特殊规则，依据主要来自 28 U.S.C. § 1783。

要成功传唤身在国外的美国公民，必须满足以下三个条件：

  1. 身份管辖：对象必须是美国国民或居民（U.S. national or resident）。
  2. 必要性与可行性：证词必须是“司法公正所必需的”（necessary in the interest of justice），且无法通过其他方式（如书面证词）获得。
  3. 送达与费用：必须妥当送达，且必须预付预计的差旅费和出席费。
🔍 案情关键点分析
🇺🇸
身份符合：顾问是居住在国外的美国公民，因此联邦法院有权对其行使管辖权（反驳选项 B）。
⚖️
必要性符合：顾问是关键证人，且拒绝自愿配合，因此必须强制传唤（反驳选项 A）。
📩
送达方式符合：通过国际协议允许的邮件方式送达是有效的（反驳选项 D）。
💰
费用支付违规（致命伤）：题目明确指出传票声明顾问必须“支付自己的费用”（pay his own expenses）。

根据 28 U.S.C. § 1783(b)，向身在国外的证人送达传票时，必须同时提供（tender）预计的差旅费和出席费。未能提供费用使得传票的送达无效，证人没有义务遵守。

❌ 为什么其他选项错误
  • 选项 A：证词是违约索赔的核心，且无法通过其他途径获得，因此符合“司法公正”的要求。
  • 选项 B：联邦法院对美国公民拥有全球管辖权（基于效忠义务），即使他们身在国外。注意：如果是外国公民在国外，法院通常无权传唤。
  • 选项 D：题目已说明送达方式符合国际协议，因此程序上没有瑕疵。
🎓 考试技巧：
在涉及 Subpoena（传票）的题目中，永远检查两个要素：
1. 送达方式 (Service of Process)
2. 费用支付 (Tender of Fees)
对于传唤证人，缺一不可。

questions.question:
An injured pedestrian filed a diversity action in federal court against a truck driver. The truck driver filed an answer in which he denied liability and asserted an affirmative defense that the pedestrian was contributorily negligent. The truck driver did not assert any counterclaims against the pedestrian in his answer. Thirty days later, the pedestrian seeks to file a pleading to respond to the allegations in the truck driver's answer. The court has not yet issued any orders in the case.
May the pedestrian file a response?

choices.a: No, because the pedestrian did not file a reply within 14 days after the answer was filed.
choices.b: No, because the truck driver did not assert a counterclaim and the court did not order a reply.
choices.c: Yes, because due process allows the pedestrian to file a reply.
choices.d: Yes, because the truck driver asserted an affirmative defense.

questions.question:
A distributor brought a diversity action against a manufacturer in federal district court for breach of contract. The district court ordered the parties' attorneys to attend a pretrial conference to obtain admissions and stipulations about the facts in the case. When the conference started, the manufacturer's attorney announced that his client had not authorized him to make admissions or stipulations. The district court canceled the conference as a result. This was the third time the court had to cancel a pretrial conference due to the attorney's failure to obtain authorization to make admissions or stipulations on behalf of his client.
After the conference, the district court issued an order that struck one of the manufacturer's affirmative defenses and required the manufacturer to pay the attorney's fees incurred by the distributor for attending the pretrial conference. At the conclusion of trial, the manufacturer appealed the order.
Is the appellate court likely to reverse the district court's order?

choices.a: No, because the district court has absolute discretion to issue sanctions.
choices.b: No, because the order was reasonable under the circumstances.
choices.c: Yes, because the district court is limited to requiring the manufacturer to pay the distributor's attorney's fees.
choices.d: Yes, because the manufacturer did not authorize the attorney to make admissions or stipulations.

A distributor brought a diversity action against a manufacturer in federal district court for breach of contract. The district court ordered the parties' attorneys to attend a pretrial conference to obtain admissions and stipulations about the facts in the case. When the conference started, the manufacturer's attorney announced that his client had not authorized him to make admissions or stipulations. The district court canceled the conference as a result. This was the third time the court had to cancel a pretrial conference due to the attorney's failure to obtain authorization to make admissions or stipulations on behalf of his client.

After the conference, the district court issued an order that struck one of the manufacturer's affirmative defenses and required the manufacturer to pay the attorney's fees incurred by the distributor for attending the pretrial conference. At the conclusion of trial, the manufacturer appealed the order.

Is the appellate court likely to reverse the district court's order?

一名分销商因合同违约在联邦地区法院对一名制造商提起了多元管辖权诉讼。地区法院命令双方律师参加庭前会议，以获取对案件事实的承认和约定。会议开始时，制造商的律师声称其客户未授权他作出任何承认或约定。因此，地区法院取消了此次会议。这是法院第三次因该律师未能获得其客户的授权以作出承认或约定而不得不取消庭前会议。

会议结束后，地区法院发布了一项命令，驳回了制造商的一项积极抗辩，并要求制造商支付分销商因参加庭前会议而产生的律师费。审判结束后，制造商对该命令提起了上诉。

上诉法院是否可能推翻地区法院的命令？
options:
A. No, because the district court has absolute discretion to issue sanctions.
不会，因为地区法院在发布制裁方面拥有绝对的自由裁量权。

B. No, because the order was reasonable under the circumstances.
不会，因为在该情况下，该命令是合理的。

C. Yes, because the district court is limited to requiring the manufacturer to pay the distributor's attorney's fees.
会，因为地区法院的权限仅限于要求制造商支付分销商的律师费。

D. Yes, because the manufacturer did not authorize the attorney to make admissions or stipulations.
会，因为制造商并未授权律师作出承认或约定。
data.explanation:
A federal district court may order the attorneys and any unrepresented parties to attend one or more pretrial conferences. These conferences are designed to improve the trial's quality, facilitate settlement, and expedite litigation (eg, by obtaining admissions and stipulations). To promote those goals, a district court may impose reasonable sanctions on any party or attorney who:
  • failed to attend a pretrial conference
  • was substantially unprepared to participate in the conference
  • did not participate in good faith in the conference or
  • failed to obey a pretrial order.
Here, the manufacturer's attorney was substantially unprepared to participate in the pretrial conference because he failed to obtain the manufacturer's authorization to make admissions and stipulations. This led the district court to strike one of the manufacturer's affirmative defenses. This sanction was reasonable since this was the third time the court had to cancel a pretrial conference due to the attorney's failure to obtain such authorization (Choice C).

Additionally, a court must order a noncompliant party and/or attorney to pay the other party's reasonable expenses , including attorney's fees, unless (1) the noncompliance was substantially justified or (2) the payment would be unjust. The attorney's unpreparedness was not substantially justified because he should have obtained the manufacturer's authorization before the conference (Choice D). And since there is no indication that awarding attorney's fees would be unjust, the appellate court will likely affirm the order.

(Choice A) Although the district court has discretion to decide which sanctions to impose, this discretion is not absolute. The reason is that an appellate court has the power to reverse a district court's arbitrary or unreasonable sanction as an abuse of discretion (not seen here).

Educational objective: A federal court may issue reasonable sanctions against any party or attorney who is substantially unprepared to participate in a pretrial conference. Additionally, a court must order the payment of the opposing party's reasonable expenses unless (1) noncompliance was substantially justified or (2) the payment would be unjust.



选项正确率统计：A选项 13%，B选项 55%（正确选项），C选项 27%，D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

联邦地区法院可以命令律师及任何未被代理的当事人参加一次或多次庭前会议。这些会议旨在提高审判质量、促进和解并加快诉讼进程（例如，通过获取承认和约定）。为实现这些目标，地区法院可以对有以下行为的任何当事人或律师施加合理的制裁：
  • 未能出席庭前会议
  • 为参加会议准备严重不足
  • 未本着诚信原则参加会议或
  • 未能遵守庭前命令。
在本案中，制造商的律师因未能获得制造商作出承认和约定的授权，而属于为参加庭前会议准备严重不足。这导致地区法院驳回了制造商的一项积极抗辩。此项制裁是合理的，因为这已是法院第三次因该律师未能获得此等授权而不得不取消庭前会议（选项C）。

此外，法院必须命令违规的当事人和/或律师支付另一方因此产生的合理费用，包括律师费，除非（1）违规行为有充分正当的理由，或（2）支付费用会导致不公。该律师的准备不足并无充分正当的理由，因为他本应在会议前获得制造商的授权（选项D）。而且，由于没有迹象表明判付律师费会导致不公，上诉法院很可能会维持原命令。

（选项A）尽管地区法院有权决定施加何种制裁，但这种自由裁量权并非绝对。原因是，上诉法院有权以滥用自由裁量权为由，推翻地区法院任意或不合理的制裁（本案中未见此情况）。

教学目标：联邦法院可以对为参加庭前会议准备严重不足的任何当事人或律师施加合理的制裁。此外，法院必须命令支付对方的合理费用，除非（1）违规行为有充分正当的理由，或（2）支付费用会导致不公。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 16(f) (pretrial conference sanctions).

6A Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 1531 (3d ed. 2020) (explaining when sanctions are appropriate for failure to comply with pretrial conference and/or order).
