MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Pretrial Sanctions

⚖️ 核心法律规则

根据 Fed. R. Civ. P. 16(f)，如果当事人或其律师出现以下情况，法院可以发出任何公正的命令（包括严厉制裁）：

  • 未能出席庭前会议 (Fail to appear)；
  • 准备严重不足 (Substantially unprepared)；
  • 未本着诚信原则参与 (Fail to participate in good faith)。
关键点：“准备严重不足”包括律师出席了会议，但未获得客户授权进行必要的承认 (Admissions) 或约定 (Stipulations)。
✅ 正确答案：B

不会推翻，因为在该情况下，该命令是合理的。

1
违规行为认定：
制造商律师出席了庭前会议，但没有获得客户授权进行承认或约定。这构成了 Rule 16 下的“准备严重不足”(Substantially Unprepared)。
2
制裁的合理性 (Reasonableness)：
题目强调这是第三次 (Third time) 因同样原因取消会议。法院有权根据 Rule 37(b)(2)(A) 实施制裁，包括驳回抗辩 (Striking pleadings)。鉴于屡教不改的情节，这一严厉制裁并未滥用自由裁量权。
3
强制性费用 (Mandatory Fees)：
Rule 16(f)(2) 要求法院命令违规方支付对方的合理费用（包括律师费），除非违规有正当理由或导致不公。本案中无正当理由。
❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 A 错： “绝对的自由裁量权 (Absolute Discretion)”
法院的权力很大，但不是绝对的。上诉法院可以审查地区法院是否滥用自由裁量权 (Abuse of Discretion)。如果制裁过于任意或不合理，上诉法院会推翻它。但在本案中，制裁是合理的。
选项 C 错： “权限仅限于支付律师费”
Rule 16 允许法院实施 Rule 37 中的各种制裁，不仅限于金钱惩罚，还包括驳回起诉、驳回抗辩、禁止提出证据等程序性制裁。
选项 D 错： “因为制造商未授权”
这正是受制裁的原因，而不是推翻制裁的理由。律师有义务确保在参加庭前会议时拥有必要的授权。未获授权不能作为逃避制裁的借口 (Defense)。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧

在涉及制裁 (Sanctions) 的题目中，注意寻找“重复违规”或“恶意”的事实细节。

如果是初犯，驳回抗辩或直接判输可能被视为“滥用自由裁量权”；但如果是屡次违规 (Third time)，法院采取严厉措施通常会被上诉法院维持 (Affirmed)。

questions.question:
A miner sued a coal company in a federal district court to recover damages for severe injuries he sustained during a mining explosion. Sixty days prior to trial, the company's attorney interviewed a forklift operator who witnessed the incident. The operator stated that he saw the miner violate several safety protocols leading up to the explosion.
At trial, the company sought to have the forklift operator testify to support its contributory negligence defense. The miner's attorney objected and moved for sanctions on the ground that the company had failed to disclose the operator's identity prior to trial. The company's attorney stated that she did not disclose the operator's identity because the miner's attorney never made a formal request.
The district court then sanctioned the company by (1) prohibiting the operator from testifying, (2) informing the jury of the company's nondisclosure, and (3) ordering the company to pay the miner's reasonable expenses. After the jury returned a verdict for the miner, the company appealed the sanctions.
How should the appellate court rule?

choices.a: Affirm all the sanctions.
choices.b: Affirm the sanction ordering the company to pay the miner's reasonable expenses but reverse the other sanctions.
choices.c: Affirm the sanction prohibiting the operator from testifying at trial but reverse the other sanctions.
choices.d: Reverse all the sanctions.

Q88249

A miner sued a coal company in a federal district court to recover damages for severe injuries he sustained during a mining explosion. Sixty days prior to trial, the company's attorney interviewed a forklift operator who witnessed the incident. The operator stated that he saw the miner violate several safety protocols leading up to the explosion.

At trial, the company sought to have the forklift operator testify to support its contributory negligence defense. The miner's attorney objected and moved for sanctions on the ground that the company had failed to disclose the operator's identity prior to trial. The company's attorney stated that she did not disclose the operator's identity because the miner's attorney never made a formal request.

The district court then sanctioned the company by (1) prohibiting the operator from testifying, (2) informing the jury of the company's nondisclosure, and (3) ordering the company to pay the miner's reasonable expenses. After the jury returned a verdict for the miner, the company appealed the sanctions.

How should the appellate court rule?

一名矿工在联邦地区法院起诉一家煤炭公司，要求赔偿其在一次矿井爆炸中受到的重伤。庭审前六十天，该公司的律师约谈了一名目睹了事故的叉车操作员。该操作员称，他看到矿工在爆炸前违反了多项安全规程。

庭审时，该公司试图让该叉车操作员作证，以支持其共同过失的抗辩。矿工的律师提出异议，并以该公司在审前未能披露该操作员身份为由，申请进行制裁。该公司律师则表示，她没有披露该操作员的身份，是因为矿工的律师从未提出过正式请求。

随后，地区法院对该公司实施了制裁，包括(1) 禁止该操作员作证，(2) 将该公司的未披露行为告知陪审团，以及(3) 命令该公司支付矿工的合理开支。在陪审团作出有利于矿工的裁决后，该公司对这些制裁提起了上诉。

上诉法院应如何裁决？
options:
A. Affirm all the sanctions.
维持所有制裁。

B. Affirm the sanction ordering the company to pay the miner's reasonable expenses but reverse the other sanctions.
维持命令该公司支付矿工合理开支的制裁，但撤销其他制裁。

C. Affirm the sanction prohibiting the operator from testifying at trial but reverse the other sanctions.
维持禁止该操作员在庭审中作证的制裁，但撤销其他制裁。

D. Reverse all the sanctions.
撤销所有制裁。
data.explanation:
Parties are required to make initial disclosures, disclosures of expert testimony, and pretrial disclosures without waiting for a discovery request. Such required disclosures are designed to prevent surprises at trial. As part of their pretrial disclosures, parties must disclose the identity of witnesses who may testify at trial. Since the company intended to call the forklift operator as a witness, it was required to disclose his identity as part of its pretrial disclosures. However, the company failed to do so.

To underscore the importance of such disclosures, a court has wide discretion to impose sanctions on a party who fails to make required disclosures. The most common sanction is to prohibit the use of the undisclosed information unless the nondisclosure was substantially justified or harmless. In addition to or in lieu of this sanction, the court may:

order the payment of the opposing party's reasonable expenses, including attorney's fees, caused by the nondisclosure inform the jury of the party's failure to disclose and impose any other appropriate sanction (except for contempt of court).

Here, the company provided no justification for its failure to disclose the forklift operator's identity, and this nondisclosure was harmful to the miner since he had no time to prepare for the operator's testimony. As a result, the court did not abuse its discretion in prohibiting the operator from testifying, informing the jury of the nondisclosure, and ordering the company to pay the miner's reasonable expenses. The appellate court should therefore affirm all the sanctions (Choices B, C & D).

Educational objective: A court may impose the following sanctions on a party who fails to make required disclosures:
  • (1) prohibit the use of the undisclosed evidence,
  • (2) order the payment of the opposing party's reasonable expenses,
  • (3) inform the jury of the nondisclosure, and
  • (4) impose any other appropriate sanction (except for contempt of court).




选项正确率统计：A选项 40%（正确选项），B选项 18%，C选项 34%，D选项 7%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

诉讼当事人必须主动进行初始披露、专家证言披露和审前披露，无需等待证据开示请求。此类法定披露旨在防止庭审中出现意外情况。作为审前披露的一部分，当事人必须披露可能在庭审中作证的证人身份。由于该公司打算传唤该叉车操作员作为证人，因此它被要求在审前披露中披露其身份。然而，该公司未能这样做。

为强调此类披露的重要性，法院拥有广泛的裁量权，可对未能进行法定披露的当事人实施制裁。最常见的制裁是禁止使用未披露的信息，除非该未披露行为具有充分正当理由或是无害的。除此项制裁之外或替代此项制裁，法院可以：

命令支付因未披露行为而导致的对方当事人的合理开支，包括律师费；将当事人的未披露行为告知陪审团；以及实施任何其他适当的制裁（藐视法庭罪除外）。

在本案中，该公司未能为其未披露叉车操作员身份的行为提供任何正当理由，并且该未披露行为对矿工是有害的，因为他没有时间为该操作员的证词做准备。因此，法院在禁止该操作员作证、将未披露行为告知陪审团以及命令该公司支付矿工的合理开支方面，并未滥用其裁量权。因此，上诉法院应维持所有制裁（选项 B、C 和 D）。

教学目标：法院可对未能进行法定披露的当事人实施以下制裁：
  • (1) 禁止使用未披露的证据，
  • (2) 命令支付对方当事人的合理开支，
  • (3) 将未披露行为告知陪审团，以及
  • (4) 实施任何其他适当的制裁（藐视法庭罪除外）。


References

  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 26(a) (mandatory-disclosure requirements).
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 37(c)(1) (sanctions for failure to make mandatory disclosures).
  • 8B Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 2289.1 (3d ed. 2020) (explaining when sanctions are appropriate for failure to make required disclosures).

MBE 考点解析

民事诉讼法：证据开示制裁
(Discovery Sanctions)
⚖️ 核心规则：FRCP 37(c)(1) 当事人如果未能根据 Rule 26(a) 或 (e) 提供信息或指明证人，则不得在庭审中使用该信息或证人，除非该未披露行为是“有正当理由的”(substantially justified)或“无害的”(harmless)。
🔍 案情深度解析

本题考察的是违反强制性披露义务(Mandatory Disclosures)后的后果。

1. 披露是自动的，无需请求
根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第26(a)(3)条，当事人必须在庭审前披露其打算传唤的证人名单。这属于审前披露(Pretrial Disclosures)。被告律师辩称“原告从未正式请求”是无效的，因为这些披露是自动触发的。

2. 违规后果：自动排除规则
由于被告未能披露，根据 Rule 37(c)(1)，法院首选的制裁是自动排除该证据（即禁止叉车操作员作证）。

🔨 法院可以施加哪些制裁？

除了排除证据外，Rule 37(c)(1) 明确授权法院在听证后施加额外或替代的制裁。本案中法院施加了以下三项，均符合法律规定：

  • 🚫
    禁止作证 (Exclusion)
    这是默认制裁。因为被告没有正当理由，且对原告造成了实质伤害（无法准备交叉询问）。
  • 📢
    告知陪审团 (Jury Instruction)
    规则明确允许法院将当事人未披露信息的事实告知陪审团。
  • 💰
    支付费用 (Payment of Expenses)
    规则允许法院命令违规方支付因未披露行为导致的对方合理开支（含律师费）。

因此，上诉法院应维持所有制裁 (Affirm all sanctions)。

💡 MBE 解题技巧

在处理 Discovery Sanctions 题目时，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 义务来源：是否属于 Rule 26(a) 的强制披露内容（初始披露、专家披露、审前披露）？如果是，无需对方请求。
  2. 例外测试：未披露是否有“实质性正当理由”或“无害”？（本题中显然有害且无理由）。
  3. 制裁范围：Rule 37(c)(1) 赋予了法官广泛的裁量权(Broad Discretion)。只要不是藐视法庭(Contempt)，上述组合拳通常都是允许的。
© MBE Civil Procedure Review

A dispute arose between a woman and a man over who was entitled to insurance policy proceeds held by a company incorporated and headquartered in the northern district of State A. The woman resides in the southern district of State A, and the man resides in the eastern district of State B.
The company filed a statutory interpleader action against the woman and the man in a federal court in the eastern district of State B. The company posted a bond of $50,000, which represents the amount of the disputed insurance policy proceeds. The woman and the man were served with process at their respective homes. The woman has moved to dismiss the action, claiming that the federal court has no subject-matter jurisdiction over the claim, lacks personal jurisdiction over her, and is not a proper venue.
Is the court likely to grant the woman's motion?

choices.a: No.
choices.b: Yes, because the court lacks personal jurisdiction over her.
choices.c: Yes, because the parties lack complete diversity of citizenship.
choices.d: Yes, because venue is improper.

Q88232

A dispute arose between a woman and a man over who was entitled to insurance policy proceeds held by a company incorporated and headquartered in the northern district of State A. The woman resides in the southern district of State A, and the man resides in the eastern district of State B.

The company filed a statutory interpleader action against the woman and the man in a federal court in the eastern district of State B. The company posted a bond of $50,000, which represents the amount of the disputed insurance policy proceeds. Both the woman and the man were served with process at their respective homes. The woman has moved to dismiss the action, claiming that the federal court has no subject-matter jurisdiction over the claim, lacks personal jurisdiction over her, and is not a proper venue.

一名女性与一名男性就一份保险单的收益归属产生争议，该保险单由一家在A州北区注册成立并设有总部的公司持有。该女性居住在A州南区，该男性居住在B州东区。

该公司在B州东区的联邦法院对该女性和该男性提起了法定互诉（statutory interpleader）诉讼。该公司交存了5万美元的保证金，这代表了争议保险单收益的金额。该女性和该男性均在各自的住所收到了传票送达。该女性已动议驳回该诉讼，声称联邦法院对该诉求没有标的物管辖权，对她缺乏属人管辖权，并且审判地不当。

法院是否可能批准该女性的动议？
options:
A. No.
不会。

B. Yes, because the court has no subject-matter jurisdiction over the claim.
会，因为法院对该诉求没有标的物管辖权。

C. Yes, because the court lacks personal jurisdiction over her.
会，因为法院对她缺乏属人管辖权。

D. Yes, because venue is improper.

data.explanation:
Rule interpleader v. Statutory interpleader


RequirementsRule interpleaderStatutory interpleader
Subject-matter
jurisdiction		Complete diversity between stakeholder & claimants + amount in controversy >$75,000 or Claim arises under U.S. Constitution, treaty, or federal lawMinimal diversity between claimants + amount in controversy >=$500
Personal jurisdictionConsent
Service of process
Specific jurisdiction
General jurisdiction		Nationwide service of process
VenueAny district where:
any claimant resides, if all reside in same state property located/events occurred or
any claimant is subject to personal jurisdiction (if neither of above applies)		Any district where
any claimant resides, even if claimants reside in different states
DepositNot requiredDeposit property with court or post bond

The company has filed a statutory interpleader action in federal court. This action, like rule interpleader, is available when multiple persons claim an interest in the same property (ie, the stake). It allows the possessor of the stake (ie, the stakeholder) to avoid multiple liability by joining the claimants to litigate the ownership of the stake among themselves. However, a statutory interpleader action must satisfy special requirements for:

  • subject-matter jurisdiction - requires an amount in controversy of at least $500 and minimal diversity of citizenship between at least two claimants
  • personal jurisdiction - exists over any claimant who is served with process anywhere within the U.S. and
  • venue - proper in any judicial district where any claimant resides, even if the claimants reside in different states.

Here, the court has subject-matter jurisdiction since the disputed proceeds are $50,000 and the woman and the man are citizens of States A and B, respectively (Choice B). Personal jurisdiction exists over the woman because she was served with process in State A (Choice C). And venue is proper since the man resides in the eastern district of State B - where the court is located (Choice D). Therefore, the court will likely deny the woman's motion.

Educational objective: For statutory interpleader actions, subject-matter jurisdiction requires an amount in controversy of at least $500 and minimal diversity between two or more claimants. Personal jurisdiction exists over any claimant who was served with process anywhere in the U.S. Venue is proper in any judicial district where any claimant resides.

正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

规则互诉 (Rule interpleader) vs. 法定互诉 (Statutory interpleader)


要求规则互诉 (Rule interpleader)法定互诉 (Statutory interpleader)

属人管辖权同意
传票送达

一般管辖权		全国范围内的传票送达
审判地任何符合以下条件的区域：
任何请求权人居住地，如果所有请求权人居住在同一州内；财产所在地/事件发生地或
任何请求权人受属人管辖权管辖（如果以上两者皆不适用）		任何
请求权人居住的区域，即使请求权人居住在不同的州
交存不要求向法院交存财产或提交保证金

该公司已在联邦法院提起了法定互诉 (statutory interpleader) 诉讼。与规则互诉 (rule interpleader) 一样，当多个人对同一财产（即，争议标的）主张权益时，可以提起此类诉讼。它允许争议标的（即，利益相关人）的持有人通过将请求权人合并在一起来就争议标的的所有权进行诉讼，从而避免多重责任。然而，法定互诉诉讼必须满足以下方面的特殊要求：

  • 标的物管辖权 - 要求争议金额至少为500美元，并且至少两名请求权人之间存在最低限度的公民身份多元化
  • 属人管辖权 - 对任何在美国境内任何地方收到传票送达的请求权人均存在管辖权，以及
  • 审判地 - 在任何请求权人居住的任何司法区域均为适当，即使请求权人居住在不同的州。

在本案中，法院具有标的物管辖权，因为争议收益为50,000美元，且该女性和该男性分别是A州和B州的公民（选项B）。对该女性存在属人管辖权，因为她已在A州收到了传票送达（选项C）。并且审判地是适当的，因为该男性居住在B州东区——即法院所在地（选项D）。因此，法院很可能会驳回该女性的动议。

教学目标：对于法定互诉（statutory interpleader）诉讼，标的物管辖权要求争议金额至少为500美元，并且两个或更多请求权人之间存在最低限度的多元化。对任何在美国境内任何地方收到传票送达的请求权人，均存在属人管辖权。在任何请求权人居住的司法区域，审判地均为适当。



References

28 U.S.C. §§ 1335, 1397 & 2361 (statutory interpleader).

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Interpleader

正确答案：A (No)

法院不会批准该女性的驳回动议。本案完全符合法定互诉 (Statutory Interpleader) 的所有管辖权要求。

核心考点：法定互诉 (Statutory Interpleader)

本题考察的是联邦《法定互诉法案》（Federal Interpleader Act）下的特殊管辖权规则。这是MBE民事诉讼法中的高频考点，主要考察其与普通民事诉讼规则的区别。

关键判别点：
题目明确指出公司提起的是 "Statutory Interpleader"（法定互诉），而非基于 FRCP Rule 22 的 "Rule Interpleader"（规则互诉）。这直接触发了更宽松的管辖权标准。
逐项法律分析

1. 标的物管辖权 (Subject-Matter Jurisdiction)

根据 28 U.S.C. § 1335：

  • 争议金额：只需达到 $500（本案为 $50,000，满足）。
  • 多元化 (Diversity)：只需最低限度多元化 (Minimal Diversity)。即只要有任意两名请求权人 (Claimants) 来自不同的州即可。

本案应用：女性是A州公民，男性是B州公民。请求权人之间存在多元化。公司的公民身份在此无关紧要。

2. 属人管辖权 (Personal Jurisdiction)

根据 28 U.S.C. § 2361：

  • 法定互诉允许全国范围内的传票送达 (Nationwide Service of Process)。

本案应用：只要女性在美国境内（A州）收到传票，法院即对她拥有属人管辖权，无需分析传统的 "Minimum Contacts"（最低限度联系）。

3. 审判地 (Venue)

根据 28 U.S.C. § 1397：

  • 审判地在任何一个请求权人 (Claimant) 居住的司法区均为适当。

本案应用：男性请求权人居住在B州东区，因此B州东区联邦法院是适当的审判地。

必背考点：法定互诉 vs. 规则互诉

MBE常混淆这两个概念，请务必区分：

特征 法定互诉
(Statutory)		 规则互诉
(Rule 22)
法律依据 28 U.S.C. § 1335 Fed. R. Civ. P. 22
多元化要求 最低限度
(Claimant vs. Claimant)		 完全多元化
(Stakeholder vs. All Claimants)
争议金额 $500 或以上 超过 $75,000
送达范围 全国范围 受限于州长臂管辖法
保证金 必须向法院交存 非必须
选项排查
  • 选项 B 错误：法院有标的物管辖权，因为满足了最低限度多元化和$500金额要求。
  • 选项 C 错误：法院有属人管辖权，因为法定互诉允许全国送达。
  • 选项 D 错误：审判地适当，因为其中一名请求权人（男性）居住在该区。

questions.question:
An employee, a citizen of State A, has sued his former employer, a corporation incorporated and with its headquarters in State B, in a federal district court in State A. The employee claims that the employer fired the employee because of his disability in violation of federal law. During discovery, the employee learned that the employer had previously been investigated for discriminatory practices. After the employer was served with process, the employee served the employer with a request to produce documents related to the discrimination investigation.
The employer failed to produce the requested documents at the initial planning conference. Sixty days later, the employer still had not responded or produced the documents. Without attempting to confer with the employer's attorney, the employee filed a motion in the federal court in State A to compel the employer to produce the requested documents. The employer was properly served with the motion.
The employer will likely succeed in defending against the motion to compel on which of the following grounds?

choices.a: The employee did not serve the employer with a subpoena when he requested the documents' production.
choices.b: The employee failed to include a certification of good-faith conferral with the motion.
choices.c: The employee should have filed the motion in State B, where the employer is incorporated and headquartered.
choices.d: The employer still has time to respond to the discovery request.

Q88186

An employee, a citizen of State A, has sued his former employer, a corporation incorporated and with its headquarters in State B, in a federal district court in State A. The employee claims that the employer fired the employee because of his disability in violation of federal law. During discovery, the employee learned that the employer had previously been investigated for discriminatory practices. Twenty-five days after the employer was served with process, the employee served the employer with a request to produce documents related to the discrimination investigation.

The employer failed to produce the requested documents at the initial planning conference. Sixty days later, the employer still had not responded or produced the documents. Without attempting to confer with the employer's attorney, the employee's attorney filed a motion in the federal court in State A to compel the employer to produce the requested documents. The employer's attorney was properly served with the motion.

The employer will likely succeed in defending against the motion to compel on which of the following grounds?

一名A州公民雇员，在A州的联邦地区法院起诉其前雇主——一家在B州注册成立且总部设在B州的公司。该雇员声称，雇主因其残疾而将其解雇，此举违反了联邦法律。在证据开示（discovery）程序中，该雇员得知其雇主曾因歧视性做法接受过调查。在雇主收到传票（served with process）二十五天后，雇员向雇主送达了要求出示与歧视调查相关文件的请求。

雇主未能在初次计划会议上出示所请求的文件。六十天后，雇主仍未回应或出示文件。雇员的律师未尝试与雇主的律师进行商议，便在A州的联邦法院提交了一项动议，要求强制（compel）雇主出示所请求的文件。雇主的律师已按规定收到了该动议的送达。

雇主很可能基于以下哪项理由成功地对该强制动议进行抗辩？
options:
A. Requests for production may not be served until the parties have held their initial planning conference.
文件出示请求不得在双方举行初次计划会议前送达。

B. The employee failed to include a certification of good-faith conferral.
雇员未能附上一份善意协商证明。

C. The employee should have filed the motion in State B, where the employer is incorporated and headquartered.
雇员本应在雇主注册成立和总部所在的B州提交该动议。

D. The employer still has time to respond to the discovery request.
雇主仍有时间回应证据开示请求。
data.explanation:
FRCP 37 allows a party to file and serve a motion to compel a required disclosure or a response to a discovery request (eg, request for production). This motion must include a certification that the movant has, in good faith, conferred or attempted to confer with the noncompliant party or nonparty (ie, certification of good-faith conferral ).† The motion also must be filed in the proper court:
  • A motion to compel a party must be filed with the court in which the action is pending.
  • A motion to compel a nonparty must be filed in the court where the discovery is or will be taken.


Here, the employee properly filed the motion to compel the employer (defendant) to produce the requested documents in the federal court in State A - where the action is pending (Choice C). However, the employee's attorney failed to confer or attempt to confer with the employer's attorney. As a result, no certification of good-faith conferral was included with the motion to compel. Therefore, the employer will likely succeed in defending against the employee's motion on this ground.

†Good-faith conferral is required because the court wants the parties to resolve a discovery issue on their own before using judicial resources to do so.

(Choices A & D) A party generally may not seek discovery until after the parties' initial planning conference. However, a party may serve a request for production before that conference if it is served at least 21 days after service of process (as the employee did 25 days after service). A response must then be served in writing within 30 days after the conference (not 60 days later, as the employer did here).

Educational objective: A motion to compel must include a certification that the movant has, in good faith, conferred or attempted to confer with the noncompliant party or nonparty. A motion to compel a party must be filed with the court in which the action is pending, while a motion to compel a nonparty must be filed in the court where the discovery is or will be taken.

FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.



选项正确率统计：A选项 35%，B选项 36%（正确选项），C选项 6%，D选项 21%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

FRCP 37 允许一方当事人提交并送达一项强制动议（motion to compel），以强制对方作出要求的披露或对证据开示请求（discovery request）作出回应（例如，文件出示请求）。该动议必须包含一份证明，证明动议提出方已经善意地与未遵守规定的一方当事人或非当事人进行了商议或试图进行商议（即，善意协商证明 [certification of good-faith conferral]）。† 该动议也必须在适当的法院提交：
  • 强制一方当事人的动议必须向诉讼待决（action is pending）的法院提交。
  • 强制非当事人的动议必须在证据开示正在或将要进行之地的法院提交。


在本案中，雇员在A州的联邦法院——即诉讼待决地——提交了强制雇主（被告）出示所请求文件的动议，此举是正确的（选项C）。然而，雇员的律师未能与雇主的律师进行商议或试图商议。因此，强制动议中未包含善意协商证明。所以，雇主很可能基于此理由成功地对雇员的动议进行抗辩。

†要求进行善意协商，是因为法院希望双方在动用司法资源之前，能自行解决证据开示问题。

（选项 A & D）一方当事人通常在双方的初次计划会议之后才能寻求证据开示。然而，一方当事人可以在该会议前送达文件出示请求，前提是该请求在送达程序文件（service of process）后至少21天送达（本案中雇员是在25天后送达的）。之后，必须在会议后30天内以书面形式送达回应（而非像本案中雇主那样在60天后仍未回应）。

教学目标：一项强制动议必须包含一份证明，证明动议提出方已经善意地与未遵守规定的一方当事人或非当事人进行了商议或试图进行商议。强制一方当事人的动议必须向诉讼待决的法院提交，而强制非当事人的动议必须在证据开示正在或将要进行之地的法院提交。

FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (联邦民事诉讼规则)。

References

  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 37(a) (motion to compel requirements).
  • 8B Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 2285 (3d ed. 2020) (explaining the requirements for a motion to compel required disclosures or discovery responses).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Pretrial Procedures / Discovery

✅ 正确答案：选项 B

雇主将成功抗辩，因为雇员在提交动议前，未能附上一份善意协商证明 (Certification of Good-Faith Conferral)。

⚖️ 法律依据与推理
FRCP 37(a)(1)

联邦民事诉讼规则规定，当一方当事人寻求法院介入以强制对方进行证据开示（Motion to Compel）时，动议必须包含一份证明，声明动议人已经与未履行义务的一方进行了善意协商 (conferred in good faith) 或尝试协商，试图在不惊动法院的情况下解决纠纷。

逻辑分析：

  • 法院的立场： 联邦法院希望律师们自行解决证据开示（Discovery）中的琐碎纠纷，不要因为对方没回邮件就立刻请求法官裁决。
  • 本案事实： 题目明确指出，雇员的律师 "Without attempting to confer with the employer's attorney"（未尝试与雇主律师商议）就直接提交了动议。
  • 后果： 这种程序上的缺失是致命的。无论雇主是否违规在先，法院通常会因为缺乏“善意协商证明”而直接驳回强制动议。
❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 A & D：关于时间点 (Timing)

这是关于“提前送达请求” (Early Rule 34 Requests) 的规则。虽然通常证据开示在初次计划会议（Rule 26(f) Conference）后才开始，但规则允许在送达传票（Service of Process）21天后即可送达文件出示请求。

本案中，雇员在25天后送达，符合规定。此时，雇主的回应期限是在初次会议后的30天内。题目中已经过了60天，所以雇主确实违规了，不能以“时间未到”为由抗辩。

选项 C：关于管辖法院 (Venue)

针对当事人 (Party) 的强制动议，必须向诉讼待决 (where the action is pending) 的法院提交。

本案中，诉讼在 A 州联邦法院进行，所以动议也应在那里提交。只有针对非当事人 (Non-party) 的传票强制动议，才需要在证据开示发生地的法院提交。

💡 考试通关锦囊

在 MBE 证据开示（Discovery）题目中，如果看到一方直接跑去法院投诉（File a motion），请立刻检查：

  1. 他是否先联系了对方律师？(Meet and Confer)
  2. 动议中是否包含了善意协商证明？

这是 FRCP 37 中最常考的程序性门槛之一。没有协商，就没有动议。

questions.question:
A musician sued a political candidate in a federal court for federal copyright infringement. The complaint requested damages and a preliminary injunction to stop the candidate from using the musician's songs at his political rallies. Notice of a hearing on the preliminary injunction was provided to both parties. After the hearing was conducted, the judge granted the musician's request for a preliminary injunction and stated the reasons for doing so. In addition, the injunction reads as follows:
"The political candidate and any person working or volunteering to put on a rally for the candidate may not play any of the musician's songs. The political campaign is directed to distribute this injunction to all persons, including workers, independent contractors, and volunteers, who are involved in the candidate's rallies. A fine of $1,000 per violation will be assessed against anyone who fails to adhere to this injunction."
At the candidate's next rally, a volunteer who had received a copy of the preliminary injunction nonetheless played the musician's song.
Is the volunteer subject to the monetary fine for violating the preliminary injunction?

choices.a: No, because the volunteer did not receive notice of the hearing.
choices.b: No, because the volunteer is not a party in the musician's suit against the candidate.
choices.c: Yes, because the injunction is in the best interests of the public.
choices.d: Yes, because the injunction reasonably described the prohibited acts.

Q88195

A musician sued a political candidate in a federal court for federal copyright infringement. The complaint requested damages and a preliminary injunction to stop the candidate from using the musician's songs at his political rallies. Notice of a hearing on the preliminary injunction was provided to both parties. After the hearing was conducted, the judge granted the musician's request for a preliminary injunction and stated the reasons for doing so. In addition, the injunction reads as follows:

"The political candidate and any person working or volunteering to put on a rally for the candidate may not play any of the musician's songs. The political campaign is directed to distribute this injunction to all persons, including workers, independent contractors, and volunteers, who are involved in the candidate's rallies. A fine of $1,000 per violation will be assessed against anyone who fails to adhere to this injunction."

At the candidate's next rally, a volunteer who had received a copy of the preliminary injunction nonetheless played the musician's song.

Is the volunteer subject to the monetary fine for violating the preliminary injunction?

一名音乐家在联邦法院起诉一名政治候选人，指控其侵犯联邦版权。诉状请求损害赔偿和一项初步禁令，以阻止该候选人在其政治集会上使用该音乐家的歌曲。关于初步禁令的听证会通知已送达双方当事人。听证会结束后，法官批准了音乐家关于初步禁令的请求，并陈述了理由。此外，该禁令内容如下：

“该政治候选人以及任何为该候选人举办集会而工作或志愿服务的人员，均不得播放该音乐家的任何歌曲。该政治竞选团队被指令将此禁令分发给所有参与该候选人集会的人员，包括工作人员、独立承包商和志愿者。任何未遵守此禁令者，每违反一次将被处以1000美元的罚款。”

在该候选人的下一次集会上，一名已收到初步禁令副本的志愿者仍然播放了该音乐家的歌曲。

该志愿者是否会因违反初步禁令而被处以罚款？
options:
A. No, because the volunteer did not receive notice of the hearing.
不会，因为该志愿者没有收到听证会的通知。

B. No, because the volunteer is not a party in the musician's suit against the candidate.
不会，因为在该音乐家对候选人的诉讼中，该志愿者并非当事人。

C. Yes, because the injunction is in the best interests of the public.
会，因为该禁令符合公众的最佳利益。

D. Yes, because the injunction reasonably described the prohibited acts.
会，因为该禁令合理地描述了被禁止的行为。
data.explanation:
Preliminary injunction


Grounds†Movant establishes that:
  • movant is likely to succeed on merits
  • movant is likely to suffer irreparable harm in absence of relief
  • balance of equities favors movant and
  • injunction is in public's best interests
ContentsOrder granting injunction must:
  • state reasons for issuance
  • reasonably describe prohibited or commanded acts and
  • state terms specifically
EffectBinds the following persons who receive actual notice of order:
  • parties
  • parties' officers, agents, employees & attorneys and
  • anyone in active concert or participation with above-listed persons
†Movant also must provide bond to pay costs & damages if nonmovant was wrongfully enjoined.

A preliminary injunction is a temporary court order that is issued before or during trial to prohibit or command a specified action while a case is pending before the court. A preliminary injunction can only be granted after notice of the hearing to the adverse party, and it must contain all of the following:
  • The reasons why it was granted
  • A reasonable description of the prohibited or commanded acts
  • The specific terms (eg, persons bound, penalties for noncompliance)

Additionally, actual notice of the preliminary injunction must be provided to any person bound by it, including (1) the parties, (2) their officers, agents, employees, and attorneys, and (3) persons in active concert or participation with the parties or their subordinates. Only persons who receive this notice can be held in contempt of court (eg, charged a monetary fine) for violating the injunction.

Here, the judge issued a preliminary injunction and stated the reasons why it was granted. The injunction bound the candidate and all persons working or volunteering on his behalf (specific terms) to stop playing the musician's songs (prohibited acts). And since the volunteer received a copy of the injunction (actual notice), the volunteer is subject to the monetary fine for violating the preliminary injunction.

(Choice A) The volunteer had to receive actual notice of the injunction to be subject to it, but the volunteer did not need to receive notice of the hearing since the candidate was the adverse party in this suit.

(Choice B) Although the volunteer is not a party in the musician's suit against the candidate, the volunteer worked on the candidate's behalf and received actual notice of the injunction. As a result, the volunteer is bound by the injunction.

(Choice C) The injunction may be in the public's best interests because the enforcement of copyright laws protects intellectual property rights. But that alone is not a basis to enforce the injunction against the volunteer.

Educational objective: A preliminary injunction must contain (1) the reasons why it was issued, (2) a reasonable description of the prohibited or commanded acts, and (3) its specific terms.

选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 21%，C选项 0%，D选项 72%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

初步禁令


理由†申请人须证明：
  • 申请人有可能在案情实质上胜诉
  • 若无救济，申请人可能遭受不可弥补的损害
  • 衡平法上的利益衡量有利于申请人 并且
  • 禁令符合公众的最佳利益
内容批准禁令的命令必须：
  • 陈述发布的理由
  • 合理地描述被禁止或被指令的行为 并且
  • 具体说明条款
效力对收到命令实际通知的下列人员具有约束力：
  • 当事人
  • 当事人的高级职员、代理人、雇员及律师 并且
  • 与上述人员共同积极行动或参与的任何人
†如果非申请人被错误地施加了禁令，申请人还必须提供保证金，以支付因此产生的费用和损害赔偿。

初步禁令是在审判前或审判期间发布的临时法院命令，用以在案件待决期间禁止或指令某特定行为。初步禁令只有在向对方当事人发出听证会通知后才能批准，并且必须包含以下所有内容：
  • 批准禁令的理由
  • 对被禁止或被指令的行为的合理描述
  • 具体条款（例如，受约束的人员，不遵守的处罚）

此外，初步禁令的实际通知必须送达任何受其约束的人员，包括（1）当事人，（2）其高级职员、代理人、雇员和律师，以及（3）与当事人或其下属共同积极行动或参与的人员。只有收到此通知的人员才能因违反禁令而被判藐视法庭（例如，被处以罚款）。

在本案中，法官发布了初步禁令，并陈述了批准的理由。该禁令约束候选人及其所有代表其工作或志愿服务的人员（具体条款），要求他们停止播放该音乐家的歌曲（被禁止的行为）。由于该志愿者收到了禁令的副本（实际通知），因此该志愿者会因违反初步禁令而被处以罚款。

（选项A）志愿者必须收到禁令的实际通知才会受其约束，但志愿者无需收到听证会的通知，因为在该诉讼中，候选人是对方当事人。

（选项B）尽管在该音乐家对候选人的诉讼中，该志愿者并非当事人，但该志愿者代表候选人工作，并收到了禁令的实际通知。因此，该志愿者受禁令约束。

（选项C）该禁令可能符合公众的最佳利益，因为执行版权法保护了知识产权。但仅凭这一点，不足以构成对该志愿者强制执行禁令的依据。

教学目标：初步禁令必须包含（1）发布的理由，（2）对被禁止或被指令行为的合理描述，以及（3）其具体条款。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 65(d) (required contents and scope of preliminary injunction).

MBE 考点解析：初步禁令的效力范围

本题考察的是联邦民事诉讼规则（FRCP）中关于初步禁令（Preliminary Injunction）的形式要求及其对第三人的约束力。

⚖️ 核心法则：FRCP 65(d)

一项批准禁令的命令必须具备以下要素才能生效：

  1. 陈述发布的理由 (State the reasons)；
  2. 具体说明条款 (State its terms specifically)；
  3. 合理描述被禁止或指令的行为 (Describe in reasonable detail the act or acts restrained or required)。

谁受约束？(Persons Bound)

禁令仅对收到实际通知 (Actual Notice) 的以下人员有效：

  • 当事人 (Parties)；
  • 当事人的代理人、雇员、律师等 (Officers, agents, employees, etc.)；
  • 与上述人员共同积极行动或参与的人 (Persons in active concert or participation)。

🧠 案情分析

1. 禁令是否有效？
法官陈述了理由，具体说明了条款，并明确禁止播放歌曲。符合 FRCP 65(d)(1) 的形式要求。

2. 志愿者是否属于受约束的人群？
志愿者虽然不是诉讼当事人，但他是在为候选人（被告）工作，属于“共同积极行动或参与”的人员，甚至是广义上的代理人（Agent）。

3. 志愿者是否收到通知？
题目明确指出志愿者收到了禁令的副本（Actual Notice）。

结论：
禁令形式合法，志愿者属于受约束群体且已收到通知，因此违反禁令需承担责任。

✅ 选项解析

选项 D 正确

"Yes, because the injunction reasonably described the prohibited acts."

解析：这是禁令能够被执行的前提条件。如果禁令没有清晰描述被禁止的行为（例如只说“遵守法律”），则是无效的。本题中，禁令明确禁止播放特定歌曲，且志愿者属于受约束人员并收到了通知，因此禁令对他有效。

选项 A 错误

理由：未收到听证会通知。

解析：只有对方当事人（Adverse Party）必须收到初步禁令听证会的通知。第三方（如志愿者）只需要收到禁令本身（Order）的实际通知即可受其约束。

选项 B 错误

理由：不是诉讼当事人。

解析：FRCP 65(d) 明确规定，禁令不仅约束当事人，也约束其代理人、雇员以及与其共同行动的人。否则，被告可以通过让非当事人的志愿者代为实施违法行为来规避禁令。

选项 C 错误

理由：符合公众利益。

解析：“符合公众利益”是法官决定是否批准（Grant）禁令时的考量因素之一（四要素测试），而不是判断某个人是否受禁令约束的法律依据。

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理禁令（Injunction）问题时，分两步走：

  1. 内容审查：禁令本身写得对不对？（必须具体、有理由、描述清晰）。
  2. 对象审查：被执行人是否收到通知？是否属于当事人或其“圈子”（代理人/共谋者）？

如果题目问“某非当事人是否受罚”，通常考点在于Notice（通知）和Relationship（关系）。

questions.question:
A corporation brought a patent infringement action in federal court against a manufacturer. The corporation alleged that the manufacturer infringed on the corporation's patent for a shoe design. During discovery, the corporation sent the manufacturer a request to "produce all electronic documents relating to the production of the shoe." The corporation did not specify the form in which the documents were to be produced.
The manufacturer produced one year's worth of electronic documents relating to the production of the shoe, but it argued that it could not produce any documents beyond this time because they had been deleted from its server. The corporation filed a motion to compel the production of the documents. In response to the motion, the manufacturer established that recovering the electronic documents would be unduly burdensome and costly because they could be recovered only if the manufacturer hired an expensive data-recovery firm.
How should the court rule on the corporation's motion to compel?

choices.a: It should deny the motion, because the corporation failed to specify the form in which the electronic documents should be produced.
choices.b: It should deny the motion, if the manufacturer provides a meritorious defense to the claim.
choices.c: It should grant the motion, if the corporation demonstrates that it will prevail on the merits of the case.
choices.d: It should grant the motion, if the corporation shows good cause for the production.

一家公司在联邦法院对一家制造商提起了专利侵权诉讼。该公司声称，该制造商侵犯了其一项鞋子设计的专利。在证据开示（discovery）程序中，该公司向该制造商发出请求，要求“出示所有与该鞋子生产相关的电子文件”。该公司没有具体指明文件的出示形式。

制造商出示了与该鞋子生产相关的一年内的电子文件，但辩称无法出示此时间范围之外的任何文件，因为这些文件已从其服务器中删除。该公司提出了一项强制出示文件的动议。针对该动议，制造商证实，恢复这些电子文件将造成不当负担和高昂成本，因为只有在制造商聘请昂贵的数据恢复公司的情况下才能恢复这些文件。

法院应如何裁决该公司的强制动议？
options:
A. It should deny the motion, because the corporation failed to specify the form in which the electronic documents should be produced.
应驳回该动议，因为该公司未能指明电子文件的出示形式。

B. It should deny the motion, if the manufacturer provides a meritorious defense to the claim.
应驳回该动议，如果制造商对该诉讼请求提出了有理据的抗辩。

C. It should grant the motion, if the corporation demonstrates that it will prevail on the merits of the case.
应批准该动议，如果该公司证明其将在案件实体问题上胜诉。

D. It should grant the motion, if the corporation shows good cause for the production.
应批准该动议，如果该公司为文件出示展示了正当理由。
data.explanation:
During discovery, parties can use various methods to compel disclosure of information related to the case. A request for production is a discovery method used to compel an opposing party to produce and allow inspection of documents, electronically stored information (ESI) , tangible things, and real property.

A party generally must produce ESI in the form specified in the request or, if no form is specified, then in the ESI's ordinarily maintained or usable form. If ESI is not produced, the requesting party may file a motion to compel production. The producing party must then show that the ESI is not reasonably accessible due to undue burden or cost. If this is established, the court will order the production of ESI only if the requesting party shows good cause for the production.

Here, the corporation filed a motion to compel the production of the manufacturer's electronic documents related to the shoe design at issue. The manufacturer established that retrieving the documents that had been deleted from its server would be unduly burdensome and costly because it would have to hire an expensive data-recovery firm. However, if the corporation shows good cause for the production, the court should grant the corporation's motion to compel.

(Choice A) A party requesting the production of ESI may, but is not required to, specify the form in which the ESI is to be produced.

(Choices B & C) In opposing a motion to compel discovery, the producing party (the manufacturer) need not provide a meritorious defense. Additionally, the requesting party (the corporation) does not need to show that it will prevail on the merits. Instead, the focus is whether on the discovery at issue should be produced.

Educational objective: In response to a motion to compel the production of electronically stored information (ESI), the producing party must show that the ESI is not reasonably accessible due to undue burden or cost. If shown, the court will order the production of the ESI only if the requesting party demonstrates good cause for the production.



选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 28%，C选项 2%，D选项 59%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

在证据开示程序中，当事人可以使用多种方法强制披露与案件相关的信息。出示请求（request for production）是一种证据开示方法，用于强制对方当事人出示并允许检查文件、电子存储信息 (ESI)、有形物品和不动产。

当事人通常必须以请求中指明的形式出示ESI，如果未指明形式，则以ESI通常维持或可用的形式出示。如果ESI未能出示，请求方可以提出强制出示的动议。出示方随后必须证明，由于不当负担或成本，该ESI无法合理获取。如果这一点得到证实，只有在请求方为文件出示展示了正当理由的情况下，法院才会命令出示ESI。

在本案中，该公司提出了一项强制动议，要求制造商出示与涉案鞋子设计相关的电子文件。制造商证实，恢复已从其服务器删除的文件将造成不当负担和高昂成本，因为它必须聘请昂贵的数据恢复公司。然而，如果该公司为文件出示展示了正当理由，法院应批准该公司的强制动议。

(选项A) 请求出示ESI的一方可以，但并非必须，指明ESI的出示形式。

(选项B和C) 在反对强制证据开示的动议时，出示方（制造商）无需提供有理据的抗辩。此外，请求方（公司）也无需证明其将在实体问题上胜诉。相反，焦点在于是否应出示所争议的证据。

教学目的： 针对强制出示电子存储信息 (ESI) 的动议，出示方必须证明由于不当负担或成本，该ESI无法合理获取。如果证明了这一点，只有在请求方为文件出示展示了正当理由的情况下，法院才会命令出示ESI。

References

  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 26(b)(2)(B) (limitations on electronic discovery).
  • 8 Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 2008.2 (3d ed. 2020) (explaining the procedure for inaccessible ESI).

MBE 民事诉讼法解析

电子证据开示与不当负担
正确答案：D 法院应批准该动议，前提是公司能为文件出示展示出正当理由 (Good Cause)。
核心法律规则：FRCP 26(b)(2)(B)

本题考查联邦民事诉讼规则中关于电子存储信息 (ESI) 的特殊规定。处理此类争议遵循“两步走”的举证责任转移逻辑：

1
出示方举证 (Producing Party)

首先，被要求出示证据的一方（制造商）必须证明，由于不当负担或高昂成本 (Undue Burden or Cost)，该 ESI 是无法合理获取 (Not Reasonably Accessible) 的。

本案中：制造商已成功证明恢复已删除数据需要聘请昂贵的公司，构成了不当负担。

2
请求方反证 (Requesting Party)

一旦出示方证明了困难，法院通常不会强制要求出示。但是，如果请求方（公司）能证明出示该证据具有正当理由 (Good Cause)，法院仍可命令出示。

结论：法院的裁决取决于公司是否展示了 Good Cause。

为什么其他选项是错误的？
选项 A (形式问题)： 错误。请求方可以指定 ESI 的形式（如 PDF, Native 格式），但不是必须的。如果未指定，出示方只需以通常维护的形式出示即可，这不能成为完全拒绝出示的理由。
选项 B & C (实体抗辩/胜诉可能性)： 错误。证据开示阶段（Discovery）的焦点是相关性 (Relevance) 和成比例性 (Proportionality)，而不是谁会在最终审判中胜诉。
  • 制造商是否有抗辩理由 (Meritorious Defense) 与是否有义务出示证据无关。
  • 公司无需证明自己会胜诉 (Prevail on Merits) 才能获得证据。
MBE 考试技巧

在处理 ESI (电子证据) 题目时，记住关键词链条：

ESI
↓
Not Reasonably Accessible (难获取)
↓
Undue Burden (负担重)
↓
Good Cause (正当理由)

如果题目说出示方已经证明了“负担重”，那么唯一的破局点就是请求方必须展示“正当理由”。此外，法院在发现 Good Cause 后，通常还会命令费用分摊 (Cost-shifting)，即让请求方承担恢复数据的费用。

A distributor brought a diversity action against a manufacturer in a federal court for breach of contract. During discovery, the distributor's attorney signed and served a request that the manufacturer produce every contract that the manufacturer entered during the past 50 years. The manufacturer's attorney objected in writing to the request, arguing that the request was unduly burdensome and inconsistent with the relevant case law.
The distributor's attorney filed a motion to compel the manufacturer to produce the requested documents. After a hearing on the motion, the trial judge concluded on the record that she agreed with the manufacturer's objections. The judge then ordered the distributor to pay the reasonable expenses incurred by the manufacturer related to the request and hearing.
At the conclusion of trial, the jury returned a verdict for the distributor, and the judge entered judgment on the verdict. The distributor has appealed the award of sanctions.
Is the appellate court likely to overturn the sanctions?

choices.a: No.
choices.b: Yes, because the jury entered a verdict in favor of the distributor.
choices.c: Yes, because the manufacturer did not request the sanctions.
choices.d: Yes, because the trial judge should have issued the sanctions against the distributor's attorney, not against the distributor directly.

一名分销商以违约为由，在联邦法院对一名制造商提起了多元管辖权诉讼。在证据开示（discovery）期间，分销商的律师签署并送达了一项请求，要求制造商出示其在过去50年内签订的每一份合同。制造商的律师以书面形式对该请求提出异议，主张该请求造成了不当负担，且与相关判例法不符。

在审判结束时，陪审团作出了有利于分销商的裁决，法官根据该裁决作出了判决。分销商已对制裁裁决提出上诉。

options:
A. No.

B. Yes, because the jury entered a verdict in favor of the distributor.

C. Yes, because the manufacturer did not request the sanctions.

data.explanation:
Discovery certifications


(FRCP 26(g)) Every discovery disclosure, request, response & objection must be signed by attorney (or unrepresented party), thereby certifying that:

disclosure is complete & correct or request, response, or objection is:

consistent with existing law or supported by nonfrivolous argument to extend, modify, or reverse existing law or to establish new law not made for improper purpose (eg, harass, cause unnecessary delay, needlessly increase cost of litigation) and reasonable & not unduly burdensome or expensive
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.
Discovery is the pretrial phase of a lawsuit during which the parties make required disclosures and seek information through various discovery requests, including requests for production. Every disclosure, request, response, or objection must be signed by an attorney or unrepresented party. By signing, the attorney or party certifies to the best of the person's knowledge that (1) the disclosure is complete and correct or (2) the request, response, or objection is :

  • consistent with existing law or supported by a nonfrivolous argument to extend, modify, or reverse existing law or to establish new law
  • not made for any improper purpose , such as to harass, cause unnecessary delay, or needlessly increase the cost of litigation and
  • reasonable and not unduly burdensome or expensive.


A violation of these rules, without substantial justification, requires the court to impose appropriate sanctions on the signer, the party on whose behalf the signer acted, or both. Sanctions may include an order to pay reasonable expenses, including attorney's fees, caused by the violation.

Here, the trial judge determined that the request for production signed by the distributor's attorney was unduly burdensome and inconsistent with the relevant case law. As a result, the judge had the authority to order the distributor (party on whose behalf the attorney acted) to pay the manufacturer's reasonable expenses (Choice D). Therefore, the appellate court will likely uphold, not overturn, the sanctions.

(Choice B) Sanctions may be imposed on a party or its attorney for improper behavior even if that party ultimately prevails on the merits of the case (as seen here).

(Choice C) The fact that the manufacturer did not request sanctions is irrelevant because a court may impose sanctions on its own initiative (ie, sua sponte).

Educational objective: A court must impose appropriate sanctions on an attorney, party, or both when a discovery disclosure, request, response, or objection is improperly certified. Sanctions may include an order to pay reasonable expenses, including attorney's fees, caused by the violation.

选项正确率统计：A选项 69%（正确选项），B选项 1%，C选项 7%，D选项 22%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

证据开示证明


(FRCP 26(g)) 每一份证据开示的披露、请求、回应和异议都必须由律师（或无律师代理的当事人）签署，从而证明：

披露是完整和正确的或者请求、回应或异议是：

与现行法律一致，或有非轻率的论据支持其扩展、修改或推翻现行法律，或建立新的法律；并非出于任何不正当目的（例如，骚扰、造成不必要的延误、不必要地增加诉讼成本）并且是合理的，且不会造成不当负担或过高费用。
FRCP = 《联邦民事诉讼规则》（Federal Rule of Civil Procedure）。
证据开示（Discovery）是诉讼的审前阶段，在此阶段，各方当事人进行必要的披露，并通过各种证据开示请求（包括文件出示请求）来寻求信息。每一份披露、请求、回应或异议都必须由律师或无律师代理的当事人签署。通过签署，律师或当事人就其所知尽力证明：(1) 该披露是完整和正确的，或 (2) 该请求、回应或异议是：

  • 与现行法律一致，或有非轻率的论据支持其扩展、修改或推翻现行法律，或建立新的法律
  • 并非出于任何不正当目的，例如骚扰、造成不必要的延误或不必要地增加诉讼成本并且
  • 合理的，且不会造成不当负担或过高费用。


在没有充分理由的情况下违反这些规则，法院必须对签署人、签署人所代表的当事人或两者施加适当的制裁。制裁可包括命令支付因违规行为而产生的合理费用，包括律师费。

在本案中，初审法官认定分销商律师签署的文件出示请求造成了不当负担，且与相关判例法不符。因此，法官有权命令分销商（律师所代表的当事人）支付制造商的合理费用（选项D）。因此，上诉法院很可能会维持而非推翻该制裁。

（选项B）即使一方当事人在案件实体问题上最终胜诉（如本案所示），也可能因其不当行为而对其本人或其律师施加制裁。

（选项C）制造商未请求制裁这一事实无关紧要，因为法院可以依职权主动施加制裁（即 sua sponte）。

教学目标：当证据开示的披露、请求、回应或异议的证明不当时，法院必须对律师、当事人或两者施加适当的制裁。制裁可包括命令支付因违规行为而产生的合理费用，包括律师费。

References

  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 26(g) (certification of discovery requirements).
  • 8A Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 2052 (3d ed. 2020) (explaining what sanctions may be issued for improper discovery certification).

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Discovery Sanctions
正确答案：A (No) 上诉法院不会推翻该制裁。初审法官有权因不当的证据开示请求对当事人进行制裁。

⚖️ 核心法律依据：FRCP 26(g)

本题考察的是《联邦民事诉讼规则》第26(g)条关于证据开示认证（Discovery Certification）的规定。

签字即认证 (Signing Requirement)

律师在签署任何证据开示请求（Discovery Request）时，即自动认证该请求：

  • 符合现行法律；
  • 并非出于不正当目的（Improper Purpose，如骚扰、拖延）；
  • 既不无理也不造成不当负担（Not Unreasonable or Unduly Burdensome）。

制裁规则 (Sanctions)：
如果违反了上述规则（例如提出要求对方提供50年合同这种造成巨大负担的请求），且没有实质性正当理由，法院必须（Must）对违规者实施制裁。

谁会被制裁？
规则明确规定，法院可以制裁：

  • 签署律师（The Attorney）；
  • 当事人（The Party）；
  • 或两者同时制裁。

🔍 案情分析

在本案中，分销商（Distributor）的律师提出了一个极其宽泛的请求（过去50年的所有合同）。

  1. 违规认定：法官认定该请求造成了“不当负担”（Unduly Burdensome）且违反判例法。
  2. 制裁对象：虽然是律师签的字，但FRCP 26(g)允许法院命令当事人（分销商）支付费用。
  3. 结果：上诉法院审查此类制裁时，通常适用“滥用裁量权”（Abuse of Discretion）标准。既然违规事实清楚，初审法官的裁决是合法的，不会被推翻。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？

  • 选项 B (胜诉)： Merits vs. Procedure。案件实体的胜负（陪审团裁决）与程序性违规的制裁无关。即使你赢了官司，如果你在过程中违反了规则，依然要受罚。
  • 选项 C (未请求)： 法院拥有固有权力或依据规则依职权（Sua Sponte）实施制裁，不需要对方明确请求。况且本案中对方已经提出了异议。
  • 选项 D (只罚律师)： 这是一个常见的误区。FRCP 26(g)(3) 明确授权法院可以制裁“签署人、签署人所代表的当事人，或两者”。法院有权决定由谁来买单。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧

在处理制裁（Sanctions）类题目时，请记住：
1. 程序独立性： 诉讼结果（输赢）通常不能“治愈”程序上的不当行为。
2. 连带责任： 在证据开示违规中，客户（当事人）往往要为律师的行为“买单”（虽然客户事后可以起诉律师失职，但在当前诉讼中，法院可以直接罚客户）。

questions.question:
A homeowner from State A sued a mortgage lender in a federal court located in State A. The mortgage lender is incorporated and maintains its principal place of business in State B. The homeowner's complaint alleged that the lender charged her an interest rate on her home loan that exceeded the maximum rate allowed under a federal statute. The homeowner requested $250,000 in damages and a release from the mortgage.
The mortgage lender filed a pre-answer motion to dismiss the homeowner's suit for failure to state a claim, which the court denied. The lender then filed an answer and moved to dismiss the suit for failure to join a required party. The lender claims that the homeowner's husband must be joined in the suit because he cosigned the mortgage and his name is on the deed to the home. The homeowner and her husband have been separated for five years, and he permanently resides in State B.
Should the court grant the mortgage lender's motion to dismiss for failure to join a required party?

choices.a: No, because although the husband is a required party, joining him to the suit is feasible.
choices.b: No, because the lender waived this defense by failing to assert it in the pre-answer motion.
choices.c: Yes, because joining the husband to the suit would destroy proper venue.
choices.d: Yes, because joining the husband to the suit would destroy subject-matter jurisdiction.

一名来自A州的房主在位于A州的联邦法院起诉了一家抵押贷款方。该抵押贷款方在B州注册成立，其主要营业地也在B州。房主的诉状指称，该贷款方就其房屋收取的利率超过了联邦法规所允许的最高利率。房主请求25万美元的损害赔偿并解除抵押。

该抵押贷款方以诉状未陈述可予救济的诉求为由，提出了答辩前驳回动议，但被法院驳回。随后，该贷款方提交了答辩状，在其中动议以未能合并必要当事人为由驳回诉讼。贷款方声称，房主的丈夫必须被合并到诉讼中，因为他共同签署了抵押贷款，并且他的名字在房屋的房契上。该房主与她的丈夫已经分居五年，他永久居住在B州。

法院是否应批准该抵押贷款方的驳回动议？
options:
A. No, because joining the husband to the suit is feasible.
不应批准，因为将丈夫合并到诉讼中是可行的。

B. No, because the lender waived this defense by failing to assert it in the pre-answer motion.
不应批准，因为贷款方因未在答辩前动议中主张此项抗辩，已构成放弃。

C. Yes, because joining the husband to the suit would destroy subject-matter jurisdiction.
应批准，因为将丈夫合并到诉讼中会破坏事务管辖权。

D. Yes, because the husband is a required party to the suit.
应批准，因为丈夫是本案诉讼的必要当事人。
data.explanation:
Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (FRCP) 19, an absent party must be joined (ie, added) in a suit in certain circumstances. This required (ie, compulsory) joinder rule provides a process for determining whether joinder is necessary. The first step in this process considers whether the absent party is a required party because:
  • complete relief cannot be granted without that party's presence
  • the party's absence will subject the other parties to a substantial risk of multiple or inconsistent obligations or
  • the party's absence will prejudice his/her ability to protect an interest related to the lawsuit - as seen with the husband here because he cosigned the mortgage and his name is on the deed (Choice D).

The second step considers whether it is feasible to join the required party. Here, it is feasible to join the husband because:
  • the court can obtain personal jurisdiction over him because the suit arises from his ownership of the home in State A (ie, minimum contacts with State A)
  • subject-matter jurisdiction will be preserved after joinder because the homeowner's suit is based on the federal statute (ie, arises from federal-question jurisdiction) (Choice C) and
  • proper venue will remain because the home is located in State A.

Therefore, the court should deny the lender's motion to dismiss.†

†The court will also order that the husband be joined to the suit within a specified time.

(Choice B) Under FRCP 12(h), a defendant waives certain defenses that are not asserted in a pre-answer motion or an answer, whichever occurs first. But a defense based on failure to join a required party can be asserted at any time before the end of trial, so it was not waived by failing to assert it in a pre-answer motion.

Educational objective: A required party must be joined in a suit when feasible - ie, when (1) the court can obtain personal jurisdiction over the required party, (2) subject-matter jurisdiction will be preserved after joinder, and (3) proper venue will remain.



选项正确率统计：A选项 36%（正确选项），B选项 22%，C选项 20%，D选项 20%

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》(Federal Rule of Civil Procedure, FRCP) 第19条，在特定情况下，缺席当事人必须被合并（即，被追加）到诉讼中。此必要（即，强制性）合并规则提供了一个确定合并是否必要的程序。该程序中的第一步是审查该缺席当事人是否为必要当事人，因为：
  • 若该当事人不在场，则无法给予完整的救济
  • 该当事人的缺席将使其他当事人面临多重或不一致义务的重大风险，或
  • 该当事人的缺席将损害其保护与诉讼相关的利益的能力——正如本案中的丈夫，因为他共同签署了抵押贷款并且他的名字在房契上（选项D）。

该程序的第二步是审查合并该必要当事人是否可行。在本案中，合并丈夫是可行的，因为：
  • 法院可以对他行使属人管辖权，因为诉讼源于他在A州的房屋所有权（即，与A州有最低限度联系）
  • 合并后事务管辖权将得以维持，因为房主的诉讼是基于联邦法规（即，源于联邦问题管辖权）（选项C），并且
  • 适当的审判地将保持不变，因为房屋位于A州。

因此，法院应驳回贷款方的驳回动议。†

†法院还将命令在指定时间内将丈夫合并到诉讼中。

（选项B）根据FRCP第12(h)条，被告若未在答辩前动议或答辩状（以先提交者为准）中主张某些抗辩，则构成放弃。但是，基于未能合并必要当事人的抗辩可以在审判结束前的任何时间提出，因此，未在答辩前动议中主张并不构成放弃。

教学目标：当合并是可行的时候，必须将必要当事人合并到诉讼中——即可行性是指（1）法院能对该必要当事人行使属人管辖权，（2）合并后事务管辖权将得以维持，以及（3）适当的审判地将保持不变。

References

  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 19 (required joinder of parties).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：必要当事人的合并

Civil Procedure: Joinder of Parties

核心考点：FRCP Rule 19 当一名缺席的当事人被认定为“必要当事人”且合并该当事人是“可行”的时，法院必须命令将其加入诉讼，而不是直接驳回起诉。
法律推理步骤 (Two-Step Analysis)

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第19条，处理缺席当事人问题分为两步：

第一步：该当事人是否为“必要当事人” (Required Party)?

  • 判断标准：如果没有该当事人，法院无法给予完整救济；或者该当事人的缺席会损害其自身利益；或者会导致现有当事人面临双重义务风险。
  • 本案应用：丈夫是房屋的共同所有人（名字在房契上）且共同签署了抵押贷款。解除抵押 (Release from mortgage) 会直接影响他的法律权益。因此，他是必要当事人。

第二步：合并该当事人是否“可行” (Feasible)?

可行性主要看三个方面：

  1. 属人管辖权 (Personal Jurisdiction): 丈夫在A州拥有房产，且诉讼源于该房产，A州法院对其有管辖权。
  2. 审判地 (Venue): 房产位于A州，审判地适当。
  3. 事务管辖权 (Subject-Matter Jurisdiction, SMJ):
    这是本题的关键。本案基于联邦法规 (Federal Statute)，即存在联邦问题管辖权 (Federal Question Jurisdiction)。
    与“多元管辖权” (Diversity Jurisdiction) 不同，联邦问题管辖权不要求当事人完全异籍。因此，即使加入居住在B州的丈夫，也不会破坏管辖权。
为何选 A 而排除其他选项？
选项 A (正确) 不应驳回，因为合并是可行的。
既然丈夫是必要当事人且可以被加入诉讼（不破坏管辖权），法院的正确做法是根据 Rule 19(a)(2) 命令将其加入 (Order Joinder)，而不是驳回起诉。
选项 B (错误) 关于放弃抗辩 (Waiver)。
虽然大多数 Rule 12(b) 抗辩必须在第一次回应时提出，但 Rule 12(h)(2) 明确规定，“未能合并必要当事人” (Failure to join a required party) 的抗辩可以在审判结束前的任何时间提出，并未因未在答辩前动议中提出而放弃。
选项 C (错误) 关于管辖权破坏。
只有在基于多元管辖权 (Diversity) 的案件中，加入与原告同州的被告才会破坏管辖权。本案是联邦问题案件，当事人国籍/州籍不影响管辖权基础。
选项 D (错误) 结论错误。
虽然丈夫确实是“必要当事人”，但这并不直接导致“驳回起诉”。只有当必要当事人无法被加入（例如没有PJ或会破坏SMJ），且根据公平原则诉讼无法继续时，法院才会驳回（此时该当事人被称为“不可或缺当事人” Indispensable Party）。本案中既然可以加入，就不应驳回。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
遇到 Rule 19 题目时，遵循逻辑链条：
1. 必要吗？ (Required?) → 如果 No，不用加。
2. 可行吗？ (Feasible?) → 如果 Yes，必须加 (Must Join)，不能驳回。
3. 若不可行，能继续吗？ → 只有在既必要又不可行，且无法通过其他方式补救时，才选择“驳回起诉”。

陷阱警示： 仔细看管辖权基础是 Diversity 还是 Federal Question。如果是 Federal Question，通常不会因为加入当事人而破坏 SMJ。

questions.question:
A politician from State A sued a newspaper located in State B in a federal court in State A for $200,000. The politician claimed that the newspaper invaded his privacy by publishing his federal income tax records.
During a deposition in State B, the politician's attorney asked the reporter who wrote the article to reveal the name of the source who supplied the records. The reporter, who resides in State A, refused to answer the question to preserve an alleged privilege. At the conclusion of the deposition, the politician's attorney filed a motion in the federal court in State B to compel the reporter to answer the question. After a hearing, the court held that no privilege existed and ordered the reporter to reveal the source. The reporter refused to comply with the court order. The court held the reporter in contempt and sentenced him to jail until he reveals the source.
Was the federal court's action proper?

choices.a: No, because a federal court cannot sentence a person to jail for violating a court order in a civil case.
choices.b: No, because only a federal court in State A may order the reporter to reveal his source and impose sanctions.
choices.c: Yes, because a deponent must answer every question at a deposition.
choices.d: Yes, because the reporter failed to comply with the court's order.

A politician from State A sued a newspaper located in State B in a federal court in State A for $200,000. The politician claimed that the newspaper invaded his privacy by publishing his federal income tax records.

During a deposition in State B, the politician's attorney asked the reporter who wrote the article to reveal the name of the source who supplied the records. The reporter, who resides in State A, refused to answer the question to preserve an alleged privilege. At the conclusion of the deposition, the politician's attorney filed a motion in the federal court in State B to compel the reporter to answer the question. After a hearing, the court held that no privilege existed and ordered the reporter to reveal the source. The reporter refused to comply with the court order. The court held the reporter in contempt and sentenced him to jail until he reveals the source.

Was the federal court's action proper?

一名来自A州的政治家在A州的联邦法院起诉了一家位于B州的报纸，索赔20万美元。该政治家声称，该报纸公布其联邦所得税记录，侵犯了他的隐私权。

在B州的一次录证（deposition）中，该政治家的律师要求撰写该文章的记者透露提供记录的消息来源的姓名。该记者居住在A州，他拒绝回答该问题，以维护一项声称的特免权（privilege）。录证结束时，该政治家的律师向B州的联邦法院提出动议（motion），强制该记者回答该问题。经过听证（hearing），法院裁定不存在特免权，并命令该记者透露消息来源。该记者拒绝遵守法院命令。法院裁定该记者藐视法庭（contempt），并判处其监禁，直至其透露消息来源为止。

该联邦法院的行为是否适当？
options:
A. No, because a federal court cannot sentence a person to jail for violating a court order in a civil case.
不适当，因为在民事案件中，联邦法院不能因违反法院命令而判处个人监禁。

B. No, because only a federal court in State A may order the reporter to reveal his source and impose sanctions.
不适当，因为只有A州的联邦法院可以命令该记者透露其消息来源并施加制裁。

C. Yes, because a deponent must answer every question at a deposition.
适当，因为被录证人（deponent）在录证中必须回答每一个问题。

D. Yes, because the reporter failed to comply with the court's order.
适当，因为该记者未能遵守法院的命令。
data.explanation:
Sanctions for violating discovery order


(FRCP 37(b)) Court locationSanctions allowed
Where deposition occurredHold in contempt of court
Where suit is pending
  • Direct that certain facts be construed against violator
  • Prohibit violator from offering certain evidence
  • Strike pleadings in whole or in part
  • Stay further proceedings until order is obeyed
  • Hold in contempt of court†
  • Dismiss claims in whole or in part
  • Issue default judgment against violator
  • Order payment of reasonable expenses (eg, attorney's fees) caused by violation
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

†Cannot be imposed for failing to comply with order for physical or mental examination.

When a deponent fails to answer a question at a deposition, Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 37 allows the party conducting the deposition to file a motion to compel a response.† When the deponent is a party, the motion must be filed in the court where the lawsuit is pending. But when the deponent is a nonparty (as seen here), the motion must be filed in the federal district where the deposition occurred. The court may then grant the motion and order the deponent to respond.

If the deponent refuses to comply with the court's order, the court may impose sanctions - eg, hold the deponent in criminal or civil contempt of court. The purpose of criminal contempt is to punish the violator by imposing a fixed monetary fine or jail sentence. The purpose of civil contempt is to coerce compliance with the court order by imposing a fine or jail sentence that lasts until the violator complies (eg, reveals a source) (Choice A). And since the reporter here refused to comply with the court order, the court properly held him in civil contempt.

†A motion to compel can also be filed when an opposing party fails to make a required disclosure, answer an interrogatory, or produce a document.

(Choice B) Since the reporter is not a party in this suit, the federal court in State B (where the deposition occurred) may order him to reveal his source and impose sanctions.

(Choice C) A deponent must answer every question at a deposition unless refusing to answer is necessary to
  • enforce a court-ordered limitation,
  • present a motion to terminate or limit the deposition, or
  • preserve a privilege.


Educational objective: When a nonparty fails to answer a deposition question, the court where the deposition occurred can order the nonparty to answer the question. If the nonparty fails to obey this order, the court can sanction the nonparty by holding him/her in criminal or civil contempt of court.

选项正确率统计：A选项 15%，B选项 35%，C选项 0%，D选项 48%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

对违反证据开示令的制裁


(FRCP 37(b)) 法院所在地允许的制裁
录证发生地裁定藐视法庭
诉讼待决地
  • 指令某些事实被解释为对违规者不利
  • 禁止违规者提供某些证据
  • 全部或部分删除诉状
  • 在命令被遵守前中止后续程序
  • 裁定藐视法庭†
  • 全部或部分驳回诉求
  • 对违规者作出缺席判决
  • 命令支付因违规行为产生的合理费用（例如，律师费）
FRCP = 《联邦民事诉讼规则》（Federal Rule of Civil Procedure）。

†因未遵守身体或精神检查命令而施加的制裁除外。

当被录证人在录证中未能回答问题时，《联邦民事诉讼规则》第37条允许进行录证的一方当事人提出强制其回答的动议。†当被录证人是案件当事人时，该动议必须向诉讼待决的法院提出。但是，当被录证人并非案件当事人（如本案所示）时，该动议必须向录证发生地的联邦地区法院提出。然后，法院可以批准该动议，并命令被录证人回答。

如果被录证人拒绝遵守法院的命令，法院可以施加制裁——例如，裁定被录证人构成刑事或民事藐视法庭。刑事藐视法庭的目的是通过处以固定金额的罚款或监禁来惩罚违规者。民事藐视法庭的目的是通过处以罚款或监禁来强制其遵守法院命令，该罚款或监禁将持续到违规者遵守为止（例如，透露消息来源）（选项 A）。并且，由于本案中的记者拒绝遵守法院命令，法院恰当地裁定他构成民事藐视法庭。

†当对方当事人未能按要求进行披露、回答质询书（interrogatory）或出示文件时，也可以提出强制动议。

（选项 B）由于该记者并非本案当事人，B州（录证发生地）的联邦法院可以命令他透露其消息来源并施加制裁。

（选项 C）被录证人必须回答录证中的每一个问题，除非拒绝回答是出于以下必要：
  • 执行法院命令的限制，
  • 提出终止或限制录证的动议，或
  • 维护一项特免权。


教学目标：当非当事人在录证中未能回答问题时，录证发生地的法院可以命令该非当事人回答问题。如果该非当事人不遵守此命令，法院可以通过裁定其构成刑事或民事藐视法庭来对其进行制裁。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 37(a) - (b) (motion to compel & sanctions).

MBE 考点解析

民事诉讼法：证据开示与制裁

正确答案：D

结论：联邦法院的行为是适当的，因为记者未能遵守法院的命令。

⚖️ 核心法律规则 (FRCP 37)

规则要点：

  1. 非当事人 (Non-party) 的管辖： 当被录证人（Deponent）不是案件当事人时，强制其回答问题的动议（Motion to Compel）必须向录证发生地（where the deposition occurred）的法院提出。
  2. 藐视法庭 (Contempt)： 如果非当事人拒绝遵守该法院的命令，该法院有权将其裁定为藐视法庭。
  3. 民事藐视 (Civil Contempt)： 法院可以判处监禁以强制（Coerce）其遵守命令，直到其配合为止。
🔍 案情逻辑分析
1
身份识别： 记者不是原告也不是被告，属于非当事人 (Non-party)。
2
地点确认： 录证 (Deposition) 发生在 B州。因此，B州的联邦法院拥有管辖权来处理强制动议。
3
违规行为： 法院已裁定不存在特免权 (Privilege) 并命令回答，记者仍拒绝。这构成了对法院命令的违抗。
4
制裁措施： 法院判处监禁直到他回答为止。这是典型的民事藐视法庭制裁，目的是“拿回钥匙”（强制履约），而非单纯惩罚。
❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A 错误：
民事案件中可以判处监禁。如果目的是为了强制当事人遵守法院命令（Civil Contempt），监禁是合法的手段。
选项 B 错误：
这是本题最大的干扰项。如果被录证人是当事人 (Party)，制裁通常由诉讼待决法院（A州）作出。但对于非当事人，必须由录证发生地法院（B州）行使管辖权，因为非当事人受该地法院的传票 (Subpoena) 约束。
选项 C 错误：
理由过于绝对。被录证人并非必须回答“每一个”问题（例如涉及特免权时可拒绝）。本题的关键不在于他必须回答所有问题，而在于他违反了法院明确的命令。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理 Discovery Sanctions（证据开示制裁）题目时，请务必先判断违规者是当事人 (Party) 还是 非当事人 (Non-party)。
  • 当事人： 找审理案件的法院 (Court where action is pending)。
  • 非当事人： 找录证/合规发生地的法院 (Court where compliance is required)。

A plaintiff from State A sued a defendant from State B in a federal court in State B. The plaintiff claims that the defendant breached a provision of their contract, which resulted in $100,000 in damages. The defendant filed and served an answer denying liability.
Three months later, the plaintiff stopped performing his duties under the contract. The defendant would now like to assert a claim against the plaintiff for breach of contract for $80,000.
What is the best way for the defendant to pursue her claim?

choices.a: File a new suit in the same court.
choices.b: File a reply.

data.questionStem:
Q88245

A plaintiff from State A sued a defendant from State B in a federal court in State B. The plaintiff claims that the defendant breached a provision of their contract, which resulted in $100,000 in damages. The defendant filed and served an answer denying liability.

Three months later, the plaintiff stopped performing his duties under the contract. The defendant would now like to assert a claim against the plaintiff for breach of contract for $80,000.

What action should the defendant take to pursue this claim?

一名来自 State A 的原告在 State B 的联邦法院起诉了一名来自 State B 的被告。原告主张被告违反了他们合同中的一项条款，导致了10万美元的损害赔偿。被告提交并送达了一份否认责任的答辩状。

三个月后，原告停止履行其合同项下的义务。被告现在希望对原告提出一项价值8万美元的违约索赔。

为进行此项索赔，被告应采取何种行动？
options:
A. File a new suit in the same court.
在同一法院提起新的诉讼。

B. File an amended answer as a matter of course.
依常规程序提交一份修改后的答辩状。

C. Move for leave to file a supplemental answer.
请求许可提交一份补充答辩状。

D. Request the court's leave to file an amended answer.
请求法院许可提交一份修改后的答辩状。
data.explanation:
Amended v. Supplemental pleading

(FRCP 15)
Amended pleadingSupplemental pleading
Asserts transaction, occurrence, or event that arose before pleading to be amended was filed Amend by right, with opposing party's written consent, or by leave of court Supersedes pleading to be amendedAsserts transaction, occurrence, or event that arose after pleading to be supplemented was filed Supplement by leave of court Does not supersede pleading to be supplemented
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure

Parties can modify their pleadings in two ways:
  • Amended pleadings - to set forth a transaction, occurrence, or event that arose before the pleading to be amended was filed
  • Supplemental pleadings - to set forth a transaction, occurrence, or event that arose after the pleading to be supplemented was filed


Here, the plaintiff allegedly breached his contractual duties three months after the defendant filed and served her answer. Therefore, the defendant should move for leave to file a supplemental answer that sets forth her counterclaim for breach of contract. The court will then determine whether to allow the supplemental pleading.

(Choice A) The defendant could file a new suit against the plaintiff in the same court, but this would likely be more time-consuming and expensive than filing a supplemental answer.

(Choices B & D) An amended answer would have been proper had the defendant's breach-of-contract claim arisen before she filed her original answer. Even if it were proper, she could not have amended her answer as a matter of course - ie, without the court's permission or the plaintiff's written consent. That is because more than 21 days have elapsed since her answer was served.

Educational objective: An amended pleading is used to set forth a transaction, occurrence, or event that arose before the pleading to be amended was filed. In contrast, a supplemental pleading is used to set forth a transaction, occurrence, or event that arose after the pleading to be supplemented was filed.

选项正确率统计：A选项 8%，B选项 13%，C选项 19%（正确选项），D选项 58%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

修改后诉状与补充诉状之比较

(FRCP 15)
修改后诉状补充诉状
主张在待修改诉状提交之前发生的交易、事件或事由。可通过当然权利、对方书面同意或法院许可进行修改。取代待修改的诉状。主张在待补充诉状提交之后发生的交易、事件或事由。通过法院许可进行补充。不取代待补充的诉状。
FRCP = 《联邦民事诉讼规则》(Federal Rule of Civil Procedure)

当事人可以通过两种方式修改其诉状：
  • 修改后诉状 - 用于陈述在待修改诉状提交之前发生的交易、事件或事由
  • 补充诉状 - 用于陈述在待补充诉状提交之后发生的交易、事件或事由


在本案中，原告被指控在其合同义务上的违约行为，发生于被告提交并送达其答辩状三个月之后。因此，被告应请求许可提交一份补充答辩状，以陈述其违约反诉。法院随后将决定是否准许该补充诉状。

(选项 A) 被告可以在同一法院对原告提起新的诉讼，但这可能比提交补充答辩状更耗时且成本更高。

(选项 B 和 D) 如果被告的违约索赔发生在其提交原始答辩状之前，那么提交修改后的答辩状是适当的。即使是适当的，她也无法依常规程序修改其答辩状——即未经法院许可或原告书面同意。这是因为自其答辩状送达以来，已超过21天。

教学目的： 修改后诉状用于陈述在待修改诉状提交之前发生的交易、事件或事由。相反，补充诉状用于陈述在待补充诉状提交之后发生的交易、事件或事由。

References

  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 15 (amended and supplemental pleadings).
  • 61A Am. Jur. 2d Pleading § 669 (2019) (explaining the difference between an amended and supplemental pleading).

data.htmlContent:
正确答案 选项 C
Move for leave to file a supplemental answer
(请求许可提交一份补充答辩状)
核心考点解析

本题考察的是联邦民事诉讼规则中关于诉状变更的规则，具体区分了“修改”与“补充”的概念。

FRCP 15(d): 补充诉状 (Supplemental Pleadings)

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》(FRCP) 第15(d)条，如果当事人希望陈述在原始诉状提交之后发生的交易、事件或事由，应当向法院申请许可提交补充诉状。

在本案中：

  • 被告已经提交了答辩状 (Answer)。
  • 三个月后，原告才停止履行合同（违约）。
  • 因为违约事件发生在原始答辩状提交之后，所以被告必须使用“补充诉状”来增加这一反诉 (Counterclaim)。
Reference: Fed. R. Civ. P. 15(d)
易混淆概念对比

MBE 考试中常考 Amended Pleading 与 Supplemental Pleading 的区别，关键在于时间点。

类型 Amended (修改) Supplemental (补充)
适用情形 事件发生在原诉状提交之前 事件发生在原诉状提交之后
目的 纠正错误或增加遗漏的既有事实 更新案件的最新进展
程序要求 21天内可依常规 (Course) 修改，否则需许可 总是需要法院许可 (Leave of court)
选项辨析

❌ 选项 A：提起新诉讼 (File a new suit)
虽然被告可以选择另行起诉，但这并非最高效的手段。司法原则鼓励在同一诉讼中解决所有相关争议。此外，题目问的是“被告应采取何种行动来追求此索赔”，在现有诉讼中补充反诉是最直接的方式。

❌ 选项 B & D：修改后的答辩状 (Amended Answer)
这两个选项都使用了 "Amended" 一词。

  • 法律定义错误：如前所述，对于诉状提交后发生的事实，必须用 "Supplemental"。
  • 程序错误 (针对B)：即使可以使用 Amended Answer，被告也早已过了“依常规程序”(as a matter of course) 修改的时限（通常为送达后21天）。本案已过三个月，必须经法院许可。

💡 MBE 备考技巧

在做 Civil Procedure 的题目时，一旦看到当事人想要改变诉状内容，立即画出时间轴：

  1. Original Filing Date: 原始诉状何时提交？
  2. Event Date: 新主张的事件何时发生？

如果 Event Date > Original Filing Date，答案关键词必找 "Supplemental"。

questions.question:
An employee brought a federal diversity action against his former employer, a chemical manufacturing company, seeking damages for injuries sustained on the job. During discovery, the employee's attorney served the company with notice of a written deposition she intended to conduct of one of the company's former managers. The employee's attorney attached the questions she intended to have the court officer ask the manager at the deposition. Eight days later, the company sent the manager and the employee the questions it wanted the officer to ask the manager on cross-examination. The employee's attorney served written objections to the form of the cross-examination questions four days after they were served. Twelve days later, the employee's attorney served the questions she wanted the officer to ask on redirect. Six days after service of the redirect questions, the company served its objections to the redirect questions and the questions it wanted the officer to ask on recross-examination.
Which of the following events was untimely?

choices.a: Service of the cross-examination questions.
choices.b: Service of the objections to the form of the cross-examination questions.
choices.c: Service of the redirect-examination questions.
choices.d: Service of the recross-examination questions.

data.questionStem:
Q88209

An employee brought a federal diversity action against his former employer, a chemical manufacturing company, seeking damages for injuries sustained on the job. During discovery, the employee's attorney served the company with notice of a written deposition she intended to conduct of one of the company's former managers. The employee's attorney attached the questions she intended to have the court officer ask the manager at the deposition. Eight days later, the company sent the manager and the employee the questions it wanted the officer to ask the manager on cross- examination. The employee's attorney served written objections to the form of the cross-examination questions four days after they were served. Twelve days later, the employee's attorney served the questions she wanted the officer to ask on redirect. Six days after service of the redirect questions, the company served its objections to the redirect questions and the questions it wanted the officer to ask on recross-examination.

Which of the following events was untimely?

一名雇员对其前雇主（一家化学品制造公司）提起了联邦多元管辖权诉讼，要求对其在工作中受到的伤害进行损害赔偿。在证据开示期间，该雇员的律师向公司送达了一份书面证言录取通知，意图对公司的一位前经理进行取证。该雇员的律师附上了她打算让法庭官员在取证时向经理提出的问题。八天后，公司向该经理和雇员发送了其希望法庭官员在交叉询问中向经理提出的问题。在交叉询问问题送达四天后，该雇员的律师对交叉询问问题的形式送达了书面异议。十二天后，该雇员的律师送达了她希望法庭官员在再主诘问中提出的问题。在再主诘问问题送达六天后，公司送达了其对再主诘问问题的异议以及希望法庭官员在再反诘问中提出的问题。

下列哪项事件是逾期的？
options:
A. Service of the cross-examination questions.
交叉询问问题的送达。

B. Service of the objections to the form of the cross-examination questions.
对交叉询问问题形式之异议的送达。

C. Service of the redirect-examination questions.
再主诘问问题的送达。

D. Service of the recross-examination questions.
再反诘问问题的送达。
data.explanation:
A written deposition is a method of discovery in which an officer asks a deponent questions and records the responses under oath and outside of court. The party requesting the deposition must serve the deponent and all other parties with written notice and a copy of the questions to be asked on direct examination (direct questions). The other parties may then serve the deponent and all other parties with responsive questions as follows:
  • Cross-questions - questions to be asked during cross-examination must be served within 14 days after service of the notice and direct questions (here, they were timely served 8 days later) (Choice A).
  • Redirect questions - questions to be asked during redirect must be served within 7 days after service of the cross-questions (here, they were untimely served 12 days later).
  • Recross-questions - questions to be asked during recross must be served within 7 days after service of the redirect questions (here, they were timely served 6 days later) (Choice D).
Therefore, service of the redirect-examination questions in this case was untimely.

(Choice B) A party must serve any written objections to the form of a question within the time required for serving a responsive question. This means that objections to the company's cross-questions were due at the same time as the redirect questions - 7 days after service of the cross- questions. Therefore, the employee's attorney timely served written objections to the form of the cross-questions 4 days after they were served.

Educational objective: For a written deposition, (1) cross-questions must be served within 14 days after service of direct questions, (2) redirect questions must be served within 7 days after service of cross-questions, and (3) recross-questions must be served within 7 days after service of redirect questions. Objections are due at the same times.



选项正确率统计：A选项 8%，B选项 12%，C选项 72%（正确选项），D选项 7%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

书面证言录取是一种证据开示方法，由一名官员向证人提问，并在庭外经宣誓后记录其回答。请求取证的一方必须向证人和所有其他当事人送达书面通知以及将在主诘问中提出的问题（主诘问问题）的副本。其他当事人随后可按如下方式向证人和所有其他当事人送达回应性问题：
  • 交叉询问问题 - 用于交叉询问的问题必须在通知和主诘问问题送达后的14天内送达（在此案中，问题在8天后送达，是及时的）（选项A）。
  • 再主诘问问题 - 用于再主诘问的问题必须在交叉询问问题送达后的7天内送达（在此案中，问题在12天后送达，是逾期的）。
  • 再反诘问问题 - 用于再反诘问的问题必须在再主诘问问题送达后的7天内送达（在此案中，问题在6天后送达，是及时的）（选项D）。
因此，本案中再主诘问问题的送达是逾期的。

（选项B）当事人必须在送达回应性问题所要求的时间内，送达任何对问题形式的书面异议。这意味着对公司交叉询问问题的异议应与再主诘问问题同时到期——即交叉询问问题送达后的7天内。因此，雇员的律师在交叉询问问题送达4天后送达了对其形式的书面异议，是及时的。

教学目的：对于书面证言录取，（1）交叉询问问题必须在主诘问问题送达后14天内送达；（2）再主诘问问题必须在交叉询问问题送达后7天内送达；（3）再反诘问问题必须在再主诘问问题送达后7天内送达。异议的到期时间与上述相同。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 31 (depositions by written questions).

Fed. R. Civ. P. 32 (objections to form of questions in written depositions).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

联邦民事诉讼规则 (FRCP) 第31条

本题考查的是书面证言录取 (Depositions by Written Questions) 过程中，各方交换问题的法定时间限制。

核心考点：FRCP 31(a)(5) 时限规则 书面取证的问题交换遵循 "14-7-7" 的时间表：
  • 交叉询问 (Cross)：收到主诘问后 14天 内。
  • 再主诘问 (Redirect)：收到交叉询问后 7天 内。
  • 再反诘问 (Recross)：收到再主诘问后 7天 内。

本案时间线分析

第 0 天
雇员方送达通知及主诘问问题 (Direct Questions)。
第 8 天 (间隔8天)
公司方送达交叉询问问题 (Cross Questions)。
✔ 及时 (规定为14天内)。
第 12 天 (间隔4天)
雇员方送达对交叉询问形式的异议。
✔ 及时。
注：异议的时限与下一轮问题的时限相同 (即7天内)。
第 20 天 (间隔12天)
雇员方送达再主诘问问题 (Redirect Questions)。
✘ 逾期 (Untimely)。
法律规定必须在收到交叉询问后 7天 内送达，而此处用了12天。
第 26 天 (间隔6天)
公司方送达再反诘问问题 (Recross Questions)。
✔ 及时 (规定为7天内)。

为什么选 C？

根据 Fed. R. Civ. P. 31(a)(5)，再主诘问问题 (Redirect questions) 必须在交叉询问问题送达后的 7天 内送达。本案中，雇员律师在收到交叉询问问题后第12天才送达再主诘问问题，显然超过了7天的法定期限。

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
在 MBE 考试中遇到书面取证 (Written Deposition) 的题目，立即在草稿纸上写下 "14-7-7"：
  1. 14 days for Cross
  2. 7 days for Redirect
  3. 7 days for Recross
关于异议 (Objections)：对问题形式的异议，其截止时间与“下一轮问题”的截止时间相同。
© MBE Civil Procedure Review

Which of the following does the patient's attorney NOT need to include in the complaint?

choices.b: A detailed statement of the claim showing that the patient is entitled to relief.

data.questionStem:
Q88229

A patient suffered severe complications from a surgery on his leg. The patient hired an attorney to file a negligence lawsuit in federal court against the surgeon who performed the operation.

Which of the following does the patient's attorney NOT need to include in the complaint?

一名患者因腿部手术遭受严重并发症。该患者聘请了一名律师，向联邦法院对实施手术的外科医生提起过失诉讼。

以下哪项是该患者的律师在起诉状中不必包含的内容？
options:
A. A demand for the relief the patient seeks.
对患者寻求的救济的要求。

B. A detailed statement of the claim showing that the patient is entitled to relief.
一份详细的诉讼主张陈述，表明该患者有权获得救济。

C. A short and plain statement showing the grounds for the court's subject-matter jurisdiction.
一份简明扼要的陈述，说明法院的属事管辖权（subject-matter jurisdiction）的依据。

D. The attorney's address, phone number, and email address.
律师的地址、电话号码和电子邮件地址。
data.explanation:
A complaint is the initial pleading that starts a civil action and states the basis for the plaintiff's claim. A complaint filed in federal court must contain all of the following:

  • Caption with the court's name, a title, the parties, a file number, and a designation as a "complaint"
  • Short and plain statement showing the grounds of the court's subject-matter jurisdiction (Choice C)
  • Short and plain statement of the claim showing that the plaintiff is entitled to relief
  • Demand for the relief (ie, remedy) the plaintiff seeks (Choice A)
  • Signature, address, phone number, and email address of the plaintiff's attorney (or unrepresented plaintiff) (Choice D)


The statement of the claim need only contain enough facts for a court to plausibly infer that a claim for relief exists. Detailed, specific facts are unnecessary unless the claim alleges fraud or mistake (neither of which applies here). Therefore, the patient's attorney need not include in the complaint a detailed statement of the claim showing that the patient is entitled to relief.

Educational objective: A complaint filed in federal court must contain (1) a caption with the court, title, and parties, (2) a short and plain statement of the court's jurisdiction, (3) a short and plain statement of the claim showing that the plaintiff is entitled to relief, (4) a demand for relief, and (5) the attorney's or unrepresented plaintiff's signature and contact information.



选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 55%（正确选项），C选项 9%，D选项 30%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

起诉状 (complaint) 是启动民事诉讼的初始诉状，陈述了原告诉讼主张的依据。向联邦法院提交的起诉状必须包含以下所有内容：

  • 标题 (Caption)，包含法院名称、案名、当事人、案卷编号以及“起诉状”的标识
  • 简明扼要的陈述，说明法院的属事管辖权 (subject-matter jurisdiction) 的依据 (选项C)
  • 简明扼要的诉讼主张 (claim) 陈述，表明原告有权获得救济
  • 对原告寻求的救济 (relief)（即补救措施 remedy）的要求 (选项A)
  • 原告律师（或未由律师代理的原告）的签名、地址、电话号码和电子邮件地址 (选项D)


诉讼主张的陈述只需包含足够的事实，使法院能够合理推断存在获得救济的诉讼主张即可。除非诉讼主张涉及欺诈或错误（本案均不适用），否则无需提供详细、具体的事实。因此，该患者的律师不必在起诉状中包含一份详细的诉讼主张陈述来表明患者有权获得救济。

教学目的：向联邦法院提交的起诉状必须包含 (1) 包含法院、案名和当事人的标题 (caption)，(2) 关于法院管辖权的简明扼要陈述，(3) 表明原告有权获得救济的简明扼要的诉讼主张陈述，(4) 对救济的要求，以及 (5) 律师或未由律师代理的原告的签名和联系信息。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 8 - 11 (pleading requirements).

MBE 考点解析：联邦法院起诉状要求

Civil Procedure: Pleading
核心考点解析
本题考查的是联邦民事诉讼规则第8条 (Fed. R. Civ. P. 8) 关于起诉状 (Complaint) 的基本要求。
正确答案是 B。
在联邦法院系统中，实行的是“告知式诉答” (Notice Pleading)，而不是“事实式诉答” (Fact Pleading)。
规则要点：
起诉状不需要包含“详细的事实陈述” (Detailed statement of facts)。规则仅要求提供一份“简明扼要的陈述” (Short and plain statement)，足以让被告了解诉讼主张的性质即可。
法律依据：Rule 8(a)

根据 Fed. R. Civ. P. 8(a)，一份起诉状必须包含以下三个要素：

  • 管辖权依据：一份简明扼要的陈述，说明法院拥有属事管辖权。
    (Short and plain statement of jurisdiction) —— 对应选项 C (必须)
  • 诉讼主张：一份简明扼要的陈述，表明原告有权获得救济。
    (Short and plain statement of the claim) —— 对比选项 B (只需简明，无需详细)
  • 救济要求：对原告寻求的救济（如赔偿金）的要求。
    (Demand for the relief sought) —— 对应选项 A (必须)

此外，Fed. R. Civ. P. 11(a) 要求所有诉状必须包含律师的签名、地址、邮箱和电话。
—— 对应选项 D (必须)

MBE 解题技巧
1. 识别陷阱词 "Detailed" (详细)：
在涉及一般过失 (Negligence) 或违约 (Breach of Contract) 的题目中，如果选项声称起诉状必须包含“详细事实”或“证据”，该选项通常是错误的（即本题的正确答案）。
2. 区分一般案件与特殊案件：
虽然一般案件只需“简明扼要”的陈述，但 Fed. R. Civ. P. 9(b) 规定，涉及欺诈 (Fraud) 或错误 (Mistake) 的指控必须“具体陈述” (state with particularity)。
注意：本题是医疗过失 (Negligence)，不属于欺诈，因此适用 Rule 8 的宽松标准。
进阶理解 (Twombly/Iqbal 标准)：
虽然不需要“详细”事实，但根据最高法院在 Twombly 和 Iqbal 案中的判决，起诉状中的事实必须足以使诉讼主张在表面上“具有合理性” (Plausible)，而不仅仅是“可能” (Conceivable)。但这依然不等于要求“详细的事实陈述”。

questions.question:
A pedestrian was struck in a crosswalk by a truck and severely injured. The pedestrian brought a federal diversity action against the driver of the truck, alleging the following in the complaint: "On January 15, 2019, on Broad Street in City A, located in State B, the defendant negligently drove a motor vehicle, striking the plaintiff. As a result, the plaintiff was physically injured, lost wages or income, suffered physical and mental pain, and incurred medical expenses of $100,000."
The truck driver has moved to dismiss the action for failure to state a claim, arguing that the complaint lacks sufficient detail.
Is the court likely to grant the motion?

choices.a: No, because the complaint alleges facts showing plausible entitlement to relief.
choices.b: No, because the pedestrian has not had an opportunity to conduct discovery.
choices.c: Yes, because the complaint fails to allege facts showing probable entitlement to relief.
choices.d: Yes, because the complaint uses the term "negligently," which is a legal conclusion.
