A pedestrian was struck in a crosswalk by a truck and severely injured. The pedestrian brought a federal diversity action against the driver of the truck, alleging the following in the complaint: "On January 15, 2019, on Broad Street in City A, located in State B, the defendant negligently drove a motor vehicle, striking the plaintiff. As a result, the plaintiff was physically injured, lost wages or income, suffered physical and mental pain, and incurred medical expenses of $100,000."

The truck driver has moved to dismiss the action for failure to state a claim, arguing that the complaint lacks sufficient detail.

Is the court likely to grant the motion?

一名行人在人行横道上被一辆卡车撞倒，伤势严重。该行人对卡车司机提起了联邦多元管辖权诉讼，在诉状中指称如下：“2019年1月15日，在B州的A市Broad Street，被告因过失驾驶机动车撞倒原告。因此，原告身体受伤、损失了工资或收入、遭受了身心痛苦，并产生了10万美元的医疗费用。”

卡车司机以诉状未能陈述有效的诉讼请求为由，请求法院驳回该诉讼，其理由是诉状缺乏足够的细节。

法院是否可能批准该动议？
options:
A. No, because the complaint alleges facts showing plausible entitlement to relief.
不会，因为诉状指称的事实表明，其有合理的理由获得救济。

B. No, because the pedestrian has not had an opportunity to conduct discovery.
不会，因为行人还没有机会进行证据开示。

C. Yes, because the complaint fails to allege facts showing probable entitlement to relief.
会，因为诉状未能指称显示其很可能获得救济的事实。

D. Yes, because the complaint uses the term "negligently," which is a legal conclusion.
会，因为诉状使用了“过失地”一词，这是一个法律结论。
data.explanation:
Specificity of pleadings


ClaimPleading requirements
General ruleComplaint - short & plain statement of claim showing plaintiff is entitled to relief
Answer - short & plain statement of admissions, denials, defenses & claims against other parties
Fraud/mistake/mental conditionCircumstances giving rise to fraud/mistake must be stated with particularity
Malice, intent, knowledge, or other mental condition may be alleged generally
Conditions precedentAssertion that conditions precedent occurred may be alleged generally
Denial that conditions precedent occurred must be stated with particularity
DamagesGeneral damages may be alleged generally
Special damages must be specifically stated
A complaint is the pleading that starts a civil lawsuit and states the basis for the plaintiff's claim. It generally must contain a short and plain statement of the claim showing that the plaintiff is entitled to relief.† The statement of the claim need only contain enough facts for a court to plausibly infer that a claim for relief exists. A court may dismiss a complaint for failure to state a claim if the complaint does not satisfy this low standard.

Here, the pedestrian's complaint sets forth that the truck driver negligently struck the pedestrian on a particular date (January 15, 2019) and at a specific location (Broad Street in City A, located in State B). It then lists the damages that the pedestrian seeks to recover. Therefore, the complaint alleges facts showing plausible entitlement to relief, and the court will likely deny the truck driver's motion to dismiss for failure to state a claim.

†Detailed, specific facts are unnecessary unless the claim alleges fraud or mistake (neither of which applies here).

(Choice B) Discovery is the pretrial phase of a lawsuit that occurs after the pleading phase in which the parties are compelled to disclose information related to the case. Although the pedestrian has had no opportunity to conduct discovery, the court will deny the truck driver's motion because the complaint sets forth a plausible claim for relief.

(Choice C) Plausible entitlement to relief is a lower standard than probable entitlement to relief. The higher standard of probable entitlement is only used in situations where a preliminary injunction is sought (not seen here).

(Choice D) A plaintiff can state legal conclusions in a complaint. Therefore, the fact that the pedestrian's complaint uses the legal term "negligently" does not render the complaint defective.

Educational objective: A complaint must generally contain a short and plain statement of the claim showing that the plaintiff is entitled to relief. The statement of the claim need only contain enough facts for a court to plausibly infer that a claim for relief exists.

选项正确率统计：A选项 77%（正确选项），B选项 1%，C选项 12%，D选项 8%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

诉状的明确性


诉讼请求诉状要求
一般规则诉状 - 简明扼要地陈述诉讼请求，表明原告有权获得救济
答辩状 - 简明扼要地陈述承认、否认、抗辩及对其他方的诉讼请求
欺诈/错误/精神状态引起欺诈/错误的情形必须具体说明
恶意、意图、知情或其他精神状态可以概括性地指称
先决条件关于先决条件已发生的断言可作概括性指称
关于先决条件未发生的否认必须具体说明
损害赔偿一般损害赔償可作概括性指称
特殊损害赔償必须具体说明
诉状是启动民事诉讼并陈述原告诉讼请求之基础的诉讼文书。通常，它必须包含一份简明扼要的诉讼请求陈述，表明原告有权获得救济。† 诉讼请求的陈述只需包含足够的事实，使法院能够合理地推断出救济请求的存在。如果诉状不满足这一低标准，法院可以因未能陈述有效的诉讼请求而驳回诉状。

在本案中，行人的诉状阐明了卡车司机在特定日期（2019年1月15日）和特定地点（B州的A市Broad Street）因过失撞倒了行人。诉状接着列出了行人寻求赔偿的损害。因此，该诉状指称了显示其有合理理由获得救济的事实，法院很可能会驳回卡车司机以未能陈述有效诉讼请求为由提出的驳回动议。

†除非诉讼请求涉及欺诈或错误（本案均不适用），否则无需提供详细、具体的事实。

(选项B) 证据开示是诉讼中的一个审前阶段，发生在诉状阶段之后，在该阶段，各方当事人被强制披露与案件相关的信息。尽管行人没有机会进行证据开示，但法院将驳回卡车司机的动议，因为诉状已经提出了一个貌似合理的救济请求。

(选项C) “有合理理由获得救济”是一个比“很可能获得救济”更低的标准。“很可能获得救济”这一更高的标准仅在寻求初步禁令的情况下使用（本案中未出现）。

(选项D) 原告可以在诉状中陈述法律结论。因此，行人的诉状使用了法律术语“过失地”这一事实，并不会使诉状存在缺陷。

教学目标：诉状通常必须包含一份简明扼要的诉讼请求陈述，以表明原告有权获得救济。该诉讼请求的陈述只需包含足够的事实，使法院能够合理地推断出救济请求的存在即可。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 8 (complaint requirements).

Bell Atl. Corp. v. Twombly, 550 U.S. 544, 555 - 56 (2007) (holding that a complaint must contain a short and plain statement containing enough facts for the court to plausibly infer that a claim for relief exists).

data.htmlContent:
联邦民事诉讼起诉标准

MBE Civil Procedure Analysis
⚖️ 核心规则 (FRCP Rule 8)

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第8(a)(2)条，诉状(Complaint)必须包含一份“简明扼要的陈述” (short and plain statement)，表明原告有权获得救济。

🔑 关键判例标准 (Twombly & Iqbal):
最高法院在 Bell Atlantic Corp. v. Twombly 和 Ashcroft v. Iqbal 案中确立了现代标准：诉状必须包含足够的事实内容 (factual content)，使法院能够合理推断被告对所指控的不当行为负有责任。这被称为“合理性标准” (Plausibility Standard)。
📊 本题解析

本题考察的是诉状是否足以通过Rule 12(b)(6)（因未能陈述有效诉讼请求而驳回）的审查。

虽然诉状不需要详尽的证据，但它不能仅仅是“法律结论的堆砌”。在本案中，原告提供了具体的：

  • 时间：2019年1月15日
  • 地点：B州A市Broad Street
  • 行为：被告驾驶机动车撞击原告
  • 后果：具体的身体和经济损害

这些事实足以让法院推断出原告“有获得救济的合理可能性” (Plausible entitlement to relief)。因此，法院不会批准驳回动议。

🚫 为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 B (Discovery):
错误。能否进行证据开示(Discovery)是诉状合格后的结果，而不是理由。如果诉状本身不合格，原告无权进入证据开示阶段。
选项 C (Probable vs. Plausible):
错误。标准是“Plausible” (合理的/貌似真实的)，而不是更高的“Probable” (很有可能的)。只要事实支持一个合理的推断即可，不需要证明胜诉的可能性超过50%。
选项 D (Legal Conclusion):
错误。虽然“过失地” (Negligently) 是法律结论，但只要有具体的事实背景（如撞车的时间、地点）作为支撑，这种混合陈述是允许的。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

在联邦民诉题中，遇到关于Pleading Standard（起诉标准）的问题，记住关键词："Plausibility" (合理性)。它比“仅仅是可能” (Possibility) 要求高，但比“很有可能” (Probability) 要求低。只要诉状给了被告公平的通知 (Fair Notice) 且不仅仅是空洞的指控，通常就能过关。

A woman died with a life insurance policy worth $50,000. The woman had named "my son" as the sole beneficiary of the policy proceeds. The woman's three sons, two of whom are domiciled in State A and one of whom is domiciled in State B, individually filed claims with the insurance company to recover the proceeds of the woman's policy. The insurance company, which is incorporated and has its principal place of business in State B, brought a statutory-interpleader action in federal court against all three sons. The sons have moved to dismiss for lack of subject-matter jurisdiction.
Will the court likely grant the sons' motion to dismiss?

choices.a: No, because federal courts have exclusive jurisdiction over actions involving life insurance policies.
choices.b: No, because there is minimal diversity between the sons and the amount-in-controversy requirement is satisfied.
choices.c: Yes, because the amount in controversy does not exceed $75,000.
choices.d: Yes, because there is not complete diversity between the insurance company and the sons.

Will the court likely grant the sons' motion to dismiss?

一名女性去世，留下一份价值50,000美元的人寿保险单。该女性指定“我的儿子”为保单收益的唯一受益人。该女性的三个儿子，其中两人居住在A州，一人居住在B州，分别向保险公司提出索赔，要求获得该女性保单的收益。该保险公司在B州注册成立且主要营业地也在B州，其在联邦法院对这三个儿子提起了法定互诉（statutory-interpleader）诉讼。儿子们以缺乏属事管辖权为由，请求驳回诉讼。

法院是否可能批准儿子们的驳回请求？
options:
A. No, because federal courts have exclusive jurisdiction over actions involving life insurance policies.
不会，因为联邦法院对涉及人寿保险单的诉讼拥有专属管辖权。

B. No, because there is minimal diversity between the sons and the amount-in-controversy requirement is satisfied.
不会，因为儿子们之间存在最低限度的多元性，且争议金额要求已满足。

C. Yes, because the amount in controversy does not exceed $75,000.
会，因为争议金额未超过75,000美元。

D. Yes, because there is not complete diversity between the insurance company and the sons.
会，因为保险公司与儿子们之间不存在完全的多元性。
data.explanation:
An interpleader action is available in federal court when multiple persons claim an interest in the same property (known as the "stake"). This action allows the possessor of the stake (the "stakeholder") to avoid multiple liability by joining the claimants to litigate the stake's ownership among themselves. There are two types of interpleader, each with distinct subject-matter jurisdiction requirements that must be satisfied before a court can hear the dispute:

  • Rule interpleader requires an amount in controversy that exceeds $75,000 and complete diversity between the stakeholder and the claimants - ie, they must be citizens of different states.†
  • Statutory interpleader requires an amount in controversy of at least $500 and minimal diversity between the claimants - ie, at least two claimants must be citizens of different states.


Here, the insurance company filed a statutory-interpleader action in federal court against the three sons. The amount-in-controversy requirement is satisfied because the policy is worth $50,000. Additionally, minimal diversity exists between the claimants since two sons are domiciled in State A while one son is domiciled in State B. Therefore, the court has subject-matter jurisdiction over the action and will deny the sons' motion to dismiss.

†Subject-matter jurisdiction can also be established in a rule-interpleader action if the claim presents a federal question (not seen here).

(Choice A) Federal and state courts share jurisdiction over both state and federal law claims unless the Constitution or Congress expressly provides federal courts with exclusive jurisdiction. Actions involving life insurance policies are not actions over which federal courts have exclusive jurisdiction.

(Choice C) For most federal civil actions arising from state law, including rule-interpleader actions, subject-matter jurisdiction requires an amount in controversy that exceeds $75,000. However, statutory-interpleader actions only require an amount in controversy of at least $500.

(Choice D) Rule interpleader requires complete diversity between the stakeholder and the claimants, but statutory interpleader only requires minimal diversity between the claimants.

Educational objective: Subject-matter jurisdiction for statutory interpleader requires an amount in controversy of at least $500 and minimal diversity between the claimants - ie, at least two claimants must be citizens of different states.



选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 50%（正确选项），C选项 25%，D选项 18%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当多方对同一财产（称为“争议标的”）主张权益时，可以在联邦法院提起互诉（interpleader）诉讼。此诉讼允许争议标的的占有人（“利益相关方”）通过将所有请求人加入诉讼，让他们之间就争议标的所有权进行诉讼，从而避免多重责任。互诉有两种类型，每种都有其独特的属事管辖权要求，必须在法院审理争议前得到满足：

  • 规则互诉（Rule interpleader）要求争议金额超过75,000美元，并且利益相关方与请求人之间存在完全的多元性——即，他们必须是不同州的公民。†
  • 法定互诉（Statutory interpleader）要求争议金额至少为500美元，并且请求人之间存在最低限度的多元性——即，至少有两名请求人必须是不同州的公民。


在本案中，保险公司在联邦法院对三名儿子提起了法定互诉诉讼。争议金额的要求已得到满足，因为保单价值为50,000美元。此外，请求人之间存在最低限度的多元性，因为有两个儿子居住在A州，而另一个儿子居住在B州。因此，法院对该诉讼拥有属事管辖权，并将驳回儿子们的驳回请求。

†如果诉求涉及联邦问题（本案未出现），规则互诉诉讼的属事管辖权也可以确立。

(选项A) 联邦法院和州法院对州法和联邦法诉求拥有共同管辖权，除非宪法或国会明确规定联邦法院拥有专属管辖权。涉及人寿保险单的诉讼不属于联邦法院拥有专属管辖权的诉讼。

(选项C) 对于大多数源于州法的联邦民事诉讼，包括规则互诉诉讼，属事管辖权要求争议金额超过75,000美元。然而，法定互诉诉讼仅要求争议金额至少为500美元。

(选项D) 规则互诉要求利益相关方与请求人之间存在完全的多元性，但法定互诉仅要求请求人之间存在最低限度的多元性。

教学目标： 法定互诉的属事管辖权要求争议金额至少为500美元，且请求人之间存在最低限度的多元性——即，至少有两名请求人必须是不同州的公民。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 22 (rule interpleader).

28 U.S.C. § 1335 (statutory interpleader).

7 Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 1710 (3d ed. 2020) (explaining the subject-matter jurisdiction requirements for rule and statutory interpleader).

MBE 考点解析

联邦民事诉讼程序：互诉 (Interpleader)

核心概念：互诉 (Interpleader) 当一个人（利益相关方，Stakeholder）持有财产，但面临多个索赔人（Claimants）相互冲突的请求时，为了避免双重或多重赔偿责任，可以提起互诉，让索赔人之间去争夺财产。

本题考察的是联邦法院受理互诉案件的属事管辖权 (Subject-Matter Jurisdiction)。在联邦法院，互诉主要有两种形式，它们的管辖权要求截然不同：

比较项目 法定互诉
(Statutory Interpleader)
28 U.S.C. § 1335		 规则互诉
(Rule Interpleader)
FRCP Rule 22
争议金额
(Amount in Controversy)		 $500 或以上 超过 $75,000
多元管辖权
(Diversity of Citizenship)		 最低限度多元性
(Minimal Diversity)
只要有两个索赔人来自不同州即可。		 完全多元性
(Complete Diversity)
利益相关方必须与所有索赔人来自不同州。

本案案情分析

  • 诉讼类型：题目明确指出保险公司提起的是“法定互诉” (statutory-interpleader)。
  • 争议金额：保单价值 $50,000。
    ➔ 满足 (因为 > $500)。
  • 当事人国籍：
    • 索赔人1 & 2：A州
    • 索赔人3：B州
    • 保险公司 (利益相关方)：B州
  • 多元性分析：
    法定互诉只看索赔人之间 (Claimant vs. Claimant)。
    A州索赔人 vs. B州索赔人 ➔ 存在不同州的公民。
    ➔ 满足最低限度多元性 (Minimal Diversity)。

结论：法院拥有管辖权，因此不会批准驳回起诉的动议。正确答案是 B。

陷阱选项解析

选项 C 错误：它混淆了规则互诉的标准。虽然 $50,000 确实没有超过 $75,000，但法定互诉只需要 $500 即可。

选项 D 错误：它应用了规则互诉的“完全多元性”标准。在规则互诉中，保险公司 (B州) 和其中一个儿子 (B州) 确实会破坏完全多元性。但在法定互诉中，利益相关方 (保险公司) 的国籍通常不影响管辖权，关键看索赔人之间。

🎓 MBE 抢分技巧

看到 Interpleader 题目，第一步先找关键词：是 "Statutory" 还是 "Rule"？

  • 如果是 Statutory：找 $500 + 索赔人之间大乱斗 (只要有两个索赔人不同州就行)。这是更容易满足的标准。
  • 如果是 Rule：找 $75k + 利益相关方 vs. 索赔人 (必须完全不同)。这和普通的 Diversity Jurisdiction 标准一样。

questions.question:
An engaged couple broke up one month before their planned wedding. Upon the breakup, the man asked the woman to reimburse him for the costs associated with the wedding and to return the engagement ring that had belonged to his great-grandmother. The woman, who had moved to another state after the breakup, refused to return the ring.
The man sued the woman in a federal district court to recover the expenses and the engagement ring, which totaled over $100,000. He seeks to possess the ring pending the outcome of the litigation on the merits.
Which of the following provisional remedies would most likely accomplish the man's goal?

choices.a: Garnishment.
choices.b: Receivership.
choices.c: Replevin.
choices.d: Temporary restraining order.

data.questionStem:
Q88188

An engaged couple broke up one month before their planned wedding. Upon the breakup, the man asked the woman to reimburse him for the costs associated with the wedding and to return the engagement ring that had belonged to his great-grandmother. The woman, who had moved to another state after the breakup, refused to return the ring.

The man sued the woman in a federal district court to recover the expenses and the engagement ring, which totaled over $100,000. He seeks to possess the ring pending the outcome of the litigation on the merits.

Which of the following provisional remedies would most likely accomplish the man's goal?

一对订婚的伴侣在计划婚礼前一个月分手。分手后，男方要求女方赔偿他与婚礼相关的费用，并归还那枚曾属于他曾祖母的订婚戒指。女方在分手后已搬到另一个州，并拒绝归还戒指。

男方向联邦地区法院提起诉讼，要求女方赔偿费用并归还订婚戒指，总价值超过10万美元。他寻求在实体诉讼结果出来之前占有该戒指。

以下哪种临时补救措施最有可能实现男方的目标？
options:
A. Garnishment.
扣押令 (Garnishment)。

B. Receivership.
财产接管 (Receivership)。

C. Replevin.
返还动产之诉 (Replevin)。

D. Temporary restraining order.
临时限制令 (Temporary restraining order)。
data.explanation:
Provisional remedies


Preliminary injunctionCourt order commanding or prohibiting specified action while the case is pending
Temporary restraining orderCourt order commanding or prohibiting specified action for 14 days or until preliminary-injunction hearing can take place (whichever occurs first)
AttachmentSeizure of person's property to secure or satisfy future judgment
ReplevinSeizure of personal property in defendant's possession that is transferred to plaintiff's possession pending outcome of suit
GarnishmentCourt order directing third party to hold indebted party's assets (eg, wages) until further judicial notice
ReceivershipAppointment of neutral third party to manage & administer disputed assets/property
†A federal court can issue any provisional remedy provided under the law of the state where the court is located.

Provisional remedies are temporary remedies issued before trial that are designed to maintain the status quo until a final judgment is rendered. Such remedies include, but are not limited to, the following:
  • Garnishment - a court order directing a third party (eg, bank or employer) to hold onto an indebted party's assets (eg, employee's wages) until the court provides further notice (Choice A)
  • Receivership - a court order appointing a neutral third party (ie, receiver) to manage and administer disputed assets and/or property (often used against companies in bankruptcy proceedings) (Choice B)
  • Temporary restraining order - a court order commanding or prohibiting specified action for 14 days or until a preliminary-injunction hearing can take place - whichever occurs first
  • Replevin - a court order seizing property possessed by the defendant and transferring it to the plaintiff pending the outcome of the lawsuit
Here, the man (plaintiff) seeks to possess his great-grandmother's ring for the duration of his suit against the woman (defendant). Since a court order of replevin would force the woman to physically turn over the ring to the man pending the outcome of the litigation - not just for 14 days or until a preliminary-injunction hearing occurs - replevin would best accomplish the man's goal (Choice D).

Educational objective: Provisional remedies are temporary remedies that maintain the status quo until a final judgment is issued. Replevin is a provisional remedy that allows the court to seize property possessed by the defendant and transfer it to the plaintiff pending the outcome of the lawsuit.

选项正确率统计：A选项 6%，B选项 10%，C选项 71%（正确选项），D选项 12%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

临时补救措施 (Provisional remedies)


初步禁令 (Preliminary injunction)在案件待决期间，命令或禁止特定行为的法院命令
临时限制令 (Temporary restraining order)在14天内或在初步禁令听证会举行前（以先到者为准），命令或禁止特定行为的法院命令
财产扣押 (Attachment)扣押个人财产以确保或满足未来判决的执行
返还动产之诉 (Replevin)在诉讼结果出来前，扣押被告占有的个人财产并将其转移给原告占有
扣押令 (Garnishment)指示第三方持有负债方资产（如工资）直至法院另行通知的法院命令
财产接管 (Receivership)任命一个中立的第三方来管理和处置有争议的资产/财产
†联邦法院可以发布其所在州法律规定的任何临时补救措施。

临时补救措施 (Provisional remedies) 是在审判前发布的临时性济助，旨在维持现状直至最终判决作出。这些补救措施包括但不限于以下几种：
  • 扣押令 (Garnishment) - 指示第三方（如银行或雇主）持有负债方资产（如雇员工资）直至法院另行通知的法院命令 (选项A)
  • 财产接管 (Receivership) - 任命中立第三方（即接管人）管理和处置有争议的资产和/或财产（常用于针对破产程序中的公司）的法院命令 (选项B)
  • 临时限制令 (Temporary restraining order) - 在14天内或在初步禁令听证会举行前（以先到者为准），命令或禁止特定行为的法院命令
  • 返还动产之诉 (Replevin) - 在诉讼结果出来之前，扣押被告占有的财产并将其转移给原告的法院命令
在本案中，男方（原告）寻求在他对女方（被告）的诉讼期间占有其曾祖母的戒指。由于返还动产之诉的法院命令会强制女方在诉讼结果出来前将戒指实体移交给男方——而不仅仅是14天或直到初步禁令听证会举行——因此，返还动产之诉最能实现男方的目标 (选项C) 。

教学目的： 临时补救措施是在最终判决作出前维持现状的临时性补救措施。返还动产之诉 (Replevin) 是一种临时补救措施，允许法院在诉讼结果出来之前，扣押被告占有的财产并将其转移给原告。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 64 (provisional remedies).

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Provisional Remedies
📚 核心法律规则 (FRCP 64)

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第64条，联邦法院可以采用其所在州的法律所提供的任何临时补救措施 (Provisional Remedies)，以便在最终判决前扣押人身或财产。

✅ 正确答案解析
选项 C: Replevin

中文名称：返还动产之诉 / 动产回复令

定义：一种法律程序，允许原告在诉讼开始时或期间，通过提供担保金 (Bond)，要求法院命令执法人员扣押被告占有的特定个人财产，并将其移交给原告。

本案适用性：

  • 男方的目标非常明确："Possess the ring pending the outcome"（在诉讼结果出来前占有戒指）。
  • Replevin 是唯一一种专门设计用于在审判前将特定动产的占有权从被告转移给原告的机制。
❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 D: Temporary Restraining Order (TRO)

临时限制令主要用于维持现状（Status Quo），通常是禁止某人做某事（如禁止出售戒指）。

缺陷：TRO 的有效期非常短（通常不超过14天），且通常只是“禁止转让”，并不直接命令将物品物理移交给原告占有。

选项 A: Garnishment

扣押令针对的是第三方（Third Party）。

缺陷：例如扣押被告在银行的存款或雇主发的工资。本案中戒指在被告手中，不涉及第三方。

选项 B: Receivership

财产接管是任命一个中立的第三方（Receiver）来管理财产。

缺陷：这通常用于复杂的商业资产或破产案。对于一枚戒指，法院不会任命接管人，且男方想要的是自己占有，而不是让第三方管理。

💡 MBE 破题技巧

在 Civil Procedure 的题目中，如果看到原告要求取回特定的个人财产 (Specific Personal Property)，且希望在审判前 (Pre-judgment) 就拿到手：

👉 Replevin 几乎总是正确答案。

关键词匹配：
"Return of item" + "Pending litigation" = Replevin

questions.question:
A homeowners' association sued a federal agency in a federal district court to enjoin the agency from issuing a license to a fracking company to drill near the homeowners' association's neighborhood. An environmental group that owns a park in the neighborhood seeks to join and fully participate in that case to obtain the same remedy as the homeowners' association.
What action should the environmental group take to achieve its goal?

choices.a: File a motion to intervene as a matter of right.
choices.b: File a motion to join as an indispensable party.
choices.c: File a motion to permissibly intervene.
choices.d: File an amicus brief.

data.questionStem:
Q88185

A homeowners' association sued a federal agency in a federal district court to enjoin the agency from issuing a license to a fracking company to drill near the homeowners' association's neighborhood. An environmental group that owns a park in the neighborhood seeks to join and fully participate in that case to obtain the same remedy as the homeowners' association.

What action should the environmental group take to achieve its goal?

一个业主协会在联邦地区法院起诉一个联邦机构，请求法院下达禁令，禁止该机构向一家水力压裂公司颁发在其社区附近进行钻探的许可证。一个在该社区拥有一座公园的环保组织，寻求加入并完全参与该案件，以获得与业主协会相同的救济。

该环保组织应采取何种行动以实现其目标？
options:
A. File a motion to intervene as a matter of right.
提起一项作为权利的参加诉讼动议。

B. File a motion to join as an indispensable party.
提起一项作为不可或缺的当事人加入的动议。

C. File a motion to permissibly intervene.
提起一项经许可参加诉讼的动议。

D. File an amicus brief.
提交一份法庭之友意见书。
data.explanation:
Intervention


(FRCP 24)
Intervention of rightOn timely motion, court must permit intervention when either:
  • nonparty's interest in case not adequately represented by existing parties & deciding case may impair nonparty's ability to protect that interest
  • federal statute gives unconditional right to intervene
Permissive interventionOn timely motion, court may permit intervention when either:
  • nonparty's claim or defense shares common question of law or fact with main action
  • federal statute gives conditional right to intervene
Court must consider whether intervention will unduly delay or prejudice adjudication of original parties' rights
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure

The environmental group (nonparty) seeks to fully participate in the suit between the homeowners' association and the federal agency. A nonparty can join and fully participate in a pending suit to protect his/her interest by filing a motion to intervene under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (FRCP) 24. There are two types of intervention:

  • Intervention of right - the court must permit intervention when (1) the nonparty's interest is inadequately represented by the existing parties and (2) deciding the case may impair the nonparty's ability to protect that interest

  • Permissive intervention - the court may permit intervention when the nonparty's claim or defense shares a common question of law or fact with the main action †


The environmental group likely cannot intervene as a matter of right since the homeowners' association will adequately represent the group's interest in its park (Choice A). This is because both entities seek to enjoin the federal agency from issuing a fracking license near the neighborhood. But since both claims share common questions of law and fact, the group should file a motion to permissibly intervene in the case.

†Intervention is also allowed when a federal statute gives a person an unconditional or conditional right to intervene (not seen here).

(Choice B) Only a party may file an FRCP 19 motion to join an indispensable party. But the group is not indispensable because
  • complete relief can be provided to the existing parties,
  • the group can protect its park through future litigation, and
  • no threat of inconsistent obligations exists since the entities seek the same remedy.

(Choice D) An amicus (ie, friend-of-the-court) brief is a legal document filed by a nonparty that provides the court with relevant information to help it decide the disputed issues. But amicus briefs do not allow the nonparty to fully participate in the case and are most commonly filed in appeals.

Educational objective: A nonparty may intervene (1) as a matter of right, if the nonparty's interest is inadequately represented and a decision may impair the nonparty's ability to protect that interest or (2) permissively, if the nonparty's claim or defense shares a common question of law or fact with the main action.

选项正确率统计：A选项 26%，B选项 10%，C选项 59%（正确选项），D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

参加诉讼


(FRCP 24)
有权参加诉讼在及时提出动议时，若满足以下任一条件，法院必须准许参加诉讼：
  • 非当事人在案件中的利益未被现有当事人充分代表，且案件的判决可能损害该非当事人保护其利益的能力
  • 联邦法规赋予无条件的参加诉讼权
经许可参加诉讼在及时提出动议时，若满足以下任一条件，法院可以准许参加诉讼：
  • 非当事人的诉求或抗辩与主诉讼有共同的法律或事实问题
  • 联邦法规赋予有条件的参加诉讼权
法院必须考虑参加诉讼是否会不当地延迟或损害原当事人权利的裁决
FRCP = 联邦民事诉讼规则

该环保组织（非当事人）寻求完全参与业主协会与联邦机构之间的诉讼。根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》(FRCP)第24条，非当事人可以通过提起参加诉讼的动议，加入并完全参与正在进行的诉讼，以保护其利益。参加诉讼有两种类型：

  • 有权参加诉讼 - 当(1)非当事人的利益未被现有当事人充分代表，且(2)案件的判决可能损害非当事人保护该利益的能力时，法院必须准许参加诉讼

  • 经许可参加诉讼 - 当非当事人的诉求或抗辩与主诉讼有共同的法律或事实问题时，法院可以准许参加诉讼 †


该环保组织可能无法作为一项权利参加诉讼，因为业主协会将充分代表该组织在其公园中的利益（选项 A）。这是因为两个实体都寻求禁止联邦机构在社区附近颁发水力压裂许可证。但由于两者的诉求都涉及共同的法律和事实问题，该组织应提起一项经许可参加诉讼的动议。

†当联邦法规赋予个人无条件或有条件的参加诉讼权时，也允许参加诉讼（本案未见）。

(选项 B) 只有当事人才可以根据FRCP第19条提起动议，要求加入一个不可或缺的当事人。但该组织并非不可或缺的，因为
  • 可以向现有当事人提供完全的救济，
  • 该组织可以通过未来的诉讼来保护其公园，并且
  • 由于各实体寻求相同的救济，因此不存在产生不一致义务的威胁。

(选项 D) 法庭之友（即，friend-of-the-court）意见书是由非当事人提交的一份法律文件，它向法院提供相关信息以帮助其对争议问题作出裁决。但法庭之友意见书不允许非当事人完全参与案件，并且最常用于上诉案件中。

教学目标：非当事人可以在以下情况下参加诉讼：(1) 作为一项权利参加，如果非当事人的利益未被充分代表，且判决可能损害其保护该利益的能力；或 (2) 经许可参加，如果非当事人的诉求或抗辩与主诉讼有共同的法律或事实问题。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 14 (intervention).

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Intervention
⚖️ 核心规则：FRCP 24 (Intervention)

当非当事人（Nonparty）希望主动加入诉讼并完全参与时，必须提起参加诉讼动议 (Motion to Intervene)。联邦民事诉讼规则将其分为两类：

类型 关键条件
权利参加
Intervention of Right (Rule 24(a))		 1. 利益受损；
2. 且现有当事人无法充分代表该利益。
许可参加
Permissive Intervention (Rule 24(b))		 非当事人的主张与主诉讼有共同的法律或事实问题 (Common question of law or fact)。
🔍 案情深度解析

本案中，环保组织（Environmental Group）希望加入诉讼，目标与原告业主协会（HOA）完全一致：禁止颁发许可证。

正确答案 C

提起许可参加诉讼的动议 (Motion to permissibly intervene)

理由：环保组织的诉求（保护公园环境）与主诉讼（HOA反对钻探）显然共享“共同的法律或事实问题”（即该许可证是否合法）。这是最稳妥的路径。

陷阱选项 A

权利参加 (Intervention of Right)

为什么错？ 虽然环保组织有利益，但很难证明现有当事人（HOA）“代表不充分” (Inadequate Representation)。因为HOA和环保组织寻求的是完全相同的救济（禁令），法院通常会推定现有当事人已经充分代表了该利益。

错误选项 B

必要当事人合并 (Joinder / Indispensable Party)

为什么错？ 这是FRCP 19条。通常是由现有当事人或法院提出，要求将必须参与的人拉进来。非当事人主动加入通常使用 Intervention (FRCP 24)。此外，环保组织并非“不可或缺”，没有它案件也能审理。

错误选项 D

法庭之友 (Amicus Brief)

为什么错？ 题目明确指出该组织希望“完全参与” (fully participate)。法庭之友只能提交书面意见，不能传唤证人、进行取证或作为当事人参与庭审。

💡 MBE 提分技巧

在处理 Intervention 问题时，如果外部人员的目标与现有当事人完全一致，通常无法满足“权利参加”中的“代表不充分”要件。此时，“许可参加” (Permissive Intervention) 往往是最佳选择。

questions.question:
An electrician and a plumber filed separate diversity actions against a construction company in which they both claim that the company failed to pay them the amount specified in their contracts. The company defended on the ground that the electrician and plumber failed to complete their work on time. The electrician served a request for admission on the company, requesting that the company admit that it repeatedly denied contractors such as the electrician access to the construction site. The company did not respond to the request.
Forty-five days after the electrician's request was served, the plumber asked the court during a pretrial conference to enter an order conclusively establishing the fact that the company repeatedly denied contractors access to the construction site. The plumber relied on the company's failure to timely respond to the electrician's request for admission.
Is the court likely to enter the order?

choices.a: No, because the construction company has sixty days to respond to the electrician's request for admission.
choices.b: No, because the plumber cannot rely on the construction company's failure to respond to the request for admission in the electrician's action.
choices.c: Yes, because the construction company's failure to respond to the electrician's request for admission within 30 days after service is treated as an admission.
choices.d: Yes, because the court has the authority to enter orders at pretrial conferences that will expedite litigation.

Q88187

An electrician and a plumber filed separate diversity actions against a construction company in which they both claim that the company failed to pay them the amount specified in their contracts. The company defended on the ground that the electrician and plumber failed to complete their work on time. The electrician served a request for admission on the company, requesting that the company admit that it repeatedly denied contractors such as the electrician access to the construction site. The company did not respond to the request.

Forty-five days after the electrician's request was served, the plumber asked the court during a pretrial conference to enter an order conclusively establishing the fact that the company repeatedly denied contractors access to the construction site. The plumber relied on the company's failure to timely respond to the electrician's request for admission.

Is the court likely to enter the order?

一名电工和一名水管工分别对一家建筑公司提起了独立的多元管辖权诉讼（diversity actions），他们都声称该公司未能支付其合同中规定的款项。该公司辩称，电工和水管工未能按时完成工作。电工向该公司送达了一份承认请求（request for admission），要求该公司承认其曾多次拒绝电工等承包商进入施工现场。该公司未对该请求作出回应。

在电工的请求送达四十五天后，水管工在一次庭前会议上请求法院下达一项命令，以确凿地认定该公司曾多次拒绝承包商进入施工现场这一事实。水管工的依据是该公司未能及时回应电工的承认请求。

法院是否可能下达该命令？
options:
A. No, because the construction company has sixty days to respond to the electrician's request for admission.
不会，因为建筑公司有六十天的时间来回应电工的承认请求。

B. No, because the plumber cannot rely on the construction company's failure to respond to the request for admission in the electrician's action.
不会，因为在电工的诉讼中，水管工不能依赖建筑公司未能回应承认请求这一事实。

C. Yes, because the construction company's failure to respond to the electrician's request for admission within 30 days after service is treated as an admission.
会，因为建筑公司未在送达后30天内回应电工的承认请求，这被视为一种承认。

D. Yes, because the court has the authority to enter orders at pretrial conferences that will expedite litigation.
会，因为法院有权在庭前会议上下达旨在加快诉讼进程的命令。
data.explanation:
In a request for admission, a party requests that another party admit the truth about matters within the scope of discovery that relate to facts, the application of law to facts, opinions about either, or the genuineness of documents. The party served with such a request must serve a written response within 30 days that:
  • admits the matter
  • specifically denies the matter in whole or in part
  • explains why the matter cannot be admitted or denied or objects that the matter falls outside the scope of discovery.
A party's failure to adequately respond within 30 days results in the matter being admitted and conclusively established in the pending action. However, it does not serve as an admission for any other purpose and cannot be used against the party in another proceeding.

Here, the electrician and the plumber filed separate actions against the construction company. The electrician then served the company with a request to admit that it repeatedly denied contractors access to the construction site. The company's failure to respond within 30 days after the request was served results in the matter being established in the electrician's action (Choice A). However, the plumber cannot rely on the company's failure to respond in the electrician's action, so the court is unlikely to enter the plumber's requested order (Choice C).

(Choice D) At a pretrial conference, a federal court has broad authority to consider matters and enter appropriate orders that will help expedite litigation, improve the trial's quality, and facilitate settlement. Here, an order establishing that the company repeatedly denied contractors access to the construction site would be improper since the plumber cannot rely on the company's failure to respond in the electrician's action.

Educational objective: A party's failure to adequately respond to a request for admission within 30 days after the request is served results in the matter being admitted and conclusively established in the pending action. However, it does not serve as an admission for any other purpose and cannot be used against the party in another proceeding.



选项正确率统计：A选项 3%，B选项 54%（正确选项），C选项 38%，D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

在一项承认请求（request for admission）中，一方当事人请求另一方当事人承认在证据开示（discovery）范围内，与事实、法律对事实的适用、关于任一者的意见或文件真实性相关的事项的真实性。被送达该请求的当事人必须在30天内送达一份书面答复，该答复：
  • 承认该事项
  • 明确否认该事项的全部或部分内容
  • 解释为何该事项无法被承认或否认或提出异议，主张该事项超出了证据开示的范围。
一方当事人未在30天内作出充分回应，将导致该事项在该未决诉讼中被视为承认并被确凿地认定。然而，该承认不适用于任何其他目的，并且不能在另一项诉讼程序中用以对抗该当事人。

在本案中，电工和水管工对建筑公司提起了独立的诉讼。电工随后向该公司送达了一份承认请求，要求其承认曾多次拒绝承包商进入施工现场。该公司未在请求送达后30天内作出回应，导致该事项在电工的诉讼中被认定 (选项 A)。但是，水管工不能依赖该公司在电工诉讼中的未回应行为，因此法院不太可能下达水管工所请求的命令 (选项 C)。

(选项 D) 在庭前会议上，联邦法院拥有广泛的权力来审议事项并下达适当的命令，以帮助加快诉讼进程、提高审判质量并促进和解。在本案中，下达一项认定该公司曾多次拒绝承包商进入施工现场的命令是不当的，因为水管工不能依赖该公司在电工诉讼中的未回应行为。

教学目标：一方当事人未在承认请求送达后30天内作出充分回应，将导致该事项在该未决诉讼中被视为承认并被确凿地认定。然而，该承认不适用于任何其他目的，并且不能在另一项诉讼程序中用以对抗该当事人。

References

  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 36 (requests for admission).
  • 8B Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 2264 (3d ed. 2020) (explaining the effect of failing to respond to a request for admission).

MBE 民事诉讼法解析

Pretrial Procedures / Discovery
核心考点：承认请求的效力范围

本题考查的是 Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 36 (FRCP 36) 关于 Requests for Admission（承认请求）的两个关键规则：

  1. 默认承认：未在 30 天内回应，视为承认。
  2. 效力限制：该承认仅在当前未决诉讼（Pending Action）中有效。

1. 事实认定：
电工（Electrician）向建筑公司发出了承认请求。公司未在 30 天内回应。根据 FRCP 36，这在电工的诉讼中被视为确凿的事实（Conclusively Established）。

2. 法律障碍：
水管工（Plumber）提起了另一个独立的诉讼（Separate Action）。虽然案情相似，但这是两个不同的案件。

FRCP 36(b) 明确规定：
"An admission under this rule is not an admission for any other purpose and cannot be used against the party in any other proceeding."
（根据本规则作出的承认不得用于任何其他目的，也不得在任何其他程序中用来对抗该当事人。）

3. 结论：
水管工不能“借用”电工案件中因被告失误而产生的自动承认。因此，法院不会批准水管工的请求。

选项解析

正确答案 B 理由：这是对 FRCP 36(b) 的直接应用。承认请求的效力具有案件专属性（Case-specific）。即使是针对同一被告的类似事实，在分开的诉讼中也不能交叉使用默认承认。
选项 A 错误 理由：回应承认请求的期限是 30 天，而不是 60 天。虽然期限是错的，但即使期限已过，水管工依然不能使用该承认，所以 A 的结论和理由都偏离了核心考点。
选项 C 错误 理由：前半句是对的（未回应视为承认），但后半句结论错误。这种“视为承认”仅限于电工的诉讼，不能延伸到水管工的诉讼中。
选项 D 错误 理由：虽然法院在庭前会议（Pretrial Conference）有权管理案件进程，但这种权力不能凌驾于证据规则和程序规则之上。法院不能为了“加快诉讼”而允许一方使用法律明文禁止使用的证据（即另一个案件中的承认）。
💡 MBE 备考小贴士：
在做 Discovery（证据开示）题目时，如果看到"Separate Actions"（独立诉讼），一定要警惕证据互用的限制。

Requests for Admission 是 MBE 的常考点，记住它的“双刃剑”特性：
  • 对自己：不回=死（默认承认）。
  • 对别人：没用（不能在其他案子用）。

questions.question:
A sailor filed a diversity action against a defendant in a federal district court to recover damages for injuries sustained in a boating accident. The district court ordered the attorneys for both parties to attend the first pretrial conference, but the sailor's attorney failed to appear. This was the first and only hearing that the attorney failed to attend. As a result, the district court entered an order dismissing the sailor's action with prejudice. The court also ordered the sailor to pay the expenses incurred by the defendant for attending the conference. The sailor immediately appealed.
What is the sailor's best argument for persuading the appellate court to reverse the dismissal?

choices.a: The dismissal was unreasonable because the attorney had not shown a pattern of noncompliance or disobedience.
choices.b: The dismissal was unwarranted because the sailor was also ordered to pay the defendant's expenses.
choices.c: The district court committed clear error when it dismissed the case before trial.
choices.d: The district court may sanction a party only when it fails to obey a pretrial order.

data.questionStem:
Q88193

A sailor filed a diversity action against a defendant in a federal district court to recover damages for injuries sustained in a boating accident. The district court ordered the attorneys for both parties to attend the first pretrial conference, but the sailor's attorney failed to appear. This was the first and only hearing that the attorney failed to attend. As a result, the district court entered an order dismissing the sailor's action with prejudice. The court also ordered the sailor to pay the expenses incurred by the defendant for attending the conference. The sailor immediately appealed.

What is the sailor's best argument for persuading the appellate court to reverse the dismissal?

一名水手在联邦地区法院对一名被告提起了多元管辖权诉讼（diversity action），要求赔偿因船只事故所受的伤害。地区法院命令双方律师参加首次审前会议，但该水手的律师未能出席。这是该律师第一次也是唯一一次未能出席的听证会。因此，地区法院下达了一项命令，以有既判力的方式（with prejudice）驳回了该水手的诉讼。法院还命令该水手支付被告因参加会议而产生的费用。该水手立即提起了上诉。

该水手说服上诉法院推翻该驳回裁定的最佳论点是什么？
options:
A. The dismissal was unreasonable because the attorney had not shown a pattern of noncompliance or disobedience.
该驳回裁定是不合理的，因为该律师并未表现出持续不遵守或不服从的行为模式。

B. The dismissal was unwarranted because the sailor was also ordered to pay the defendant's expenses.
该驳回裁定是不正当的，因为该水手同时也被命令支付被告的费用。

C. The district court committed clear error when it dismissed the case before trial.
地区法院在审判前驳回案件时犯了明显错误（clear error）。

D. The district court may sanction a party only when it fails to obey a pretrial order.
地区法院仅当一方当事人未能遵守审前命令时，才可对其进行制裁。
data.explanation:
Pretrial conferences are designed to improve the quality of trial, facilitate settlement, and expedite litigation. To underscore the importance of these conferences, a federal court typically must order † a party and/or attorney to pay the other party's reasonable expenses when the party or attorney:
  • failed to attend a pretrial conference
  • was substantially unprepared for the conference
  • did not participate in good faith in the conference
  • or failed to obey a pretrial order.
In addition to ordering the payment of expenses, the court may impose sanctions on the noncompliant party or attorney (Choice B). The court has discretion to decide which sanction to impose, but the sanction must be reasonable under the circumstances - ie, the punishment must fit the violation. Otherwise, an arbitrary or unreasonable sanction will be reversed on appeal for abuse of discretion.

Here, the district court dismissed the sailor's action with prejudice because the sailor's attorney failed to attend the initial pretrial conference. Dismissal of an action is one of the harshest sanctions and is appropriate to punish a pattern of disobedience or noncompliance (not seen here). Therefore, the sailor's best argument to reverse the dismissal is that this sanction was unreasonable under the circumstances.

†A court should not order the payment of the other party's reasonable expenses when
  • the noncompliance was substantially justified or
  • the payment would be unjust.


(Choice C) A district court's factual findings in a bench trial are reviewed for clear error and will only be reversed if no reasonable judge would have made such a finding. But here, the district court's discretionary decision to sanction the sailor's attorney and dismiss the sailor's action with prejudice before trial will be reviewed for abuse of discretion.

(Choice D) A district court may sanction a party if it failed to attend, did not participate in good faith in, or was substantially unprepared for a pretrial conference - not just when it failed to obey a pretrial order.

Educational objective: A federal court must order the payment of the other party's reasonable expenses and may impose reasonable sanctions on any attorney or party who
  • failed to attend a pretrial conference,
  • was substantially unprepared for the conference,
  • did not participate in good faith in the conference, or
  • failed to obey a pretrial order.




选项正确率统计：A选项 75%（正确选项），B选项 3%，C选项 13%，D选项 7%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

审前会议旨在提高审判质量、促进和解并加快诉讼进程。为了强调这些会议的重要性，当一方当事人或其律师出现以下情况时，联邦法院通常必须命令†该当事人或/和律师支付另一方当事人的合理费用：
  • 未能出席审前会议
  • 对会议准备严重不足
  • 未本着善意参与会议
  • 或未能遵守审前命令。
除命令支付费用外，法院可以对不遵守规定的一方当事人或律师施加制裁（选项B）。法院有自由裁量权来决定施加何种制裁，但制裁必须在当时情况下是合理的——即，惩罚必须与违规行为相适应。否则，任意或不合理的制裁将因滥用自由裁量权而在上诉中被推翻。

在本案中，地区法院因该水手的律师未能出席首次审前会议，而以有既判力的方式驳回了水手的诉讼。驳回诉讼是最严厉的制裁之一，适用于惩罚持续不服从或不遵守的行为模式（本案中未见此种情况）。因此，该水手推翻驳回裁定的最佳论点是，该制裁在当时情况下是不合理的。

†在以下情况下，法院不应命令支付另一方当事人的合理费用：
  • 不遵守规定具有充分正当理由，或
  • 支付费用将导致不公。


（选项C）地区法院在法官审（bench trial）中的事实认定，应以“明显错误”（clear error）标准进行审查，只有在没有理性的法官会做出此种认定时，才会被推翻。但在本案中，地区法院在审判前制裁该水手的律师并以有既判力的方式驳回其诉讼的自由裁量决定，将以“滥用自由裁量权”（abuse of discretion）的标准进行审查。

（选项D）如果一方当事人未能出席审前会议、未本着善意参与会议或对会议准备严重不足，地区法院均可对其进行制裁——而不仅仅是在其未能遵守审前命令时。

教学目标：当任何律师或当事人出现以下情况时，联邦法院必须命令其支付另一方当事人的合理费用，并可施加合理的制裁：
  • 未能出席审前会议，
  • 对会议准备严重不足，
  • 未本着善意参与会议，或
  • 未能遵守审前命令。


References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 16(f) (pretrial conference sanctions).

6A Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 1531 (3d ed. 2020) (explaining when sanctions are appropriate for failure to comply with pretrial conference or order).

data.htmlContent:
联邦民事诉讼法解析

Pretrial Procedures & Sanctions
✅ 正确答案：A

最佳论点是：驳回裁定是不合理的，因为该律师并未表现出持续不遵守或不服从的行为模式（Pattern of noncompliance）。

法律依据：FRCP 16(f)

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第16(f)条，如果一方当事人或其律师出现以下情况，法院可以进行制裁（Sanctions）：

  • 未能出席审前会议 (Failed to attend)；
  • 准备严重不足 (Substantially unprepared)；
  • 未善意参与 (Not participate in good faith)；
  • 违反审前命令 (Failed to obey a pretrial order)。
制裁的原则：
虽然法院拥有广泛的自由裁量权（Discretion），但制裁必须与违规行为的严重程度相称（Proportional）。
推理逻辑

本题的核心在于制裁的严厉程度是否构成滥用自由裁量权 (Abuse of Discretion)。

1. 最严厉的制裁：“有既判力的驳回” (Dismissal with prejudice) 是民事诉讼中的“死刑”。它意味着原告不仅输掉了这场官司，而且永远不能就同一事项再次起诉。

2. 适用标准：上诉法院通常认为，只有在存在恶意 (Bad faith)、故意违规 (Willfulness) 或持续不合规的模式 (Pattern of noncompliance) 时，才适用这种极端制裁。

3. 本案事实：题目明确指出这是律师“第一次也是唯一一次”未能出席。对于单一的、孤立的失误，直接判处“死刑”显然是不合理的（Unreasonable）。因此，这是上诉最强有力的切入点。

为什么其他选项不够好？
❌ 选项 B 错误：
虽然法院同时命令支付费用和驳回起诉看起来很严苛，但法律允许法院“叠加”制裁。问题不在于是否可以同时罚款和驳回，而在于“驳回”本身对于初犯来说太重了。
❌ 选项 C 错误：
这是一个程序性考点。明显错误 (Clear Error) 是上诉法院审查下级法院“事实认定”时的标准。而审查法院的“制裁决定”使用的是滥用自由裁量权 (Abuse of Discretion) 标准。用词不当。
❌ 选项 D 错误：
法律表述错误。FRCP 16(f) 明确规定，仅仅是“未能出席会议”本身就可以成为制裁的理由，不需要违反其他特定的审前命令。
💡 MBE 考试技巧：
当题目涉及法院的制裁（Sanctions）时，注意寻找“比例原则”。如果违规行为是轻微的或初犯，而制裁是终结案件（Dismissal 或 Default Judgment），那么“制裁过重/滥用裁量权”通常是正确答案的方向。

questions.question:
A consumer filed a class action in federal court on behalf of millions of users of a social media site for $100 million, claiming that the corporation that owns the site shared the users' data without their consent. The court certified the class action after determining that common questions of law and fact predominated and that the class action was the best method to fairly and efficiently adjudicate the dispute. Notice was sent by email to users of the social media site, informing them of their right to opt out of the class action. However, due to a technical error, a certain group of users was never sent the notice. The class eventually reached a settlement with the corporation, and the court entered an order dismissing the class action with prejudice.
Two months later, the group of users who never received notice of the first class action filed an identical class action against the same corporation in federal court. The corporation moved to dismiss.
How will the court likely rule on the corporation's motion?

choices.a: Deny the motion, because email is not an appropriate means to send notice of a class action.
choices.b: Deny the motion, because the group had no opportunity to opt out of the first class action.
choices.c: Grant the motion, because notice of the first class action was appropriately provided under the circumstances.
choices.d: Grant the motion, because the first class action was dismissed with prejudice.

A consumer filed a class action in federal court on behalf of millions of users of a social media site for $100 million, claiming that the corporation that owns the site shared the users' data without their consent. The court certified the class action after determining that common questions of law and fact predominated and that the class action was the best method to fairly and efficiently adjudicate the dispute. The class eventually reached a settlement with the corporation, and the court entered an order dismissing the class action with prejudice.

Two months later, the group of users who never received notice of the first class action filed an identical class action against the same corporation in federal court. The corporation moved to dismiss.

一名消费者代表数百万社交媒体网站用户在联邦法院提起集体诉讼，索赔1亿美元，声称拥有该网站的公司未经用户同意分享了他们的数据。法院在确定法律和事实上的共同问题占主导地位，并且集体诉讼是公平有效地裁决该争议的最佳方法后，认证了该集体诉讼。通知通过电子邮件发送给该社交媒体网站的用户，告知他们有权选择退出该集体诉讼。然而，由于技术错误，某一群用户从未收到该通知。该集体最终与公司达成了和解，法院下达了命令，以有既判力地（with prejudice）驳回了该集体诉讼。

两个月后，那群从未收到第一次集体诉讼通知的用户，在联邦法院对同一家公司提起了完全相同的集体诉讼。该公司动议驳回起诉。

法院很可能会如何裁定该公司的动议？

C. Grant the motion, because notice of the first class action was appropriately provided under the circumstances.

data.explanation:
Adequate notice for class action


ContentsNotice must clearly & concisely state in plain language:
  • nature of action
  • definition of class
  • claims, issues, or defenses
  • class member may appear through attorney
  • court will exclude member who opts out of class
  • time & manner for opting out and
  • binding effect of class judgment
DeliveryCourt must provide notice by most practical means - including individual notice to reasonably identifiable members
CostsPlaintiff bears cost of notifying members of class action
A federal court has the power to certify (ie, authorize) the following types of class actions:

  • Prejudicial risk - separate actions would create a risk of (1) inconsistent decisions regarding the parties or (2) impairing absent class members' interests

  • Common question - common questions of law or fact predominate over individual questions, and a class action is the best method to fairly and efficiently adjudicate the dispute (as seen here)

  • Final equitable relief - injunctive or declaratory relief is appropriate because the opposing party's actions generally apply to the whole class


In a "common question" class action, adequate notice must be provided to all class members because they have the right to opt out of the class action and sue on their own behalf.† Notice must be provided by the most practical means under the circumstances, including U.S. mail, email, or other reasonable means. A class member who receives notice but fails to opt out cannot pursue a subsequent suit involving the same claim.

Here, notice of the first class action against the corporation was appropriately provided by email to users of the social media site (Choice A). However, a group of users never received this notice due to a technical error and had no opportunity to opt out of the first class action. As a result, the group may pursue a subsequent class action against the corporation involving the same claim, and the court will likely deny the corporation's motion to dismiss (Choice C).

†In "prejudicial risk" and "final equitable relief" class actions, notice is not required because class members do not have a right to opt out. Instead, a court has the discretion to provide notice and an opportunity to opt out of such class actions.

(Choice D) The court order dismissing the first class action with prejudice means that the members of that class action cannot sue on the same claim in the future. However, it does not prevent the group from asserting the same claim since the group was not provided with notice and had no opportunity to opt out.

Educational objective: In a "common question" class action, adequate notice must be provided to all class members because they have the right to opt out of the class action. A class member who receives such notice but fails to opt out cannot pursue a subsequent suit involving the same claim.

选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 57%（正确选项），C选项 21%，D选项 14%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

集体诉讼的充分通知


内容通知必须以简明易懂的语言清晰简洁地说明：
  • 诉讼的性质
  • 集体的定义
  • 诉求、争议点或抗辩理由
  • 集体成员可通过律师出庭
  • 法院将把选择退出的成员排除在集体之外
  • 选择退出的时间和方式 以及
  • 集体判决的约束力
送达法院必须通过最切实可行的方式提供通知——包括向可合理识别的成员进行单独通知
费用原告承担通知集体诉讼成员的费用
联邦法院有权认证（即，批准）以下类型的集体诉讼：

  • 损害性风险(Prejudicial risk) - 单独诉讼会产生以下风险：（1）关于当事方的裁决不一致，或（2）损害缺席集体成员的利益

  • 共同问题(Common question) - 法律或事实上的共同问题超过了个人问题，并且集体诉讼是公平有效地裁决争议的最佳方法（如本案所示）

  • 最终衡平法救济(Final equitable relief) - 禁令性或宣告性救济是适当的，因为对方当事人的行为普遍适用于整个集体


在“共同问题”集体诉讼中，必须向所有集体成员提供充分通知，因为他们有权利选择退出集体诉讼并自行起诉。† 通知必须通过当时情况下最切实可行的方式提供，包括美国邮政、电子邮件或其他合理方式。收到通知但未选择退出的集体成员不能就同一诉求提起后续诉讼。

在本案中，针对公司的第一次集体诉讼的通知通过电子邮件适当地发送给了社交媒体网站的用户（选项A）。然而，一群用户由于技术错误从未收到此通知，也没有机会选择退出第一次集体诉讼。因此，该群体可以就同一诉求对该公司提起后续的集体诉讼，法院很可能会驳回公司的驳回动议（选项C）。

†在“损害性风险”和“最终衡平法救济”集体诉讼中，不要求提供通知，因为集体成员没有选择退出的权利。相反，法院有自由裁量权来决定是否提供通知和选择退出的机会。

（选项D） 法院以有既判力的方式驳回第一次集体诉讼的命令意味着，该集体诉讼的成员未来不能就同一诉求再行起诉。然而，这并不妨碍那个未收到通知且没有机会选择退出的群体主张同一诉求。

教学目标：在“共同问题”集体诉讼中，必须向所有集体成员提供充分的通知，因为他们有权选择退出该集体诉訟。收到此类通知但未选择退出的集体成员，不能就同一诉求提起后续诉讼。

References



  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 23(c)(2) (notice requirements for "common question" class action).


  • 7AA Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 167; 1786 (3d ed. 2020) (explaining the notice requirements for a "common question" class action).

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Class Actions
核心考点：正当程序与既判力 在“共同问题”集体诉讼（Rule 23(b)(3)）中，判决要对缺席的集体成员产生约束力（Binding Effect），必须满足正当程序（Due Process）的要求：即必须提供充分的通知（Notice）以及选择退出（Opt Out）的机会。

1. 法律规则详解

联邦民事诉讼规则第23条将集体诉讼分为三类。本题涉及的是第三类（Rule 23(b)(3)），即“共同法律或事实问题占主导地位”的诉讼（通常是金钱赔偿诉讼）。

类型 通知 (Notice) 退出权 (Opt Out)
(b)(1) & (b)(2)
禁令/宣告性救济		 法院裁量决定
(Discretionary)		 通常无权退出
(b)(3)
损害赔偿/共同问题		 必须提供
(Mandatory)		 必须提供

对于 (b)(3) 类诉讼，如果集体成员没有收到通知且没有机会选择退出，那么该判决对他们没有既判力（Res Judicata / Claim Preclusion）。

2. 案情分析

本案中，虽然法院试图通过电子邮件发送通知，但由于“技术错误”，特定群体的用户从未收到通知。

  • 关键点：这群用户没有获得“选择退出”（Opt Out）的机会。
  • 后果：由于缺乏正当程序保障（Notice + Opportunity to Opt Out），第一次集体诉讼的判决（即使是 Dismissal with Prejudice）不能约束这群特定的用户。

3. 选项解析

✅ 选项 B (正确答案)

驳回动议，因为该群体没有机会选择退出第一次集体诉讼。

这是本题的核心逻辑。在 (b)(3) 集体诉讼中，约束力的前提是成员有机会“脱离”集体单独起诉。如果因为未收到通知而剥夺了这一权利，他们就不受原判决的束缚，可以提起新的诉讼。

❌ 选项 A (错误)

理由：电子邮件不是适当的方式。

这是错误的法律陈述。根据现代规则（FRCP 23(c)(2)(B)），通知应当是“在当时情况下最切实可行的（best notice that is practicable）”。电子邮件通常被认为是通知在线平台用户的适当且合理的方式。

❌ 选项 C (错误)

理由：通知已适当送达。

虽然原告可能尽了力，但题目明确指出由于技术错误，该群体从未收到通知。更重要的是，MBE考察的是结果：如果他们没收到通知导致无法Opt Out，他们就不受判决约束。如果选C，意味着法院会批准驳回起诉（即认定他们被第一次判决约束了），这违反了正当程序原则。

❌ 选项 D (错误)

理由：第一次诉讼是有既判力驳回。

“有既判力驳回”（Dismissal with prejudice）确实通常会产生既判力，但这仅限于受该判决管辖的当事人。由于该群体未获适当通知，他们从未在法律上成为第一次诉讼的有效当事人，因此该判决对他们无效。

💡 MBE 解题技巧 遇到集体诉讼（Class Action）的题目，第一步先判断类型：
如果是 Rule 23(b)(3)（求偿类），脑中必须立刻亮起红灯：Notice（通知）和 Opt Out（退出权）是强制性的宪法性要求。

如果题目说某人没机会退出（无论是因为没收到通知还是法院没给机会），那么此人绝不会被之前的判决所约束（Bound）。

questions.question:
A shopper brought a federal diversity action in federal court against a grocery store for negligence based on a slip and fall on the grocery store's premises. The shopper's complaint alleged that the grocery store negligently failed to clean a liquid spill on the floor—a spill that its employees were aware of. The failure to clean the spill caused the shopper to slip and fall, resulting in permanent injuries to her leg. The grocery store's answer contained a general denial, stating that it denied every allegation in the complaint.
After the shopper received the grocery store's answer, she immediately filed a motion for summary judgment. In support of her motion, the shopper submitted three affidavits—two from other shoppers and one from a former employee of the store, each fully supporting the shopper's version of the event. The grocery store did not submit any affidavits or other evidence in opposition to the motion.
Should the court grant the shopper's motion for summary judgment?

choices.a: Yes, because the grocery store failed to submit evidence showing a genuine issue of fact for trial.
choices.b: Yes, because the evidence, when viewed in the light most favorable to the shopper, demonstrates the lack of a genuine dispute.
choices.c: No, because the general denial in the grocery store's answer is sufficient to demonstrate a genuine dispute for trial.
choices.d: No, because the shopper failed to meet the burden of persuasion.

questions.question:
A franchisee sued a franchisor in a federal court in State A for breach of contract. The franchisee is domiciled in State B, and the franchisor's headquarters and principal place of business are in State A. The franchisee's complaint included one line about subject-matter jurisdiction that stated: "The court has subject-matter jurisdiction over this suit." In response, the franchisor filed a motion to dismiss for lack of subject-matter jurisdiction.
Upon reviewing the motion and the complaint, the judge issued an order to show cause to the franchisee's attorney to explain why the attorney should not be sanctioned for failing to adequately plead subject-matter jurisdiction. At the show-cause hearing, the franchisee's attorney arrived with an amended complaint to substitute for the original complaint. The judge accepted the amended complaint and denied the franchisor's motion to dismiss. The judge also imposed sanctions against the franchisee's attorney in the amount of $2,000, payable to the court.
The case proceeded, the jury returned a verdict in favor of the franchisee, and the judge issued a final judgment consistent with the verdict.
The franchisee's attorney then filed an appeal related to the court's imposition of sanctions.
What is the appellate court's likely response?

choices.a: Affirm the order imposing sanctions.
choices.b: Vacate the order imposing sanctions, because the judge accepted the amended complaint.
choices.c: Vacate the order imposing sanctions, because the judge acted sua sponte.
choices.d: Vacate the order imposing sanctions, because the judge failed to allow 21 days to pass before imposing sanctions.

一名特许经营人在A州的联邦法院就违约起诉了一名特许人。该特许经营人定居于B州，而该特许人的总部和主要营业地均在A州。该特许经营人的起诉状中包含一行关于属事管辖权的陈述：“本法院对本案具有属事管辖权。”作为回应，该特许人以缺乏属事管辖权为由，提出了驳回动议。

在审查了该动议和起诉状后，法官向特许经营人的律师发出了一份说明理由令，要求其解释为何不应因未能充分陈述属事管辖权而受到制裁。在说明理由听证会上，特许经营人的律师带着一份修改后的起诉状到场，以取代原起诉状。法官接受了修改后的起诉状，并驳回了特许人的驳回动议。法官还对特许经营人的律师处以2000美元的制裁，该款项需支付给法院。

案件继续进行，陪审团作出了有利于特许经营人的裁决，法官也作出了与该裁决一致的最终判决。

特许经营人的律师随后就法院的制裁决定提起了上诉。

上诉法院可能的回应是什么？
options:
A. Affirm the order imposing sanctions.
维持处以制裁的命令。

B. Vacate the order imposing sanctions, because the judge accepted the amended complaint.
撤销处以制裁的命令，因为法官接受了修改后的起诉状。

C. Vacate the order imposing sanctions, because the judge acted sua sponte.
撤销处以制裁的命令，因为法官是依职权行事。

D. Vacate the order imposing sanctions, because the judge failed to allow 21 days to pass before imposing sanctions.
撤销处以制裁的命令，因为法官在处以制裁前未给予21天的期限。
data.explanation:
Representations to court

(FRCP 11(b)) Every pleading, motion, or other document filed must be signed by attorney (or unrepresented party), thereby certifying that:

  • document is presented for proper purpose - not to harass, cause unnecessary delay, or needlessly increase cost of litigation
  • claims, defenses & legal contentions are warranted by existing law or by nonfrivolous argument for revising or establishing law
  • factual assertions have or will have evidentiary support and
  • factual denials are warranted by evidence or reasonably based on belief/lack of information


FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

A court can impose sanctions on a law firm (default), attorney, or party if the court finds that they violated one of the provisions of Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (FRCP) 11(b) - shown above. Sanction proceedings can be initiated by:

  • an opposing party's motion - which requires that party to serve the motion on the violator but refrain from filing it with the court for 21 days to allow the violation to be corrected (ie, safe-harbor rule)
  • on the court's own initiative (ie, sua sponte) - which requires the judge to issue an order to show cause on the violator but does not require the judge to apply the safe-harbor rule.


Here, the franchisee's complaint simply alleged that the federal court "has subject-matter jurisdiction over this suit." The complaint did not include the grounds supporting this assertion as required by FRCP 8 - eg, by providing the facts that established subject-matter jurisdiction. This means that the franchisee's jurisdictional claim was not warranted by law and violated FRCP 11(b)(2). As a result, the judge had the authority to initiate sanction proceedings sua sponte and impose sanctions after the show-cause hearing (Choices C & D).

Such sanctions should be sufficient to deter the violator's conduct in the future - eg, a $2,000 fine payable to the court (as seen here). However,

the sanctions order can be appealed. The appellate court will then review the sanctions order for abuse of discretion, thereby giving great deference to the trial court's ruling and only reversing that ruling if it was unreasonable or arbitrary. Therefore, the appellate court will likely affirm the order imposing sanctions.

(Choice B) The judge's acceptance of the amended complaint does not negate the judge's power to sanction the attorney for his deficient original complaint.

Educational objective: A court can impose sanctions for violating Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 11(b). Sanction proceedings can be initiated by (1) an opposing party, who must give the violator 21 days to correct the violation, or (2) the court, which need not give the violator time to do so.

选项正确率统计：A选项 42%（正确选项），B选项 30%，C选项 5%，D选项 21%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

向法院的陈述

(FRCP 11(b)) 每一份提交的诉状、动议或其他文件都必须由律师（或未由律师代理的当事人）签署，从而证明：

  • 文件的提交是出于正当目的——而非为了骚扰、造成不必要的延误或不必要地增加诉讼成本
  • 诉讼请求、抗辩及法律主张均受到现行法律的支持，或有修改或确立新法的非轻率论据支持
  • 事实主张具有或将在之后具有证据支持并且
  • 事实否认有证据支持，或合理地基于信念/信息缺乏


FRCP = 《联邦民事诉讼规则》(Federal Rule of Civil Procedure)。

如果法院认定律师事务所（默认）、律师或当事人违反了上述《联邦民事诉讼规则》(FRCP) 11(b)的某项规定，法院可以对其处以制裁。制裁程序可由以下方式启动：

  • 对方当事人的动议 - 这要求该当事人将动议送达给违规方，但在21天内不得向法院提交，以便违规行为得以纠正（即安全港规则）
  • 法院依职权（即 sua sponte） - 这要求法官向违规方发出说明理由令，但不要求法官适用安全港规则。


在本案中，特许经营人的起诉状仅声称联邦法院“对本案具有属事管辖权”。该起诉状未按照FRCP 8的要求包含支持此主张的依据——例如，提供确立属事管辖权的事实。这意味着该特许经营人的管辖权主张没有法律依据，违反了FRCP 11(b)(2)。因此，法官有权依职权（sua sponte）启动制裁程序，并在说明理由听证会后处以制裁（选项 C 和 D）。

此类制裁应足以阻止违规方未来的行为——例如，如本案所示，向法院支付2000美元的罚款。然而，

该制裁令可以上诉。上诉法院将审查该制裁令是否存在裁量权滥用，从而对初审法院的裁决给予高度尊重，并且只有在该裁决不合理或武断时才会予以推翻。因此，上诉法院很可能会维持处以制裁的命令。

（选项 B）法官接受修改后的起诉状，并不剥夺法官因其有缺陷的原起诉状而制裁该律师的权力。

教学目标：法院可因违反《联邦民事诉讼规则》11(b)而处以制裁。制裁程序可由(1)对方当事人启动，其必须给予违规方21天时间纠正违规行为；或(2)法院启动，其无需给予违规方时间进行纠正。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 11(c) (sanctions for violating this rule).

Cooter & Gell v. Hartmarx Corp., 496 U.S. 384, 405 (1990) (establishing that abuse of discretion is appropriate appellate standard of review for Fed. R. Civ. P. 11 sanctions).

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure | Sanctions
核心考点：FRCP 11 制裁程序

本题考察《联邦民事诉讼规则》第11条（FRCP 11）关于制裁（Sanctions）的程序要求。关键在于区分制裁是由当事人动议启动，还是由法院依职权启动。

启动方式 安全港规则 (Safe Harbor) 程序要求
当事人动议
(Party's Motion)		 适用 (21天)
必须先送达对方，等待21天纠正，若未纠正方可提交法院。		 必须单独提出动议。
法院依职权
(Sua Sponte)		 不适用
法院无需给予纠正机会。		 法院必须先发出说明理由令 (Order to Show Cause)。
案情逻辑推演

在本案中，制裁程序是由法官依职权（Sua Sponte）启动的：

  1. 律师提交的起诉状仅有一句空洞的管辖权陈述，违反了 FRCP 8(a)(1) 的要求，进而违反了 FRCP 11(b)（法律主张需有依据）。
  2. 法官发出了说明理由令 (Order to Show Cause)。
  3. 法官举行了听证会。
  4. 法官处以了制裁。

虽然律师后来提交了修改后的起诉状（Amended Complaint），但这并不能免除其提交原始有缺陷文件时的责任。因为是法院主动发起的制裁，不需要遵守21天的安全港规则。

选项深度解析
正确答案 A

维持处以制裁的命令 (Affirm the order)。

法律依据：上诉法院审查制裁令的标准是“滥用裁量权” (Abuse of Discretion)。这意味着上诉法院会高度尊重初审法官的决定。

推理：初审法官遵循了正确的程序（发出说明理由令 -> 听证 -> 裁决）。律师违反 FRCP 11 的行为（提交无事实依据的管辖权声明）是客观存在的。因此，法官的制裁决定既不武断也不违法，上诉法院将予以维持。

错误选项 B

撤销命令，因为接受了修改后的起诉状。

解析：FRCP 11 制裁针对的是提交文件时的行为。虽然修改起诉状解决了案件继续审理的问题，但它不能“擦除”律师最初提交轻率文件（Frivolous filing）的违规行为。制裁的目的在于惩戒和威慑。

错误选项 C

撤销命令，因为法官依职权行事。

解析：FRCP 11(c)(3) 明确授权法院可以依职权（sua sponte）启动制裁程序。这完全在法官的权力范围内。

错误选项 D

撤销命令，因为未给予21天期限。

解析：这是一个经典的干扰项。21天安全港规则 (Safe Harbor Rule) 仅适用于当事人提出的制裁动议。当法院依职权启动制裁时，无需给予律师撤回文件的机会。

MBE 备考小贴士：看到 Sanctions 题目，第一反应检查是由“对方律师”还是“法官”发起的。如果是法官，21天规则不适用。

questions.question:
An attorney representing a defendant filed an answer in which he truthfully asserted that, after a reasonable opportunity for further investigation, it was likely that the evidence would show that the statute of limitations had expired with respect to the plaintiff's claim. The defendant's attorney signed the answer and included his email address and telephone number, but he did not attach an affidavit attesting to the truthfulness of the assertions in the answer. At a pretrial conference, the defendant's attorney asserted that he now had evidence establishing that the statute of limitations had expired. In fact, the defendant's attorney knew that the evidence eliminated the statute of limitations as a defense. The plaintiff's attorney served a motion for sanctions under Rule 11 on the defendant's attorney, but she did not file the motion with the court until a month later.
May the court impose sanctions under Rule 11 on the defendant's attorney?

choices.a: No, because the defendant's attorney truthfully asserted the statute-of-limitations defense in the answer that he signed.
choices.b: No, because the plaintiff's attorney failed to timely file her sanctions motion with the court.
choices.c: Yes, because the defendant's attorney failed to attach an affidavit to the answer attesting to the truthfulness of the assertions in the answer.
choices.d: Yes, because the defendant's attorney presented the statute-of-limitations defense at the pretrial conference.

questions.question:
A federal court in State A properly certified a class action against a company incorporated in State A for fraudulently marketing annuities to customers in violation of federal law. The certification was based on the predominance of common questions of law. The court subsequently rendered a judgment in favor of the company.
One member of the class who received proper notice of the action and did not elect to opt out initiated a lawsuit against the company in federal court in State B. The class member's suit seeks damages stemming from the company's fraudulent marketing of an annuity that she purchased from the company through its sales representative based in State B. The class member is domiciled in State B. The company has moved to dismiss this suit on the grounds that the class member's claim is precluded by the judgment in the class action.
How should the court rule?

choices.a: For the class member, because she did not expressly agree to be a member of the class action.
choices.b: For the class member, because she did not have minimum contacts with State A.
choices.c: For the company, because a judgment in this type of class action is enforceable against all members of the class.
choices.d: For the company, because the class member did not opt out of the class action.

questions.question:
A motorcyclist from State A, who suffered severe injuries in an automobile collision with a driver from State B, filed a complaint against the driver in federal court. In her complaint, the motorcyclist sought to recover special damages for her medical expenses by requesting that the driver pay "my medical expenses." Fifteen days after being served with process, the driver filed a motion for a more definite statement. The motion alleged that the complaint failed to state with specificity the medical expenses incurred by the motorcyclist and set forth the details that needed to be included.
Will the driver likely succeed on his motion for a more definite statement?

choices.a: No, because claims for damages may be alleged generally.
choices.b: No, because the driver has yet to conduct discovery.
choices.c: No, because the driver must file an answer before he can make this motion.
choices.d: Yes, because the motorcyclist failed to specifically state her claim for special damages.

questions.question:
In a class action lawsuit, the representative members of the certified classes reached a settlement agreement with the defendant. The court held a fairness hearing on the proposed settlement at which a member of one of the certified classes who was not a named representative of the class voiced objections. The court, finding that the settlement was adequate and fair, approved the settlement.
Can the objecting class member appeal the court's approval of the settlement?

choices.a: No, because the objecting class member was not a named representative of the class.
choices.b: No, because the objecting class member was only permitted to voice his objections at the fairness hearing.
choices.c: Yes, because any member of a class that has been certified has the rights of a party during the litigation of the class action lawsuit.
choices.d: Yes, because the representative members of the class no longer represent the objecting member's interests.

questions.question:
A plaintiff sued a defendant in a federal district court for negligently causing an accident in which the plaintiff suffered severe injuries. The defendant answered the complaint and denied liability.
The plaintiff served a request for admission on the defendant. The plaintiff requested that the defendant admit that the defendant failed to stop at the intersection where the collision occurred. The defendant did not respond to the request. At the final pretrial conference two months later, the plaintiff claims that the defendant's failure to stop at the intersection should be deemed conclusively established at trial.
Is the plaintiff correct?

choices.a: No, because the defendant denied liability in his answer to the complaint.
choices.b: No, because the defendant did not admit that he failed to stop at the intersection.
choices.c: Yes, because the defendant failed to respond to the request for admission.
choices.d: Yes, but only if the plaintiff demonstrates by a preponderance of the evidence that the defendant failed to stop at the intersection.

data.questionStem:
Q88173

A plaintiff sued a defendant in a federal district court for negligently causing an accident in which the plaintiff suffered severe injuries. The defendant answered the complaint and denied liability.

The plaintiff served a request for admission on the defendant. The plaintiff requested that the defendant admit that the defendant failed to stop at the intersection where the collision occurred. The defendant did not respond to the request. At the final pretrial conference two months later, the plaintiff claims that the defendant's failure to stop at the intersection should be deemed conclusively established at trial.

Is the plaintiff correct?

一名原告在联邦地区法院起诉一名被告，指控其因过失造成了一场事故，导致原告受重伤。被告对起诉状作出了答辩，并否认了其责任。

原告向被告送达了一份请求承认书。原告请求被告承认，被告在发生碰撞的交叉路口未曾停车。被告未对该请求作出回应。两个月后，在最终审前会议上，原告主张，被告未在交叉路口停车这一事实应被视为在审判中已确定无疑地成立。

原告的主张是否正确？
options:
A. No, because the defendant denied liability in his answer to the complaint.
否，因为被告已在其对起诉状的答辩中否认了责任。

B. No, because the defendant did not admit that he failed to stop at the intersection.
否，因为被告并未承认其未在交叉路口停车。

C. Yes, because the defendant failed to respond to the request for admission.
是，因为被告未对请求承认书作出回应。

D. Yes, but only if the plaintiff demonstrates by a preponderance of the evidence that the defendant failed to stop at the intersection.
是，但仅当原告以优势证据证明被告未在交叉路口停车时才正确。
data.explanation:
A request for admission seeks to expedite litigation and decrease costs by alleviating the need to prove undisputed matters at trial. In this method of discovery, a party requests that another party admit the truth about matters within the scope of discovery that relate to facts, the application of law to facts, opinions about either, or the genuineness of documents. The party served with the request must then serve a written response † within 30 days that:
admits the matterspecifically denies the matter in whole or in part
explains why the matter cannot be admitted or deniedorobjects that the matter falls outside the scope of discovery.
An admission or a failure to adequately respond within 30 days results in the matter being admitted and conclusively established in the action unless the admission is later withdrawn or amended.

Here, the plaintiff requested that the defendant admit that he failed to stop at the intersection where the collision occurred. The defendant did not admit this fact, but he failed to respond before the final pretrial conference that took place two months after the request was served. As a result, the plaintiff is correct that the defendant's failure to stop at the intersection should be deemed conclusively established at trial (Choice C).

†Alternatively, a party served with a request for admission may move for a protective order or ask for an extension of time to respond to the request.

(Choice A) The defendant's denial of liability in the answer to the complaint does not serve as a denial to the plaintiff's request for admission.

(Choice D) To prevail at trial, the plaintiff must prove each element of negligence by a preponderance of the evidence. But the plaintiff need not satisfy this burden to conclusively establish a fact in a request for admission. The plaintiff simply needs to show that the defendant failed to respond to the request (as seen here).

Educational objective: A party's admission or failure to adequately respond to a request for admission within 30 days after being served with the request results in the matter being conclusively established in the action.



选项正确率统计：A选项 18%，B选项 13%，C选项 61%（正确选项），D选项 6%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

请求承认书旨在通过减少在审判中证明无争议事项的需要，从而加快诉讼进程并降低成本。在这种证据开示方法中，一方当事人请求另一方当事人承认在证据开示范围内的、与事实、法律对事实的适用、关于前两者的意见或文件的真实性有关的事项的真实性。收到请求书的当事人则必须在30天内送达书面答复†，该答复应：
承认该事项明确否认该事项的全部或部分
解释为何该事项无法被承认或否认或提出异议，认为该事项超出了证据开示的范围。
承认或在30天内未能作出充分回应，其结果将导致该事项被视为承认，并在该诉讼中被确定无疑地成立，除非该承认后续被撤回或修正。

在本案中，原告请求被告承认其在发生碰撞的交叉路口未曾停车。被告没有承认这一事实，但他在请求书送达两个月后举行的最终审前会议之前都未作出回应。因此，原告的主张是正确的，即被告未在交叉路口停车这一事实应被视为在审判中确定无疑地成立（选项C）。

†作为替代方案，收到请求承认书的当事人可以申请保护令或请求延长回应时间。

（选项A）被告在对起诉状的答辩中否认责任，并不构成对原告请求承认书的否认。

（选项D）为了在审判中胜诉，原告必须以优势证据证明过失的每一个构成要件。但是，原告无需满足此证明责任来通过请求承认书使一个事实确定无疑地成立。原告仅需证明被告未对该请求作出回应（如本案所示）。

教学目标：当事人在收到请求承认书后30天内承认或未能作出充分回应，将导致该事项在该诉讼中被确定无疑地成立。

References

Fed. R. Civ. P. 36 (requests for admission).

8B Charles Alan Wright, Arthur R. Miller & Richard L. Marcus, Federal Practice and Procedure § 2259 (3d ed. 2020) (responses to requests for admissions).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：
请求承认书的效力

Civil Procedure / Discovery
正确答案：C

是的，因为被告未对请求承认书作出回应。

根据联邦民事诉讼规则，未在规定时间内回应请求承认书，该事项即被视为承认，并在审判中被确定无疑地成立。

核心考点：Fed. R. Civ. P. 36

请求承认书 (Requests for Admission) 是一种强大的证据开示工具。其核心规则如下：

送达请求 (Service)
一方当事人向另一方送达请求，要求承认特定事实。
30天期限 (30-Day Deadline)
接收方必须在30天内作出书面回应（承认、否认或提出异议）。
后果 (Consequence)
若未回应，该事项被自动视为承认 (Deemed Admitted)。
法律效力：
根据规则第36(b)条，被承认的事项在未决诉讼中被确定无疑地成立 (Conclusively Established)。这意味着原告在审判中无需再提供证据来证明这一事实。
本案分析

在本案中，原告利用了规则的自动生效机制：

  • 原告请求被告承认“未在路口停车”。
  • 被告完全没有回应（沉默）。
  • 时间过去了两个月（超过了30天）。

结论： 无论被告在最初的答辩状中如何否认责任，他在证据开示阶段的沉默导致了该特定事实被法律强制锁定。原告无需再举证证明被告没停车，法官必须指示陪审团将此视为既定事实。

易错项辨析
选项 A 错误
被告在答辩状 (Answer) 中的一般性否认不能替代对请求承认书的回应。这是两个独立的诉讼阶段。答辩状只是确立了争议点，而请求承认书旨在移除无争议的事实。
选项 D 错误
优势证据 (Preponderance of the evidence) 是审判时的证明标准。既然该事实因被告未回应而已被“确定无疑地成立”，原告就不需要再承担任何证明责任。
MBE 备考锦囊
  • 看到 "Request for Admission" + "No Response"，立刻寻找“视为承认” (Deemed Admitted) 的选项。
  • 记住关键词：Conclusively Established（确定无疑地成立）。这比一般的证据更有力，因为它免除了证明责任。
  • 不要混淆“答辩状中的否认”与“证据开示中的回应”。

questions.question:
An employer believed that a former employee had disclosed the employer's trade secrets. As a result, the employer sued the employee in federal court for infringement of trade secrets. The employer sought to conduct an oral deposition of the employee. The employer's attorney sent the employee's attorney written notice of the deposition. On the day of the deposition, the employee and the employee's attorney arrived at the designated location, but the employer and the employer's attorney failed to attend.
What should the federal court do upon request?

choices.a: Award the employee the reasonable expenses of attending the deposition.
choices.b: Dismiss the employer's claim against the employee.
choices.c: Enter a protective order that prohibits a future deposition of the employee.
choices.d: Hold the employer in contempt of court.

questions.question:
An individual filed an action against an acquaintance seeking damages resulting from an alleged assault and battery. Prior to trial, the acquaintance deposed a witness to the altercation. At the deposition, which was attended by the individual, the witness stated that the individual was the initial aggressor. At trial, the individual called the witness to the stand. The witness testified that the acquaintance was the initial aggressor. On cross-examination, after the witness repeated her direct testimony, the acquaintance sought to introduce the witness's deposition testimony to impeach her trial testimony that the acquaintance was the initial aggressor. The individual objected.
Should the court allow this use of the witness's deposition testimony?

choices.a: No, because deposition testimony cannot be used unless the deponent is unavailable.
choices.b: No, because the witness is not a party in this action.
choices.c: Yes, because the deposition is being used to impeach the witness's trial testimony.
choices.d: Yes, because the deposition was conducted by the party seeking to use the witness's deposition testimony.

questions.question:
An investor who purchased shares of a corporation's stock filed a class action lawsuit against the corporation seeking damages in excess of $75,000 based on violations of federal securities law. The investor sought certification of the class of investors who bought or sold shares in reliance on misrepresentations that materially affected the corporation's stock price. Among the issues that the class would have to establish in order to recover is that the misrepresentations were material. The investor showed that the issue of materiality was common to all of the investors and that this issue predominated over issues that affected individual members of the class. The investor did not present evidence that the misrepresentations were material.
Is the court prohibited from certifying the class under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 23(b)(3)?

choices.a: No, because the investor is seeking damages in excess of $75,000.
choices.b: No, because the investor showed that the issue of materiality was common to all of the investors and predominated over issues affecting individual members of the class.
choices.c: Yes, because the investor failed to establish a likelihood of success on the issue of materiality.
choices.d: Yes, because the investor is not also seeking injunctive or declaratory relief.

questions.question:
A husband and wife from State A divorced. As part of their divorce settlement, the husband agreed to keep the wife as the sole beneficiary of his employer-sponsored life insurance policy worth $100,000. A court entered this settlement agreement as part of its divorce decree.
The husband remarried and moved with his second wife to State B. The husband then revised his life insurance policy to name the second wife as the sole beneficiary.
When the husband later died, the first and second wife each filed claims with the life insurance company to recover the proceeds from his policy. The insurance company, which is incorporated and has its principal place of business in State B, wants to avoid paying the proceeds twice.
If the insurance company files suit in federal district court, what procedure should the insurance company use to avoid double liability?

choices.a: Class action.
choices.b: Intervention.
choices.c: Rule interpleader.
choices.d: Statutory interpleader.

Q88234

A husband and wife from State A divorced. As part of their divorce settlement, the husband agreed to keep the wife as the sole beneficiary of his employer-sponsored life insurance policy worth $100,000. A court entered this settlement agreement as part of its divorce decree.

The husband remarried and moved with his second wife to State B. The husband then revised his life insurance policy to name the second wife as the sole beneficiary.

When the husband later died, the first and second wife each filed claims with the life insurance company to recover the proceeds from his policy. The insurance company, which is incorporated and has its principal place of business in State B, wants to avoid paying the proceeds twice.

What procedure should the insurance company use to avoid double liability?

一对来自A州的夫妻离婚。作为离婚协议的一部分，丈夫同意让妻子继续作为其由雇主提供、价值10万美元人寿保险的唯一受益人。法院将此协议作为离婚判决的一部分予以登记。

该丈夫再婚，并与第二任妻子迁往B州。随后，该丈夫修改其人寿保险单，指定第二任妻子为唯一受益人。

丈夫后来去世后，第一任和第二任妻子均向人寿保险公司提出索赔，要求获得保单的赔偿金。该保险公司在B州注册成立且主要营业地也在B州，希望避免双重赔付。

该保险公司应采用何种程序来避免双重责任？
options:
A. Class action.
集体诉讼。

B. Impleader.
第三方诉讼。

C. Rule interpleader.
规则互争权诉讼。

D. Statutory interpleader.
法定互争权诉讼。
data.explanation:
Interpleader is a procedure used when multiple persons claim an interest in the same property (ie, the stake) - like the wives claiming an interest in the same life insurance proceeds here. It allows the possessor of the stake (ie, stakeholder ) to avoid multiple liability by joining the claimants to litigate the ownership of the stake amongst themselves. There are two types of interpleader with distinct subject-matter jurisdiction requirements that must be met before a federal court can hear the dispute:

Interpleader Subject-Matter Jurisdiction Requirements


Rule interpleaderrequires that (1) the action arise under a federal question or (2) the amount in controversy exceed $75,000 and completediversity exist between the stakeholder and claimants - ie, they must be citizens of different states
Statutory interpleaderrequires an amount in controversy of at least $500 and minimaldiversity between the claimants - ie, at least two claimants are citizens of different states
Here, rule interpleader is unavailable because the insurance company (stakeholder) from State B is not completely diverse from the wives (claimants) from States A and B (Choice C). But subject-matter jurisdiction exists under statutory interpleader because the wives are diverse and the amount in controversy exceeds $500. Therefore, the insurance company should use statutory interpleader to avoid paying the proceeds twice.

(Choice A) A certified class action allows named parties to sue or be sued on behalf of similarly situated unnamed parties. One requirement for certification is that the class be so numerous that joinder of all members is impracticable, which is not met by the two wives here.

(Choice B) Impleader allows a defendant to bring in a nonparty who may be liable to the defendant for all or part of the plaintiff's claim (not seen here).

Educational objective: Diversity jurisdiction for rule interpleader requires complete diversity between the stakeholder and claimants AND an amount in controversy that exceeds $75,000. But statutory interpleader only requires minimal diversity between the claimants AND an amount in controversy of at least $500.



选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 37%，C选项 21%，D选项 39%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

互争权诉讼 (Interpleader) 是一种程序，当多方对同一财产（即，争议标的）主张权利时使用——就像本案中两位妻子对同一笔人寿保险赔偿金主张权利一样。它允许争议标的的占有人（即，利益相关方）通过将索赔人加入诉讼，让他们之间就争议标的所有权进行诉讼，从而避免多重责任。互争权诉讼有两种类型，其对事物管辖权有不同要求，必须满足这些要求，联邦法院才能审理该争议：

互争权诉讼的事物管辖权要求


规则互争权诉讼 (Rule interpleader)要求 (1) 诉讼由联邦问题引起 或 (2) 争议金额超过75,000美元，且利益相关方与索赔人之间存在完全多元性——即，他们必须是不同州的公民
法定互争权诉讼 (Statutory interpleader)要求争议金额至少为500美元，且索赔人之间存在最低限度的多元性——即，至少有两名索赔人是不同州的公民
在本案中，规则互争权诉讼 (rule interpleader) 不可用，因为来自B州的保险公司（利益相关方）与来自A州和B州的妻子们（索赔人）之间不具有完全多元性 (选项 C)。但根据法定互争权诉讼 (statutory interpleader)，事物管辖权是存在的，因为两位妻子具有多元性（分属不同州），且争议金额超过500美元。因此，保险公司应使用法定互争权诉讼来避免双重赔付。

(选项 A) 经认证的集体诉讼允许指定当事方代表处境相似的未具名当事方提起诉讼或应诉。认证的要求之一是，集体成员人数众多，以至于合并所有成员进行诉讼不切实际，本案中的两位妻子不满足此条件。

(选项 B) 第三方诉讼 (Impleader) 允许被告将一个非当事方带入诉讼，而该非当事方可能就原告的全部或部分索赔对被告负有责任（本案情况不符）。

教学目的：规则互争权诉讼 (rule interpleader) 的多元化管辖权要求利益相关方与索赔人之间存在完全多元性，并且争议金额超过75,000美元。而法定互争权诉讼 (statutory interpleader) 仅要求索赔人之间存在最低限度的多元性，并且争议金额至少为500美元。

References

  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 22 (rule interpleader).
  • 28 U.S.C. §§ 1335, 1397 & 2361 (statutory interpleader).
  • State Farm Fire & Cas. Co. v. Tashire, 386 U.S. 523, 530 - 31 (1967) (explaining the minimal diversity requirements for statutory interpleader).

MBE 考点解析

民事诉讼法 (Civil Procedure)
正确答案 D. 法定互争权诉讼 (Statutory Interpleader)

本题的核心考点在于区分联邦法院受理互争权诉讼的两种形式及其管辖权要求：规则互争权诉讼 (Rule 22) 与 法定互争权诉讼 (§ 1335)。

核心概念对比

当保险公司（Stakeholder）面临多方索赔（Claimants）且不想双重赔付时，使用 Interpleader。选择哪种形式取决于当事人的公民身份 (Citizenship) 和 争议金额。

特征 规则互争权诉讼
(Rule 22)		 法定互争权诉讼
(Statutory § 1335)
多元性要求
(Diversity)		 完全多元性
(Complete Diversity)
利益相关方 vs. 所有索赔人		 最低限度多元性
(Minimal Diversity)
索赔人 vs. 索赔人
争议金额
(Amount)		 超过 $75,000 $500 或以上
保证金
(Deposit)		 非强制要求 必须向法院交存争议财产
案情具体分析
1. 确定当事人身份：
  • 利益相关方 保险公司：B州 (注册地+主要营业地)
  • 索赔人1 前妻：A州
  • 索赔人2 现任妻子：B州 (随丈夫迁居)
2. 检验规则互争权诉讼 (Rule 22)：
要求利益相关方与所有索赔人完全不同州。
❌ 失败： 保险公司 (B州) 与 现任妻子 (B州) 来自同一州。不满足完全多元性。
3. 检验法定互争权诉讼 (Statutory)：
仅要求索赔人之间至少有两人来自不同州。
✅ 成功： 前妻 (A州) 与 现任妻子 (B州) 来自不同州。且金额 $100,000 > $500。
为什么其他选项错误？
  • A. Class Action (集体诉讼)： 适用于人数众多导致合并诉讼不切实际的情况。本案只有两名索赔人，不符合 Rule 23 的数量要求。
  • B. Impleader (第三方诉讼/引入承担责任者)： 这是被告（作为第三方原告）将一个应对原告索赔承担责任的第三方引入诉讼（Rule 14）。本案是保险公司主动发起诉讼解决归属问题，而非推卸责任给第三方。
  • C. Rule Interpleader： 如上分析，因缺乏“完全多元性”而不可用。
💡 MBE 考试技巧
做 Interpleader 题目时，第一步先看利益相关方 (Stakeholder) 的公民身份是否与任何一个索赔人 (Claimant) 相同。
如果是，Rule Interpleader 立即被排除（除非有联邦问题管辖权），答案通常是 Statutory Interpleader。
